Proteomic analyses were performed using pen-level biological replication (n = 4/treatment group) to identify proteins differentially abundant in response to chronic cyclic HS. The LC-MS/MS proteomics combined with bioinformatics was undertaken to identify proteins in breast muscle with significant changes in abundance in response to HS exposure.4. Bioinformatics confirmed that 116 proteins were differentially expressed, with the majority downregulated (88%) under HS, as determined at a significant fusion score ≤ 0.05. The KEGG pathways related to extracellular matrix organisation and structural integrity, including cytoskeleton in muscle cells, extra-cellular matrix (ECM)-receptor interaction and focal adhesion, were significantly enriched. The majority of associated proteins in these pathways were downregulated in breast muscle of HS-challenged broilers.5. Gene Ontology Cellular Component terms, including extracellular matrix and external encapsulating structure were enriched, likely indicating HS-induced impairment of muscle structural stability and cell–matrix interactions in broiler breast muscle.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 先前研究顯示，與適溫對照組（TN；23°C）相比，慢性週期性熱緊迫（HS；33°C，每天 8 小時）導致肉雞胸肌減少了 18.2%。鑑於熱緊迫對肉雞胸肌質量的負面影響，本試驗採用基於質譜（MS）的蛋白質體學，比較飼養於熱緊迫或適溫條件下肉雞的肌肉蛋白質表現，以探討熱緊迫導致胸肌質量減少所涉及的分子機制。

2. 本試驗使用 15 至 35 日齡的肉雞。馴化期為 15 日齡至 21 日齡，期間熱緊迫組的雞隻經歷溫度自 28°C 至 33°C（每天 8 小時）的逐步升高，於 21 日齡達到 33°C 並維持至 35 日齡。

3. 在 35 日齡時，隨機選取公雞（每處理 n = 10，總 n = 20）並安樂死，以進行胸肌蛋白質體譜分析。蛋白質體分析採用欄舍層級的生物學重複（每處理組 n = 4），以鑑定因應慢性週期性熱緊迫而表現量有差異的蛋白質。本研究結合液相層析串聯質譜（LC-MS/MS）蛋白質體學與生物資訊學，以鑑定因熱緊迫暴露而使胸肌中蛋白質表現量發生顯著變化的蛋白質。

4. 生物資訊學證實有 116 種蛋白質有顯著表現差異，在顯著融合分數 $\le$ 0.05 的標準下，熱緊迫下絕大多數蛋白質（88%）表現量下調。與細胞外基質組織和結構完整性相關的 KEGG 通路顯著富集，包括肌細胞中的細胞骨架、細胞外基質（ECM）-受體交互作用以及細胞黏附。這些通路中多數相關的蛋白質在熱緊迫處理肉雞的胸肌中皆表現量下調。

5. 基因本體論（Gene Ontology）細胞組分術語（包括細胞外基質和外部包被結構）顯著富集，這可能暗示熱緊迫導致肉雞胸肌的肌肉結構穩定性及細胞與基質交互作用受損。

papers.title: Biological functions and mechanisms of boron in poultry
papers.abstract: SUMMARYBoron has attracted increasing attention in poultry nutrition because of its potential biological and metabolic effects, although it is not currently recognised as an essential trace element. This review critically evaluates evidence on the effects of boron supplementation on growth performance, skeletal integrity, eggshell quality, reproductive traits, metabolism, antioxidant status, and health in poultry. Available studies indicate that boron may improve feed efficiency, bone mineralisation, and mineral utilisation, particularly when calcium (Ca), phosphorus (P), or vitamin D3 supply is marginal. Studies on laying hens and pullets reported changes in eggshell characteristics, bone strength, selected serum biochemical indices, and egg yolk lipid composition following boron supplementation. Evidence from breeder flocks and other poultry species, including geese and quail, suggested potential effects on follicular development, fertility, hatchability, and reproductive physiology. Mechanistically, boron may influence mineral metabolism, endocrine signalling, redox balance, and metabolic regulation through interactions with the Ca–P–vitamin D3 axis and related pathways, although direct molecular validation in poultry remains limited. Responses are dose-dependent: supplementation levels in the lower nutritional range commonly examined in poultry studies (approximately 5–75 mg kg−1, depending on species and dietary context) are associated with beneficial effects or no significant change in measured outcomes, whereas studies using much higher experimental exposures (≥200–400 mg kg−1) reported impaired growth performance, reduced feed intake, decreased egg production, or metabolic disturbances. Poultry boron studies generally use conventional experimental designs comparable to those used for other trace elements; the main challenge for synthesis is the broad range of boron inclusion levels and nutritional contexts evaluated. Accordingly, boron should be regarded as a potentially functional, context-dependent dietary component for which an essential requirement has not been established in poultry. The broad range of boron doses evaluated limited molecular characterisation of underlying mechanisms and scarce data on long-term safety.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
雖然硼目前尚未被公認為必需微量元素，但因其具有潛在的生物學與代謝效應，在家禽營養學中日益受到關注。本篇文獻綜述批判性地評估了補充硼對家禽生長性能、骨骼完整性、蛋殼品質、繁殖性狀、代謝、抗氧化狀態及健康影響之證據。現有研究顯示，硼可能有助於改善飼料效率、骨骼礦化及礦物質利用率，特別是在鈣（Ca）、磷（P）或維生素 D3 供應處於臨界值時。針對產蛋母雞與生長母雞的研究指出，補充硼後，其蛋殼特性、骨強度、特定血清生化指標及蛋黃脂質組成皆有改變。來自種禽群及其他家禽物種（包括鵝與鵪鶉）的證據表明，硼對卵泡發育、受精率、孵化率及生殖生理具有潛在影響。在機制方面，硼可能透過與 Ca–P–維生素 D3 軸及相關途徑的相互作用，影響礦物質代謝、內分泌信號傳遞、氧化還原平衡與代謝調節，儘管在家禽中的直接分子驗證仍相當有限。反應具有劑量依賴性：在家禽研究通常檢視的較低營養範圍內（約 5–75 mg kg−1，取決於物種與日糧背景）之補充濃度，通常與測定指標的有益影響或無顯著變化相關，而使用高得多的實驗暴露量（≥200–400 mg kg−1）的研究則報告了生長性能受損、採食量下降、產蛋量減少或代謝紊亂。家禽的硼研究通常採用與其他微量元素類似的傳統實驗設計；綜合分析的主要挑戰在於所評估的硼添加水平與營養背景範圍廣泛。因此，硼應被視為一種具潛在功能性、且取決於背景的日糧成分，目前尚未確立其在家禽中的必需需求量。所評估的廣泛硼劑量範圍限制了對潛在機制的分子表徵，且關於長期安全性的數據亦相當匱乏。

papers.title: Inbreeding Depression in Wild Mammals: Genomic Mechanisms and Conservation Consequences
papers.abstract: Inbreeding depression is a widespread but highly variable threat to wild mammal populations, especially small, isolated, or fragmented ones. Genomic tools can now estimate individual inbreeding and mutation load more precisely than pedigrees or a few genetic markers. They show that similar levels of autozygosity can have very different fitness consequences. In this structured narrative review, we examine how runs of homozygosity, genomic inbreeding coefficients, and mutation load relate to inbreeding depression in wild mammals. We distinguish inbreeding (a process), autozygosity (its genomic consequence), low genetic diversity, and inbreeding depression (a fitness outcome), and we stress that high autozygosity alone does not demonstrate fitness costs. We compare land and marine case studies in which high autozygosity is associated with reduced reproduction, survival, and disease resistance, with cases in which purging or demographic history may have limited the decline in fitness. We consider how environmental stress, methodological differences, and confounding factors affect the observed inbreeding–fitness relationships. We then discuss how genomic estimates can inform conservation decisions, including the limits of genetic rescue, and we identify research priorities such as long-term studies that combine genomic, demographic, and ecological data. The review offers a framework for interpreting genomic inbreeding measures cautiously in conservation planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 近親衰退（inbreeding depression）對野生哺乳動物族群是普遍存在且變異極大的威脅，特別是對小型、隔離或破碎化的族群而言。基因體工具現在能夠比譜系或少數基因標記更精確地估計個體的近親交配與突變負擔（mutation load）。這些工具顯示，相似程度的同源合子化（autozygosity）可能會產生截然不同的適應度（fitness）後果。在本篇結構化敘事綜論中，我們檢視了連續同源區段（runs of homozygosity）、基因體近親交配係數與突變負擔如何與野生哺乳動物的近親衰退相關聯。我們區分了近親交配（一種過程）、同源合子化（其基因體後果）、低基因多樣性以及近親衰退（一種適應度結果），並強調單憑高同源合子化並不能證明存在適應度成本。我們比較了陸域與海洋的案例研究，在這些案例中，高同源合子化與繁殖力、存活率及抗病力的降低有關，但也有些案例顯示基因淨化（purging）或人口學歷史可能限制了適應度的下降。我們探討了環境壓力、方法學差異與混擾因子如何影響所觀察到的近親交配與適應度之間的關係。接著，我們討論基因體估計值如何為保育決策提供資訊（包括基因救援的極限），並指出了研究優先事項，例如結合基因體、人口學與生態學數據的長期研究。本綜論為在保育規劃中審慎解讀基因體近親交配指標提供了框架。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Association Study of Body Weight and Body Size Traits in Wenshang Barred Chickens at the Late Rearing Stage
papers.abstract: The late rearing stage is a critical period for the development of body weight and body size traits in chickens. In this study, we investigated the genetic architecture underlying these traits in 925 healthy 16-week-old Wenshang Barred chickens, with the aim of identifying candidate genes and genetic markers for trait improvement. We performed a genome-wide association study, linkage disequilibrium analysis, genotype–phenotype effect analysis, and enrichment analysis for body weight and seven body size traits. Heritability estimates for these traits ranged from 0.18 to 0.48. The study identified 89 candidate genes, including SETDB2, CAB39L, RB1, TRIM13, LDB2, and LCORL. In addition to the classic growth-associated region at GGA4:72.48–76.42 Mb, we identified an important region at GGA4:68.24–70.22 Mb, located approximately 2.3 Mb upstream, as well as an important region at GGA1:168.03–170.24 Mb. Functional enrichment analysis revealed that candidate genes were nominally enriched (p < 0.05) in amino sugar and nucleotide sugar metabolism, biosynthesis of nucleotide sugars, calcium signaling, and neuroactive ligand–receptor interaction pathways. Collectively, our findings clarify the genetic basis of body weight and body size traits during the late rearing stage and may provide a basis for further evaluation of genetic markers in indigenous chicken breeding programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 育雛後期是雞隻體重與體型性狀發育的關鍵時期。在本研究中，我們探討了 925 隻 16 週齡健康汶上蘆花雞這些性狀背後的遺傳結構，旨在找出用於性狀改良的候選基因與遺傳標記。我們針對體重及七項體型性狀進行了全基因組關聯分析、連鎖不平衡分析、基因型－表現型效應分析以及富集分析。這些性狀的遺傳力估值介於 0.18 至 0.48 之間。本研究辨識出 89 個候選基因，包含 SETDB2、CAB39L、RB1、TRIM13、LDB2 與 LCORL。除了位於 GGA4:72.48–76.42 Mb 的經典生長相關區域外，我們還識別出一個位於約 2.3 Mb 上游、重要且位於 GGA4:68.24–70.22 Mb 的區域，以及一個位於 GGA1:168.03–170.24 Mb 的重要區域。功能富集分析顯示，候選基因在胺基糖與核苷酸糖代謝、核苷酸糖生物合成、鈣離子訊息傳遞及神經活性配體－受體交互作用等路徑中具有名義上的顯著富集（p < 0.05）。總體而言，我們的研究結果闡明了育雛後期體重與體型性狀的遺傳基礎，並可能為本土雞隻育種計畫中遺傳標記的進一步評估提供基礎。

papers.title: Dose–Response Evaluation of Dietary Curcumin Supplementation on Ileal Morphology and Antioxidant Status in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate suitable dietary curcumin supplementation levels for improving intestinal morphology and antioxidant status in medium-growing broiler chickens fed a practical corn–soybean meal diet from 57 to 84 d of age. A total of 252 male broilers (57 d of age; 1092.86 ± 8.91 g) were randomly assigned to six dietary treatments with seven replicate cages of six birds each. Broilers were fed diets supplemented with 0, 80, 160, 240, 320, or 400 mg/kg curcumin for 28 d. Asymptotic, broken-line, and quadratic models were fitted to dose–response data to estimate suitable dietary curcumin supplementation levels. Curcumin supplementation improved ileal morphology and antioxidant status, as evidenced by increased villus height (VH), VH/crypt depth (CD), villus surface area, total antioxidant capacity, and superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, together with decreased CD and malondialdehyde (MDA) content. Curcumin also upregulated the mRNA expression of catalase (CAT), SOD, glutathione peroxidase (GPX)1, GPX3, GPX4, and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and increased Nrf2 protein abundance. Among the candidate models, broken-line regression provided the best fit for key ileal antioxidant indices, indicating that approximately 188 mg/kg of dietary curcumin may be sufficient to maximize ileal total antioxidant capacity under the present experimental conditions. Furthermore, Nrf2 expression exhibited trends similar to those of antioxidant-related gene expression and antioxidant enzyme activities, but showed an opposite trend to MDA content. These findings suggest a potential association between Nrf2 expression and intestinal antioxidant status.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估在 57 至 84 日齡中生長肉雞飼餵實用型玉米－大豆粕日糧時，添加適宜劑量之日糧薑黃素對改善其腸道形態與抗氧化狀態的效果。試驗選用總計 252 隻公肉雞（57 日齡；1092.86 ± 8.91 克），隨機分配至 6 個日糧處理組，每組 7 個重複籠，每籠 6 隻雞。肉雞分別飼餵添加 0、80、160、240、320 或 400 mg/kg 薑黃素的日糧，為期 28 天。利用漸近線模型、折線模型及二次曲線模型對劑量反應數據進行擬合，以估算適宜的日糧薑黃素添加量。薑黃素添加改善了迴腸形態與抗氧化狀態，表現為絨毛高度（VH）、VH/隱窩深度（CD）比值、絨毛表面積、總抗氧化能力及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性增加，同時隱窩深度與丙二醛（MDA）含量降低。薑黃素亦上調了過氧化氫酶（CAT）、SOD、麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶（GPX）1、GPX3、GPX4 及核因子紅血球 2 相關因子 2（Nrf2）的 mRNA 表達，並增加了 Nrf2 蛋白質豐度。在候選模型中，折線迴歸對關鍵迴腸抗氧化指標的擬合效果最佳，顯示在本試驗條件下，約 188 mg/kg 的日糧薑黃素添加量即足以最大化迴腸總抗氧化能力。此外，Nrf2 表達趨勢與抗氧化相關基因表達及抗氧化酶活性相似，但與 MDA 含量呈相反趨勢。這些結果表明 Nrf2 表達與腸道抗氧化狀態之間存在潛在的關聯性。

papers.title: Combined Dietary Supplementation with Bacillus subtilis DSM 29784 and a Phytogenic Blend Modulates the Microbiome–Gut–Bone Axis in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: The microbiome–gut–bone axis may influence skeletal physiology in fast-growing broilers. This study evaluated dietary Bacillus subtilis DSM 29784 combined with a phytogenic blend (BsP) in 560 male Ross 308 broilers assigned to control or BsP diets (eight pens/treatment; 35 birds/pen) for 42 days. One clinically normal bird per pen was sampled on days 21, 35, and 42. BsP increased final body weight and cumulative gain and reduced the overall feed conversion ratio (p < 0.05). Intestinal barrier-associated gene expression increased, several ileal inflammatory marker transcripts decreased, and mineral-handling-related gene expression and serum/femoral mineral concentrations were higher at selected ages. Cecal 16S rRNA gene profiles showed differences in diversity and taxonomic composition. PICRUSt2 identified differences in predicted microbial functional potential, not measured pathway activity or metabolite production. Femoral inflammatory and osteogenic gene expression responses varied with age. Exploratory networks summarized microbiome–gut–bone associations at days 21, 35, and 42 without establishing causality or within-bird temporal change. BsP was associated with improved growth and altered intestinal and bone-related indicators, but clinical BCO prevention was not established. Future factorial studies should include direct bone quality measurements, standardized clinical and lesion assessments, and targeted microbial metabolite measurements.
papers.abstract_zh: 微生物群－腸道－骨骼軸可能會影響生長快速的肉雞之骨骼生理。本研究評估在 560 隻羅斯 308（Ross 308）公肉雞日糧中添加枯草芽孢桿菌 DSM 29784 結合植物萃取物複合物（BsP），試驗雞隻隨機分配至對照組或 BsP 組（每處理 8 個欄位；每欄 35 隻雞），為期 42 天。於第 21、35 和 42 天每欄採樣 1 隻臨床健康的雞隻。BsP 提高了最終體重與累積增重，並降低了整體飼料增重比（$p < 0.05$）。在特定週齡下，腸道屏障相關基因表現增加、數個迴腸發育發炎標記轉錄本減少、礦物質處理相關基因表現以及血清／股盲腸礦物質濃度較高。盲腸 16S rRNA 基因圖譜顯示多樣性與分類組成有所差異。PICRUSt2 鑑定出預測微生物功能潛力的差異，但未測量代謝途徑活性或代謝物產量。股骨發炎與成骨基因表現反應隨週齡而異。探索性網路總結了第 21、35 和 42 天的微生物群－腸道－骨骼關聯，但未確立因果關係或個別雞隻的的時間序列變化。BsP 與生長改善及腸道和骨骼相關指標的改變有關，但尚未確立預防臨床細菌性軟骨壞死性骨髓炎（BCO）的效果。未來的析因研究應包含直接的骨骼品質測量、標準化的臨床與病灶評估，以及標的性微生物代謝物測量。

papers.title: Effect of tannic acid and chitosan supplementation on growth performance, antioxidant status, immune function, and caecal microbial diversity of Pekin duck aged 0 to 21 days
papers.abstract: 1. Tannic acid (TA) and chitosan (CH) are natural compounds with antioxidant, antimicrobial and immunomodulatory bioactivities. This study evaluated the effects of dietary TA, CH and their combination on White Pekin ducks aged 0 to 21 d.2. A total of 336 one-day-old Pekin ducks were randomly assigned to one of four dietary treatments with six replicate cages per treatment and 14 birds per cage. The treatments included a basal diet (CON), CON +0.2% TA, CON +0.2% CH and CON +0.2% TA + 0.2% CH. The trial lasted 21 d.3. Dietary supplementation with 0.2% TA alone increased average daily gain (p < 0.05), while 0.2% CH decreased thymus weight and thymus index (p < 0.05). Both TA and CH alone improved serum antioxidant status and immunoglobulin levels, but their combination did not give any synergistic effects.4. All supplemented diets modified caecal microbial community structure, which significantly reduced the relative abundance of Proteobacteria at the phylum level and Desulphovibrio at the genus level (p < 0.05).5. In conclusion, 0.2% TA alone improved growth performance, while 0.2% CH alone enhanced antioxidant and immune function in 0–21 d Pekin ducks. The combination of TA and CH showed no synergistic benefits. Both compounds beneficially modulated caecal microbiota by inhibiting potentially harmful taxa. These results indicated that single supplementation of TA or CH is more suitable for Pekin duck production.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 單寧酸（tannic acid, TA）與殼聚醣（chitosan, CH）是具有抗氧化、抗菌及免疫調節生物活性的天然化合物。本研究旨在評估飼糧中添加 TA、CH 及其複合添加對 0 至 21 日齡白北京鴨之影響。
2. 試驗選用共 336 隻一日齡北京鴨，隨機分配至四種飼糧處理組，每組 6 個重複籠，每籠 14 隻鴨。處理組包括基礎飼糧（CON）、CON + 0.2% TA、CON + 0.2% CH，以及 CON + 0.2% TA + 0.2% CH。試驗為期 21 天。
3. 飼糧單獨添加 0.2% TA 可提高平均日增重（p < 0.05），而單獨添加 0.2% CH 則會降低胸腺重與胸腺指數（p < 0.05）。單獨添加 TA 與 CH 均能改善血清抗氧化狀態及免疫球蛋白濃度，但兩者併用並未產生協同效應。
4. 所有添加試驗飼糧皆改變了盲腸微生物相結構，顯著降低了門級變形菌門（Proteobacteria）及屬級脫硫弧菌屬（Desulphovibrio）之相對豐度（p < 0.05）。
5. 綜上所述，於 0–21 日齡北京鴨飼糧中，單獨添加 0.2% TA 可改善生長性能，單獨添加 0.2% CH 則可增強抗氧化與免疫功能。TA 與 CH 併用並未顯示出協同效益。此兩種化合物皆能透過抑制潛在有害菌群，對盲腸微生物相發揮有益的調節作用。結果顯示，單獨添加 TA 或 CH 更適合應用於北京鴨生產。

papers.title: Effects of a low dose of 3-nitrooxypropanol and a combination of direct-fed microbials on methane emission, oral swab bacterial community, and performance in dairy cows
papers.abstract: Background 3-Nitrooxypropanol (3-NOP) can inhibit ruminal methane production by inactivating the key enzyme during methanogenesis. Combining 3-NOP and direct-fed microbials (DFM) can potentially provide a dual-action approach to reduce ruminal methane production. The objective of this study was to investigate the effects of supplementation of a low dose of 3-NOP and a mixture of DFM, on methane emissions, performance, and rumen microbial community of dairy cows. Results Forty-eight Danish Holstein dairy cows were used in a 14-week randomized complete block design. Due to a mixing error, 3-NOP was included at an unexpected low dose (6.0 mg/kg DM). Cows were fed with one of four experimental diets: (1) control diet, and other treatment diets were control diet supplemented with (2) 3-NOP, or with (3) DFM (12 mg/kg P. acidipropionici strain P169 and 120 mg/kg Bacillus subtilis and B. licheniformis mixture), or with (4) a combination of 3-NOP and DFM. 3-NOP inclusion did not affect DMI, feed efficiency, or milk yield and composition. DFM supplementation reduced partial mixed ration intake and total DMI. 3-NOP supplementation significantly reduced CH 4 production (g/d) (8%) and CH 4 intensity (g/kg ECM) (9%) but did not affect CH 4 yield (g/kg DMI). Furthermore, 3-NOP supplementation increased H 2 production, yield, and intensity. DFM supplementation reduced milk yield from weeks 3 to 8 and ECM yield from weeks 3 to 7, but these effects diminished over time. 3-NOP alone or in combination with DFM resulted in higher abundance of Megasphaera and Prevotella genera in oral swab samples. DFM supplementation had no effect on gas emissions, and it only tended to improve feed efficiency (ECM/DMI, kg/kg) during the later stage of the experiment. DFM supplementation led to higher abundance of certain species within the Lactobacillaceae family particularly at later stages of the experiment. Conclusions An unforeseen reduced dose of 3-NOP supplementation still can effectively mitigate methane emissions (both production and intensity) and increase H 2 emissions without affecting DMI or performance. DFM supplementation reduced DMI and milk yield at the onset of the experiment, but the effects subsided over time, resulting in an increased feed efficiency by the end of the experiment.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：3-硝基氧基丙醇（3-NOP）可透過去活化產甲烷過程中的關鍵酶，來抑制瘤胃甲烷生成。將 3-NOP 與直接飼喂微生物（DFM）結合，可能提供一種雙重作用的方法來減少瘤胃甲烷生成。本研究旨在探討補充低劑量 3-NOP 與 DFM 混合物對乳牛甲烷排放、生產性能及瘤胃微生物群落的影響。結果：本研究使用 48 頭丹麥荷斯坦乳牛進行為期 14 週的隨機完全區集設計。由於混合錯誤，3-NOP 的添加量為意料之外的低劑量（6.0 mg/kg 乾物質 [DM]）。乳牛被飼餵四種實驗日糧之一：（1）對照日糧，其他處理日糧則為對照日糧補充（2）3-NOP，或（3）DFM（12 mg/kg 費氏丙酸桿菌 P169 菌株及 120 mg/kg 枯草芽孢桿菌與地衣芽孢桿菌混合物），或（4）3-NOP 與 DFM 的組合。3-NOP 的添加不影響乾物質採食量（DMI）、飼料效率或乳產量與乳成分。DFM 補充降低了部分混合日糧的採食量及總 DMI。3-NOP 補充顯著降低了 $\text{CH}_4$ 產量（g/d）（8%）及 $\text{CH}_4$ 強度（g/kg 能量校正乳 [ECM]）（9%），但並不影響 $\text{CH}_4$ 得率（g/kg DMI）。此外，3-NOP 補充增加了 $\text{H}_2$ 的產量、得率及強度。DFM 補充在第 3 至 8 週降低了乳產量，在第 3 至 7 週降低了 ECM 產量，但這些影響隨時間而消退。單獨使用 3-NOP 或與 DFM 併用，會導致口腔拭子樣本中巨球形菌屬（Megasphaera）和普雷沃氏菌屬（Prevotella）的豐度增加。DFM 補充對氣體排放沒有影響，且僅在實驗後期傾向於改善飼料效率（ECM/DMI，kg/kg）。DFM 補充導致乳酸桿菌科（Lactobacillaceae）內某些物種的豐度增加，特別是在實驗後期。結論：未預期之低劑量的 3-NOP 補充仍能有效減緩甲烷排放（包括產量與強度）並增加 $\text{H}_2$ 排放，且不影響 DMI 或生產性能。DFM 補充在實驗初期降低了 DMI 與乳產量，但這些影響隨時間消退，並在實驗結束時提高了飼料效率。

papers.title: Population Genomic Survey of Dongliao Black and Jilin Spotted Pigs and Their Genetic Relationships With Northeastern Asian Breeds
papers.abstract: In this study, we conducted a population genomic survey of two local pig breeds in Jilin Province, Dongliao Black (DLB) and Jilin Spotted (JLS) pigs, and evaluated their genetic relationships with 23 Northeastern Asian pig breeds, comprising 46 wild boars, 211 Chinese local pigs, 69 Russian pigs, 13 Korean pigs, and 107 commercial pigs. The results will be helpful for the conservation and utilization of these rare germplasm resources. The minor allele frequency of DLB and JLS pigs was 0.24 and 0.22, respectively. Both DLB and JLS pigs exhibited higher observed heterozygosity than expected values. Moreover, JLS pigs displayed the lowest excess of homozygosity inbreeding coefficient (−0.12 ± 0.07) among all studied populations. Additionally, population structure analyses indicated that DLB and JLS pigs possess admixed ancestries intermediate between Chinese and Western pigs, with DLB being closely related to Min pigs and both breeds showing admixture signals with neighboring Northeastern Chinese breeds, reflecting their distinct hybrid histories. Furthermore, 16 and 19 genes were identified as putative candidate genes in DLB and JLS pigs using Fst analyses, respectively. All these findings are consistent with a history of crossbreeding and with low levels of inbreeding in DLB and JLS pig populations. Additionally, it is hypothesized that DLB and JLS pig breeds may carry putative candidate genes during their breeding programs, which are associated with meat quality, reproduction, production, immunity, and environmental adaptation. Therefore, strengthening conservation and promotion efforts for DLB and JLS pigs is of great significance.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究針對吉林省的兩個地方豬品種——東遼黑豬（DLB）與吉林斑豬（JLS）進行了群體基因體調查，並評估了牠們與23個東北亞豬品種（包含46頭野豬、211頭中國地方豬、69頭俄羅斯豬、13頭韓國豬及107頭商業豬）的遺傳關係。研究結果將有助於這些珍稀種質資源的保育與利用。DLB與JLS豬的次要等位基因頻率分別為0.24與0.22。DLB與JLS豬皆展現出高於期望值的觀測雜合度。此外，在所有受測群體中，JLS豬顯示出最低的純合度過剩近交係數（−0.12 ± 0.07）。再者，群體結構分析顯示，DLB與JLS豬具有介於中國地方豬與西方豬之間的混血祖先成分，其中DLB與民豬的親緣關係較近，且兩品種皆與鄰近的中國東北品種呈現混血信號，反映出其獨特的雜交歷史。此外，透過 $F_{st}$ 分析，分別在DLB與JLS豬中鑑定出16個與19個假定候選基因。所有這些發現皆與DLB和JLS豬群體的雜交歷史及低近交水準一致。此外，推測DLB與JLS豬品種在其育種過程中可能攜帶了與肉質、繁殖、生產、免疫及環境適應相關的假定候選基因。因此，加強DLB與JLS豬的保育與推廣工作具有重大意義。

papers.title: Effects of Grain Source and Emulsifier Supplementation of Reduced-Energy Diets on Performance, Slaughter Traits, Tibia Characteristics, Jejunal Histomorphology and Pancreatic Enzymes in Broilers
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the effect of emulsifier addition to reduced-energy maize-, barley- or wheat-based diets on selected indicators in broilers. In this experiment, a total of 540 unsexed (mixed-sex) one-day-old Ross 308 chicks were allocated to six treatment groups using a 3 × 2 factorial design (five replicate pens of 18 birds). Each diet was fed either as a standard-energy diet without emulsifier or as a reduced-energy diet (−50 kcal/kg ME, achieved by lowering soybean oil inclusion) supplemented with 500 g/ton emulsifier. The wheat-based diet reduced body weight and feed consumption but improved feed conversion ratio compared with the barley-based diet. Feeding a maize-based diet increased carcass yield and the breast (meat, skin and bone) ratio but decreased the leg (two thighs and two drumsticks, with meat, skin and bone) ratio compared to feeding a wheat-based diet. The addition of emulsifiers to barley- and wheat-based diets increased carcass yield. The negative effects of barley- and wheat-based diets on the carcass compared to the maize diet were compensated for by the addition of emulsifiers to the diet. The highest values for tibia breaking strength and tibia ash content were obtained with wheat-, maize-, and barley-based diets, respectively. Tibia ash increased with the addition of emulsifiers to barley- and wheat-based diets. Barley- and wheat-based diets resulted in higher pancreatic amylase activity compared to maize-based diets. Pancreatic lipase activity increased with the addition of emulsifiers. The wheat-based diet increased villus surface area compared to other cereals. The addition of emulsifier to the diet increased villus height/crypt depth but decreased other villus measurements. In conclusion, it can be said that adding emulsifiers to reduced-energy broiler diets feed is more effective in increasing carcass yield in barley- and wheat-based feeds, and that emulsifier addition compensates for the energy deficit in the diet.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估在減低能量的玉米、大麥或小麥基礎飼糧中添加乳化劑對肉雞特定指標之影響。在本實驗中，共 540 隻一日齡、公母混養的 Ross 308 肉雞被分配至六個處理組，採用 3 × 2 因子設計（設有 5 個重複欄位，每欄 18 隻雞）。每種飼糧分別為不含乳化劑之標準能量飼糧，或添加 500 克/噸乳化劑之減低能量飼糧（代謝能減少 50 千卡/公斤，透過降低大豆油添加量達成）。與大麥基礎飼糧相比，小麥基礎飼糧降低了體重和飼料消耗量，但改善了飼料換肉率。與餵食小麥基礎飼糧相比，餵食玉米基礎飼糧提高了屠宰率與胸肉（肉、皮和骨）比例，但降低了腿部（兩個大腿和兩個小腿，含肉、皮和骨）比例。在大麥和小麥基礎飼糧中添加乳化劑提高了屠宰率。大麥和小麥基礎飼糧對屠宰性狀相較於玉米飼糧所產生的負面影響，可透過在飼糧中添加乳化劑來彌補。脛骨斷裂強度和脛骨灰分含量的最高值分別出現在小麥、玉米和大麥基礎飼糧中。在大麥和小麥基礎飼糧中添加乳化劑會使脛骨灰分增加。與玉米基礎飼糧相比，大麥和小麥基礎飼糧導致較高的胰澱粉酶活性。胰脂肪酶活性隨乳化劑的添加而增加。與其他穀物相比，小麥基礎飼糧增加了絨毛表面積。飼糧中添加乳化劑增加了絨毛高度／隱窩深度比，但減少了其他絨毛測量值。總體而言，在減低能量的肉雞飼糧中添加乳化劑，對於提高大麥和小麥基礎飼料的屠宰率更為有效，且乳化劑的添加能補償飼糧中的能量赤字。

papers.title: Content of Manganese and Molybdenum in Selected Tissues and Organs of Mallards (Anas platyrhynchos L.) in Relation to Their Sex and Harvest Location
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to analyze the manganese and molybdenum content in selected tissues of mallard ducks (Anas platyrhynchos L.) depending on their location of collection and gender. The study was conducted on material obtained from mallard ducks from two study areas: the Siedlce hunting district and the Leszno hunting district. The research material consisted of breast muscles, leg muscles, and liver obtained from 28 mallards. The samples were frozen and stored at −20 °C. The material was analysed for manganese and molybdenum using inductively coupled argon plasma atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP OES), with a Perkin Elmer Optima 2000 DV spectrometer (Shelton, WA, USA). Manganese levels were significantly higher in mallards harvested in the Siedlce hunting district than in those from the Leszno hunting district. The pattern was reversed for molybdenum, which was present in higher concentrations in the tissues of mallards from the Leszno hunting district, although these were not statistically significant differences. Among the muscles and organs tested, the highest levels of manganese and molybdenum were shown in the liver. The level of molybdenum in the liver was significantly higher in male mallards than in females. An effect of the birds’ origin on manganese content and of sex on molybdenum content in mallard tissues was observed.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在分析綠頭鴨（*Anas platyrhynchos* L.）特定組織中的錳和鉬含量，並探討其與採集地點和性別的關係。本研究之實驗材料取自兩個研究區域的綠頭鴨：謝德爾采（Siedlce）狩獵區與萊什諾（Leszno）狩獵區。研究材料包含取自 28 隻綠頭鴨的胸肌、腿肌和肝臟。樣品經冷凍並保存於 −20 °C。使用感應耦合電漿原子發射光譜法（ICP OES），搭配 Perkin Elmer Optima 2000 DV 光譜儀（美國華盛頓州謝爾頓），分析材料中的錳和鉬含量。謝德爾采狩獵區捕獲的綠頭鴨，其錳濃度顯著高於萊什諾狩獵區的綠頭鴨。鉬則呈現相反的模式，萊什諾狩獵區綠頭鴨組織中的鉬濃度較高，儘管這些差異未達統計顯著性。在所測試的肌肉與器官中，錳和鉬的最高含量皆出現在肝臟中。雄性綠頭鴨肝臟中的鉬含量顯著高於雌性。研究觀察到鳥類的來源對綠頭鴨組織中的錳含量有影響，而性別則對鉬含量有影響。

papers.title: A Lightweight Deep Learning Approach for Real-Time Detection of Egg-Laying Behavior and Hatching Eggs in Breeding Ducks
papers.abstract: Egg production rate and laying behavior are important indicators of reproductive performance in breeding ducks. Manual monitoring is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and litter, small eggs, variable postures, and occlusion complicate detection. This study proposed DPG-YOLO to detect egg-laying behavior and hatching eggs. Based on YOLO26, the DE-C3K2 module was reconstructed to enhance fine-grained feature extraction. PPA was incorporated to strengthen multi-scale semantic modeling, and C3Ghost was adopted to optimize neck feature fusion and reduce redundant computation. DPG-YOLO achieved precision, recall, and mAP50 values of 96.8%, 96.3%, and 97.4%, respectively, exceeding YOLO26 by 4.6, 4.8, and 5.0 percentage points. The model required 7.6 GFLOPs, occupied 7.1 MB, and processed 124.1 frames/s. Automatically estimated egg production rate and laying behavior frequency were significantly and positively correlated with manually calculated values (rs = 0.987 and 0.964, p < 0.05). Neither indicator differed significantly between the two methods (p > 0.05). Thus, DPG-YOLO combines detection accuracy, real-time performance, and statistical reliability to support automated monitoring of reproductive performance, precision feeding management, and digitalization of breeding duck production.
papers.abstract_zh: 產蛋率與產蛋行為是種鴨繁殖性能的重要指標。人工監測耗時費力，且墊料、小蛋、多變的姿態及遮擋等因素使檢測更加複雜。本研究提出 DPG-YOLO 以檢測產蛋行為與種蛋。基於 YOLO26，重建了 DE-C3K2 模組以增強細粒度特徵萃取；納入 PPA 以強化多尺度語意建模；並採用 C3Ghost 來優化頸部特徵融合並減少冗餘計算。DPG-YOLO 的準確率、召回率和 mAP50 分別達到 96.8%、96.3% 和 97.4%，較 YOLO26 分別提升了 4.6、4.8 和 5.0 個百分點。該模型需要 7.6 GFLOPs 的運算量，佔用 7.1 MB 的記憶體，處理速度為 124.1 格/秒 (frames/s)。自動估算的產蛋率與產蛋行為頻率與人工計算值呈顯著正相關（rs 分別為 0.987 與 0.964，p < 0.05）。兩種方法的這兩項指標均無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。因此，DPG-YOLO 兼具檢測準確度、即時性能與統計可靠性，可支援繁殖性能的自動化監測、精準飼養管理以及種鴨生產的數位化。

papers.title: Correction: Genetic parameters via predictivity in large populations under strong genomic selection
Integrating longitudinal metabolite profiles improves phenotype prediction in pigs in a trait- and timepoint-dependent manner
papers.abstract: Background Accurate prediction of phenotypes is essential for assessing the actual productive performance of individual pigs, particularly for traits that are costly or difficult to measure directly. This study investigated the potential of integrating individual-level blood serum metabolite profiles sampled at two developmental stages (10-week and 20-week) into phenotype prediction models for five economically important traits: average daily feed intake (DFI), feed conversion ratio (FCR), backfat thickness (BF), test daily gain (TDG), and loin depth (LD). Using a BayesC modeling framework, we analyzed 1,637 pigs from a single purebred population with complete phenotype, genotype, and metabolite-profile data. We evaluated seven models, including a genotype-only model (G), metabolite-only models using metabolite-profile data from 10-week (M1), 20-week (M2), or both timepoints (M1+M2), and combined models integrating genotypes with metabolite-profile data (G+M1, G+M2, G+M1+M2). Results Heritability estimates were generally low to moderate, ranging from 0.08 to 0.23 for the 10-week metabolite profiles and from 0.07 to 0.26 for the 20-week metabolite profiles. Prediction accuracy of phenotypes consistently improved when metabolite-profile data were integrated into prediction models, although the magnitude of improvement varied depending on the trait and the timepoint of metabolite sampling. Prediction accuracy increased from 0.33 (G) to 0.42 (G+M2; G+M1+M2) for DFI, and from 0.27 (G) to 0.32 (G+M2; G+M1+M2) for FCR. The latter two models also delivered the largest gains over G for BF (from 0.39 to 0.46) and TDG (from 0.30 to 0.32). However, LD benefited the most when both 10-week and 20-week metabolite profiles were combined (G+M1+M2: 0.44 compared to G: 0.42). Conclusions Across all traits, models combining genotype data with metabolite profiles from one or multiple timepoints achieved the highest or equally high phenotype prediction accuracies compared to the genotype-only model, reflecting complementary biological insights captured by metabolite profiles. These findings highlight the potential value of metabolite-profile data as an intermediate omics layer to enhance phenotypic prediction, particularly when integration strategies are tailored to trait-specific biology and sampling timepoints.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：準確預測表型對於評估個別豬隻的實際生產性能至關重要，特別是用於那些成本高昂或難以直接測量的性狀。本研究探討了將兩個發育階段（10週齡與20週齡）採樣之個體血清代謝物譜整合至表型預測模型的潛力，研究對象涵蓋五個具經濟重要性的性狀：平均日採食量（DFI）、飼料換肉率（FCR）、背脂厚度（BF）、檢定日增重（TDG）以及背肌深度（LD）。本研究採用 BayesC 模型框架，分析了來自單一純種族群、具備完整表型、基因型及代謝物譜數據的 1,637 頭豬隻。我們評估了七種模型，包含僅使用基因型的模型（G）、僅使用 10 週齡（M1）、20 週齡（M2）或兩個時間點（M1+M2）代謝物譜數據的模型，以及整合基因型與代謝物譜數據的綜合模型（G+M1、G+M2、G+M1+M2）。結果：遺傳力估計值普遍偏低至中等，10 週齡代謝物譜的遺傳力介於 0.08 至 0.23 之間，20 週齡代謝物譜則介於 0.07 至 0.26 之間。當代謝物譜數據被整合至預測模型中時，表型預測準確度皆呈現一致的提升，儘管提升的幅度會因性狀及代謝物採樣的時間點而異。對於 DFI，預測準確度從 0.33（G）提升至 0.42（G+M2；G+M1+M2）；對於 FCR，則從 0.27（G）提升至 0.32（G+M2；G+M1+M2）。後兩者模型在 BF（從 0.39 提升至 0.46）和 TDG（從 0.30 提升至 0.32）上，也取得了相較於 G 模型最大的增幅。然而，LD 在結合 10 週齡與 20 週齡代謝物譜時獲益最大（G+M1+M2：0.44，相較於 G：0.42）。結論：在所有性狀中，結合基因型數據與一個或多個時間點代謝物譜的模型，相較於僅使用基因型的模型，皆達到了最高或同等高的表型預測準確度，這反映出代謝物譜所捕捉到的互補性生物學見解。這些發現突顯了代謝物譜數據作為中間體學（omics）層次以增強表型預測的潛在價值，特別是在整合策略針對性狀特異性生物學特性與採樣時間點進行調整時。

papers.title: Multi-omics reveals that dietary Piper sarmentosum Roxb. extract improves goat meat quality via the microbiota–muscle amino acid metabolic axis
papers.abstract: Background Improving meat quality through nutritional regulation is an important approach in ruminant production. Growing evidence suggests that rumen microbiota influences host metabolism via microbial metabolites, thereby affecting meat quality. However, whether Piper sarmentosum Roxb. extract (PSE), a medicinal and edible plant-derived extract, improves meat quality through rumen microbiota–host metabolic interactions remains unclear. Thirty-six weaned male Hainan black goats (approximately 3 months old) were randomly assigned to four dietary treatments supplemented with 0, 200, 400, or 600 mg/kg PSE (dry matter basis), respectively. After a 90-day feeding trial, goats were fasted for 12 h before slaughter, and rumen and longissimus lumborum muscle samples were collected for subsequent analyses. Results Supplementation with 600 mg/kg PSE significantly enhanced meat quality traits, including higher ultimate pH, improved color stability, and increased water-holding capacity, without affecting growth performance or carcass traits. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses revealed that PSE supplementation was associated with remodeling of amino acid and energy metabolism in muscle, particularly glutamate-related pathways. These metabolic changes were accompanied by increased expression of key metabolic genes, including BCAT2 , IDH1 , and IDH3A , alongside alterations in energy-related metabolites, such as the downregulation of carnitine and upregulation of creatinine. Concomitant shifts in rumen microbial composition were observed, with PSE supplementation increasing the abundance of genera like Weissella and Ruminococcus , while reducing potentially opportunistic genera, such as Acinetobacter and Klebsiella . Weissella showed strong positive correlations with elevated rumen metabolites like serine, threonine, choline, and hypoxanthine. Metagenome-assembled genome analysis of Weissella cibaria revealed an enrichment of genes related to amino acid metabolism and glycosyltransferase families. Correlation and mediation analyses further revealed associations among Weissella abundance, rumen metabolites, and muscle metabolic traits, supporting a potential microbiota–metabolite–host metabolic relationship. Conclusions Collectively, this study provides new insights into the association network linking PSE-induced alterations in rumen microbiota, microbial metabolites, and host muscle metabolism in relation to goat meat quality. These findings suggest that PSE supplementation may improve meat quality through coordinated changes in rumen microbial ecology and muscle metabolic profiles.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 透過營養調控來改善肉品品質是反芻動物生產中的重要方法。越來越多的證據表明，瘤胃微生物群透過微生物代謝物影響宿主代謝，進而影響肉品品質。然而，賈苔（Piper sarmentosum Roxb.）萃取物（PSE）這種兼具藥用與食用的植物源萃取物，是否能透過「瘤胃微生物群—宿主代謝」的交互作用來改善肉品品質，目前仍不清楚。本研究將 36 隻離乳海南黑山羊公羊（約 3 月齡）隨機分為四個日糧處理組，分別補充 0、200、400 或 600 mg/kg 的 PSE（以乾物質基礎計）。經過 90 天的飼養試驗後，山羊在屠宰前禁食 12 小時，並採集瘤胃及背最長肌樣本以進行後續分析。結果 補充 600 mg/kg 的 PSE 顯著提升了肉品品質特徵，包括較高的最終 pH 值、改善的色澤穩定性以及增加的保水力，且不影響生長性能或屠體性狀。轉錄體學與代謝體學分析顯示，PSE 補充與肌肉中胺基酸及能量代謝（特別是麩胺酸相關途徑）的重塑有關。這些代謝變化伴隨著關鍵代謝基因（包括 BCAT2、IDH1 及 IDH3A）表現量的增加，以及能量相關代謝物（如肉鹼的下調和肌酸酐的上調）的改變。同時觀察到瘤胃微生物組成的轉變，PSE 補充增加了魏斯氏菌屬（Weissella）和瘤胃球菌屬（Ruminococcus）等屬的豐度，同時減少了諸如不動桿菌屬（Acinetobacter）和克雷伯氏菌屬（Klebsiella）等潛在伺機性致病菌屬。魏斯氏菌屬與升高的瘤胃代謝物（如絲胺酸、蘇胺酸、膽鹼和次黃嘌呤）呈現強烈的正相關。對西氏魏斯氏菌（Weissella cibaria）進行的巨基因體組裝基因組（MAG）分析顯示，其胺基酸代謝及醣基轉移酶家族相關基因富集。相關性與中介分析進一步揭示了魏斯氏菌屬豐度、瘤胃代謝物與肌肉代謝特徵之間的關聯，支持了潛在的「微生物群—代謝物—宿主代謝」關係。結論 總體而言，本研究為連結 PSE 引起的瘤胃微生物群、微生物代謝物變化，以及與山羊肉品品質相關的宿主肌肉代謝之間的關聯網絡提供了新的見解。這些發現表明，補充 PSE 可能透過協調瘤胃微生物生態與肌肉代謝特徵的改變來改善肉品品質。

papers.title: Study on the Effects of Dandelion Ultrafine Powder on the Production Performance and Intestinal Microbiota of Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with dandelion superfine powder (DSFP) on the growth performance, organ indices, intestinal length, antioxidant parameters, cecal microbiota and economic benefits of broilers, so as to determine its optimal dosage. A total of 240 one-day-old ROSS broilers were randomly allocated into four groups fed basal diets supplemented with 0%, 0.5%, 1% and 3% DSFP, respectively. The results showed that medium-dose (1%) DSFP significantly increased the overall ADG and average daily feed intake, elevated duodenal length, and improved serum GSH-Px activity of broilers. Microbiological analysis revealed that 1% DSFP was associated with changes in the cecal microbiota structure and tended to increase the relative abundance of Firmicutes and potential short-chain fatty acid-producing bacteria. Economically, the medium-dose group achieved the highest gross profit per broiler. In conclusion, dietary supplementation with 1% DSFP can effectively improve growth performance and was associated with favorable changes in certain intestinal microbial indicators, leading to superior economic benefits, and it represents the appropriate dosage for broiler production.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討飼糧中添加蒲公英超微粉（DSFP）對肉雞生長性能、臟器指數、腸道長度、抗氧化指標、盲腸微生物菌群及經濟效益的影響，以確定其最適添加劑量。試驗選取240隻一日齡ROSS肉雞，隨機分為4組，分別飼喂添加0%、0.5%、1%和3% DSFP的基礎飼糧。結果顯示，中劑量（1%）DSFP顯著提高了肉雞的全期平均日增重和平均日採食量，增加了十二指腸長度，並改善了血清GSH-Px活性。微生物分析顯示，1% DSFP組的盲腸微生物菌群結構發生改變，並有增加厚壁菌門及潛在短鏈脂肪酸產生菌相對豐度的趨勢。在經濟效益方面，中劑量組獲得了每隻肉雞最高的毛利。綜上所述，飼糧中添加1% DSFP能有效改善生長性能，並與某些腸道微生物指標的良好改變相關，從而帶來更佳的經濟效益，是肉雞生產中的適宜添加劑量。

papers.title: An Enhanced Genomic Transformer for Multi-Dataset Forward-Validation Benchmarking in Pig Genomic Prediction
papers.abstract: Genomic prediction models in pig breeding should forecast the performance of future selection candidates, yet random cross-validation does not accurately reflect this sequential setting. Here, we introduce an enhanced genomic transformer (EGT) that compresses genome-wide SNP profiles into compact tokens and incorporates a differentiable scoring term alongside mean squared error (MSE) during training. We constructed 70%/10%/20% forward-validation datasets for three pig datasets and evaluated single-trait and multi-task EGT variants against GBLUP, support-vector regression, random forest, XGBoost, CNN, and RNN across 12 prediction tasks. The better-performing EGT variant achieved a higher test-set Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) than the baseline for 10 of the 12 prediction tasks, with the largest improvement on LDL-C (+0.057). In BloodLipid ablations, autoencoder-only representation yielded the highest mean PCC (0.285), while Pearson–MSE objective reached 0.293 versus 0.291 for MSE-only training. Integrated-gradient analysis revealed a recurrent candidate region on Sus scrofa chromosome 13 across three lipid traits, and masking the top-attributed features reduced predictive performance more than a marker-count-matched random control for HDL-C, LDL-C and TG, whereas masking increased test-set PCC for TCHOL. This work establishes forward-validation benchmarks across three pig datasets and reports results to inform model selection and region prioritization in pig breeding.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬隻育種中的基因體預測模型應預測未來選拔候選者的性能，然而隨機交叉驗證並無法準確反映這種序列設定。在此，我們引入了一種增強型基因體變壓器（enhanced genomic transformer, EGT），它將全基因體 SNP 特徵壓縮成緊湊的符號（tokens），並在訓練過程中結合了可微分的評分項與均方誤差（MSE）。我們針對三個豬隻資料集構建了 70%/10%/20% 的前向驗證資料集，並在 12 項預測任務中評估了單特質與多任務 EGT 變體與 GBLUP、支援向量迴歸、隨機森林、XGBoost、CNN 和 RNN 的表現。表現較佳的 EGT 變體在 12 項預測任務中的 10 項上，其測試集皮爾森相關係數（PCC）高於基準模型，其中以 LDL-C 的改善幅度最大（+0.057）。在 BloodLipid 消融實驗中，僅使用自動編碼器的表示法產生了最高的平均 PCC（0.285），而皮爾森-MSE 目標函數達到了 0.293，相較之下僅使用 MSE 訓練則為 0.291。整合梯度（integrated-gradient）分析揭示了在三個血脂特質中，位於豬隻第 13 號染色體（Sus scrofa chromosome 13）上的一個重複出現的候選區域；對於 HDL-C、LDL-C 和 TG 而言，遮蔽歸因評分最高的特徵比隨機控制（標記數量匹配）更能降低預測效能，而遮蔽則提高了 TCHOL 的測試集 PCC。這項工作建立了跨三個豬隻資料集的前向驗證基準，並報告相關結果以提供豬隻育種中的模型選擇與區域優先排序之參考。

papers.title: Estimation of Genomic Breeding Values for Economic Traits in Alxa-Type Cashmere Goats Using Bayesian Methods
papers.abstract: Conventional breeding has a long generation interval; genomic selection can enable early selection and shorten the breeding process in cashmere goats. This study aimed to estimate genomic breeding values for economic traits in Inner Mongolia (Alxa-type) cashmere goats using Bayesian methods. Whole-genome resequencing at 1× depth was performed on 491 Alxa-type cashmere goats (40 males and 451 females), and genotypes were imputed to 10× using a reference panel with an average imputation accuracy of 97.90%. Fixed effects were determined by analysis of variance, and breeding values for body weight, cashmere fiber diameter, and cashmere yield were estimated using Bayes A, Bayes B, and Bayes C; prediction accuracy and unbiasedness were evaluated by five-fold cross-validation. Measurement year and group affected all three traits highly significantly (p < 0.01); sex affected body weight and cashmere yield highly significantly (p < 0.01) but no significant effect on cashmere fiber diameter (p > 0.05); and maternal age had a significant effect on body weight (p < 0.05), but no significant effect on cashmere fiber diameter or cashmere yield (p > 0.05); group had a highly significant effect on all three traits (p < 0.01). Breeding values were estimated using Bayes A, Bayes B, and Bayes C, with five-fold cross-validation, and the three methods performed comparably overall in this population.
papers.abstract_zh: 傳統育種的世代間隔較長，而基因體選擇能實現早期選擇，並縮短喀什米爾羊的育種進程。本研究旨在利用貝氏方法評估內蒙古（阿拉善型）喀什米爾羊經濟性狀的基因體育種值。本研究對491隻阿拉善型喀什米爾羊（40隻公羊和451隻母羊）進行1倍深度的高通量全基因組定序，並利用參考群體將基因型填充至10倍深度，平均填充準確度達97.90%。透過變異數分析確定固定效應，並使用Bayes A、Bayes B和Bayes C方法評估體重、喀什米爾絨纖維直徑和產絨量的育種值；透過五折交叉驗證評估預測準確度與無偏性。測定期與群體對這三個性狀均有極顯著影響（p < 0.01）；性別對體重與產絨量有極顯著影響（p < 0.01），但對喀什米爾絨纖維直徑無顯著影響（p > 0.05）；母齡對體重有顯著影響（p < 0.05），但對喀什米爾絨纖維直徑與產絨量無顯著影響（p > 0.05）；群體對這三個性狀皆有極顯著影響（p < 0.01）。使用Bayes A、Bayes B和Bayes C方法進行育種值估計並結合五折交叉驗證，結果顯示這三種方法在此群體中的整體表現相當。

papers.title: First Isolation, Genomic Characterization and Experimental Infection of Bovine Coronavirus from Sheep
papers.abstract: Bovine coronavirus (BCoV) is an important pathogen of cattle and has also been detected in several non-bovine ruminants. Although BCoV infection has been reported in sheep, virus isolation and genomic characterization from this host have not been described. In this study, two BCoV isolates were successfully recovered from fecal samples of sheep during an outbreak involving enteric and respiratory signs in Qinghai Province, China. Nearly complete genomes of the two isolates were obtained and were 100% identical to each other across the complete coding regions. Comparative genomic analysis showed that the complete coding regions of the sheep-derived isolates shared 100% nucleotide identity with a previously reported yak-derived BCoV strain, Yak/SWUN/NF2/2022 (OR603986). Phylogenetic analyses based on complete coding regions, S gene, and HE gene sequences showed that the sheep-derived isolates clustered with yak-derived BCoV strains previously identified in Qinghai Province, suggesting that closely related BCoV lineages may circulate among different ruminant hosts in the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. Experimental infection provided evidence that the representative sheep-derived isolate was capable of establishing infection in sheep, as evidenced by viral RNA detection, seroconversion, and virus re-isolation from lung tissue. To our knowledge, this study represents the first successful isolation and genomic characterization of BCoV from sheep and provides new insights into the host range, genetic diversity, and potential distribution of closely related BCoV lineages among high-altitude ruminants.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛冠狀病毒（BCoV）是牛隻的重要病原體，亦曾在數種非牛類反芻動物中被檢測出。儘管綿羊感染 BCoV 的案例曾被報導，但尚未有來自該宿主的病毒分離與基因體特徵描述之相關記錄。在本研究中，中國青海省發生一起涉及腸道與呼吸道症狀的疫情期間，自綿羊糞便樣本中成功分離出兩株 BCoV。研究獲得了這兩株分離株的近完整基因體，其完整編碼區彼此具有 100% 的相同性。比較基因體學分析顯示，綿羊源分離株的完整編碼區與先前報導的一株氂牛源 BCoV 毒株 Yak/SWUN/NF2/2022（OR603986）具有 100% 的核苷酸相同性。基於完整編碼區、S 基因與 HE 基因序列的親緣關係分析顯示，綿羊源分離株與先前在青海省鑑定出的氂牛源 BCoV 毒株聚類在一起，這暗示了高度相關的 BCoV 譜系可能在青海高原的不同反芻動物宿主間循環傳播。動物實驗感染提供了證據，表明具代表性的綿羊源分離株能夠在綿羊體內建立感染，這可由病毒 RNA 檢測、血清轉換以及從肺組織中重新分離出病毒獲得證明。據我們所知，本研究代表了首次成功自綿羊中分離出 BCoV 並進行基因體特徵分析，為高海拔反芻動物中高度相關 BCoV 譜系的宿主範圍、基因多樣性及潛在分布提供了新的見解。

papers.title: Metabolic Signatures of Refrigerated Storage Linked to Quality Deterioration in Thai Native Chicken Meat: An Integrated 1H NMR-Based Metabolomics and Meat Quality Assessment
papers.abstract: Refrigeration is essential for preserving meat quality; however, understanding the biochemical mechanisms underlying deterioration during storage is crucial for extending its shelf life. This study examines the impact of refrigerated storage on the quality, metabolite profiles, and microbiological characteristics of Thai native chicken meat using physicochemical analysis and 600 MHz 1H NMR-based metabolomics. The samples were individually wrapped and stored at 4 °C and analyzed on days 1, 3, 5, 7, and 10 to evaluate pH, drip loss, cooking loss, microbial characteristics, texture, and metabolic profiles. Physicochemical assessments showed that pH and drip loss increased significantly over time, whereas color, texture profile, chemical composition, and lipid oxidation remained relatively stable. Coliform counts remained stable through day 7 before peaking on day 10. Metabolomic profiling identified 26 metabolites, primarily associated with amino acids, nucleotides, bioactive compounds, organic acids, and sugars. Chemometric analyses, including principal component analysis (PCA) and orthogonal partial least squares discriminant analysis (OPLS-DA), demonstrated continuing metabolic changes, distinctly separating day 10 samples from earlier time points. Furthermore, glutamine and N-methylhydantoin were identified as potential storage-related biomarkers. These findings indicate that day 10 represents an advanced storage phase, demonstrating the usefulness of metabolomics in evaluating freshness and elucidating shelf-life dynamics in chicken meat.
papers.abstract_zh: 冷藏對於保持肉品品質至關重要；然而，理解儲存過程中劣變背後的生化機制對於延長其保存期限至關重要。本研究利用理化分析與 600 MHz $^1\text{H}$ 核磁共振（NMR）代謝體學，探討冷藏儲存對泰國土雞肉的品質、代謝物分佈及微生物特性的影響。樣品經個別包裝後儲存於 4 °C，並於第 1、3、5、7 和 10 天進行分析，以評估 pH 值、滴水損失、蒸煮損失、微生物特性、質地與代謝分佈。理化評估顯示，pH 值和滴水損失隨時間顯著增加，而顏色、質地分佈、化學成分和脂質氧化則保持相對穩定。大腸桿菌群數量在第 7 天前保持穩定，隨後在第 10 天達到峰值。代謝體學分佈鑑定了 26 種代謝物，主要與胺基酸、核苷酸、生物活性化合物、有機酸和糖類有關。化學計量學分析，包括主成分分析（PCA）與正交偏最小二乘法判別分析（OPLS-DA），展現了持續的代謝變化，將第 10 天的樣品與早期時間點明確區分開來。此外，麩醯胺酸（glutamine）和 $N$-甲基海因（$N$-methylhydantoin）被識別為潛在的儲存相關生物標記。這些發現表明，第 10 天代表了進階的儲存階段，證明瞭代謝體學在評估雞肉新鮮度和闡明保存期限動態方面的效用。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics and Trend Analysis of African Swine Fever Virus in Romanian Wild Boar Populations (2018–2024)
papers.abstract: Background: African Swine Fever (ASF) remains a critical threat to the swine industry globally, with wild boars (Sus scrofa) acting as a major wildlife reservoir. Romania has been one of the most severely affected European countries since the virus’s introduction. Objectives: This study aims to estimate the long-term spatiotemporal trends, environmental persistence, and transmission dynamics of ASF virus (ASFV) in the Romanian wild boar population based on a finalized dataset of 1443 confirmed cases distributed across an 80-month timeline (May 2018–December 2024). Methods: Advanced epidemiological workflows integrating spatial and temporal modeling frameworks were developed. Spatiotemporal cluster detection was performed using SatScan to identify significant disease hotspots. Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) were utilized to model non-linear seasonal trends and spatial patterns of carcass persistence. Furthermore, the time-varying reproduction number (Rt) was calculated using a Bayesian renewal framework via the EpiEstim package, parameterized with a wild boar serial distribution (mean = 10.3 days; SD = 4.2 days). Results: SatScan identified one most primary cluster in Dobrogea and five other major recurrent hot spots in Muntenia, Transylvania, and Moldova. The GAM analysis revealed a strong, statistically significant seasonal pattern, with case detection from carcasses peaking markedly during the winter months when low temperatures favor environmental virus stability. The Bayesian Rt reconstruction disclosed three distinct epidemiological phases: a sharp initial invasion peak at a mean Rt of 2.38 (95% Crl: 1.82–3.02), followed by regional wave-like oscillations, and a distinct long-term stabilization in the late endemic phase, hovering dynamically around a stationary mean of 1.01 (95% Crl: 0.87–1.16). Conclusions: Our findings statistically validate the shift from an acute epidemic wave to a self-sustaining, chronic endemic equilibrium within the natural habitat, driven by constant carcass-mediated environmental re-seeding. These insights underscore that successful disease mitigation must prioritize the rapid, targeted removal of infected carcasses in high-risk forest matrices rather than generic population reduction strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：非洲豬瘟（African Swine Fever, ASF）對全球養豬產業構成重大威脅，其中野豬（Sus scrofa）扮演主要的野生動物保毒宿主。自病毒引入以來，羅馬尼亞一直是受歐洲影響最嚴重的國家之一。目的：本研究旨在基於涵蓋 80 個月時間軸（2018 年 5 月至 2024 年 12 月）共 1,443 例確診病例的完整資料集，評估羅馬尼亞野豬族群中非洲豬瘟病毒（ASFV）的長期時空趨勢、環境持久性及傳播動態。方法：本研究開發了整合空間與時間建模框架的先進流行病學工作流程。使用 SatScan 進行時空群聚偵測，以識別顯著的疾病熱點。利用廣義加法模型（Generalized Additive Models, GAMs）對屍體持久性的非線性季節性趨勢與空間模式進行建模。此外，透過 EpiEstim 套件並使用貝氏更新框架計算時變再生數（Rt），其參數設定根據野豬的序列間隔分佈（平均值 = 10.3 天；標準差 = 4.2 天）。結果：SatScan 在多布羅加（Dobrogea）識別出一個主要核心群聚，並在蒙特尼亞（Muntenia）、特蘭 silvestris（Transylvania，註：維持原專有名詞 Transylvania 譯為特蘭西瓦尼亞）及摩爾達維亞（Moldova）識別出另外五個主要的覆發性熱點。GAM 分析顯示出強烈且具統計顯著性的季節性模式，在低溫有利於病毒在環境中穩定存活的冬季月份，從屍體中檢測到的病例數顯著達到高峰。貝氏 Rt 重建揭示了三個不同的流行病學階段：平均 Rt 為 2.38（95% 信賴區間：1.82–3.02）的急劇初始入侵高峰、隨後的區域性波浪狀振盪，以及在地方性流行後期明顯的長期穩定狀態，動態徘徊在 1.01 的平穩平均值附近（95% 信賴區間：0.87–1.16）。結論：我們的研究結果從統計學上證實了在由屍體介導的持續環境重複散播驅動下，自然棲息地內的疫情已從急性流行波轉變為自我維持的慢性地方性平衡。這些見解強調，成功的疾病緩解策略必須優先針對高風險森林基質中的受感染屍體進行快速、標靶式的移除，而非採取通用的族群減少策略。

papers.title: Beyond the Transcriptome: The m 6 A Epitranscriptome in Bovine Mastitis
papers.abstract: Bovine mastitis is a heterogeneous inflammatory disease that compromises milk production, animal welfare and dairy sustainability. Despite extensive transcriptomic and epigenomic research, a PubMed search completed in September 2026 identified only 12 primary studies addressing epitranscriptomic regulation in bovine mastitis, representing approximately 0.1% of indexed publications. This review critically evaluates N 6 ‐methyladenosine (m 6 A), the most extensively studied RNA modification in bovine mastitis, its regulatory machinery and effects on mammary immunity, while identifying m 5 C and A‐to‐I editing as priorities for mechanistic investigation. Current evidence identifies transcript‐specific RNA stability as the best‐supported mechanism and provides a foundation for investigating m 6 A‐dependent translation. Functional studies of ALKBH5– LOC4191 , YTHDF2– IER3 , YTHDF2‐associated CCL20 and CCL5 regulation, m 6 A‐regulated LncRNA7825 and FTO– FN1 demonstrate that m 6 A reshapes inflammatory signalling, mitochondrial stress, epithelial‐barrier integrity, cell survival and bacterial control. Synthesizing these findings, we propose a context‐dependent RNA‐fate checkpoint model in which biological effects depend on the modified transcript, effector protein, pathogen, cellular context and infection phase. The FTO– FN1 axis shows that bacterial control and tissue protection can diverge, establishing them as complementary outcomes. Future studies should test whether m 6 A provides an early post‐transcriptional response layer and whether pathogens manipulate it, using time‐resolved multi‐omics, nucleotide‐specific perturbation, primary cells, mammary organoids and longitudinal cattle samples. Parallel profiling of non‐m 6 A modifications should define interacting regulatory layers. These approaches should establish causal modification sites, resolve pathogen‐specific regulation, connect molecular mechanisms with disease trajectories, and support validated milk‐based biomarkers, mammary‐targeted interventions and prioritization of stable genetic variants for breeding mastitis‐resistant cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛乳房炎是一種異質性發炎疾病，會危害產乳量、動物福祉及乳業永續性。儘管已有廣泛的轉錄體學與表觀基因體學研究，截至 2026 年 9 月完成的 PubMed 檢索顯示，僅有 12 項探討牛乳房炎表觀轉錄體調控的原創研究，約佔索引文獻的 0.1%。本篇綜論批判性地評估了 $N^6$-甲基腺苷（$m^6A$）——牛乳房炎中研究最廣泛的 RNA 修飾、其調控機制及對乳房免疫的影響，同時將 $m^5C$ 及 A-to-I 編輯界定為機制研究的優先方向。現有證據顯示，轉錄本特異性 RNA 穩定性是獲得最多支持的機制，並為探討 $m^6A$ 依賴性轉譯奠定了基礎。ALKBH5–LOC4191、YTHDF2–IER3、YTHDF2 相關的 CCL20 與 CCL5 調控、$m^6A$ 調控的 LncRNA7825 以及 FTO–FN1 的功能研究表明，$m^6A$ 會重塑發炎訊息傳遞、粒線體壓力、上皮屏障完整性、細胞存活與細菌控制。綜合這些發現，我們提出了「情境依賴的 RNA 命運檢查點模型」，在此模型中，生物學效應取決於受修飾的轉錄本、效應蛋白、病原體、細胞情境及感染階段。FTO–FN1 軸顯示細菌控制與組織保護可能會分歧，確立了它們作為互補結果的地位。未來研究應利用時間解析多體學、核苷酸特異性擾動、原代細胞、乳房類器官及縱向牛隻樣本，來檢驗 $m^6A$ 是否提供早期的轉錄後反應層級，以及病原體是否对其进行操控。非 $m^6A$ 修飾的平行分析應能界定相互作用的調控層級。這些方法應當確立具因果關係的修飾位點、解析病原體特異性調控、將分子機制與疾病病程相連結，並支援經過驗證的乳汁生物標記、標靶乳房的介入措施，以及優先選育具抗乳房炎特性牛隻的穩定遺傳變異。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Detection of Genetic Diversity and Genomic Structure in Hanwoo Cows
papers.abstract: This study aimed to utilize genomic information to elucidate the genetic diversity and structure of Hanwoo cows and develop a more efficient improvement system. Genomic DNA was extracted from hair root samples of 7273 Hanwoo cows, and genotypes were determined using a customized Illumina Hanwoo SNP50k BeadChip. A total of 41,884 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) covering approximately 2500 Mb of the genome were selected for analysis, along with 7166 Hanwoo cows that passed quality control. The mean observed and expected heterozygosity were 0.358 ± 0.125 and 0.357 ± 0.124, respectively. A total of 94,560 runs of homozygosity (ROHs) were observed, with an average of 13.2 per animal. Linkage disequilibrium (LD) was estimated using two parameters, D’ and r2, which were found to be 0.381 ± 0.309 and 0.054 ± 0.126, respectively, on autosomes. LD declined sharply from< 50 kb to 50–100 kb. In addition, 1818 haplotype blocks were identified on autosomes, totaling 88.27 Mb (3.53% of the autosomal length). The most common haplotype block size was two SNPs, with 1101 blocks. Finally, the effective population size (Ne) was 2853 at 1691 generations but decreased to 277 at 13 generations. These results provide genomic information for further studies and will be helpful for Hanwoo breeding programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用基因體資訊來闡明韓牛的遺傳多樣性與結構，並開發更有效率的品種改良系統。本研究從 7,273 頭韓牛的毛根樣本中萃取基因體 DNA，並使用客製化的 Illumina 韓牛 SNP50k BeadChip 進行基因型鑑定。經過品質控制後，最終選出涵蓋約 2500 Mb 基因體、共 41,884 個單核苷酸多型性（SNP）以及 7,166 頭韓牛進行分析。平均觀察到的與預期的雜合度分別為 0.358 ± 0.125 和 0.357 ± 0.124。共觀察到 94,560 個純合區段（ROH），每隻動物平均有 13.2 個。本研究使用 D’ 與 r2 兩項參數來評估連鎖不平衡（LD），在體染色體上其值分別為 0.381 ± 0.309 與 0.054 ± 0.126。連鎖不平衡從 < 50 kb 到 50–100 kb 呈現急遽下降。此外，在體染色體上共鑑定出 1,818 個單套型區塊（haplotype blocks），總計 88.27 Mb（佔體染色體長度的 3.53%）。最常見的單套型區塊大小為兩個 SNP，共有 1,101 個區塊。最後，有效族群大小（Ne）在 1,691 個世代前為 2,853，但在 13 個世代前降至 277。這些結果為進一步的研究提供了基因體資訊，並將有助於韓牛的育種計畫。

papers.title: Genomic characterisation and lytic potential of phage SF01 against multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica , a key agent of infection in poultry
papers.abstract: 1. Salmonella enterica remains the key cause of salmonellosis in poultry, causing high morbidity and mortality. Due to the unprecedented resistance of S. enterica to antibiotics, bacteriophages have emerged as a powerful alternative to conventional antibiotics treatment for salmonellosis.2. In this study, a strain was isolated from infected broiler chickens and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) identified the strain SFD-01 as S. enterica subsp. enterica. Bioinformatics analyses revealed that the genome was 4.6 Mb in size with 4559 coding sequences (CDS), 77 tRNAs and 4 rRNAs. Additionally, 119 virulence genes, 125 antimicrobial resistance genes, 5 mobile genetic elements, 2 prophages and multiple copies of pathogenicity islands (SPI) were identified in the genome.3. To address this, bacteriophage SF01 was isolated from wastewater near a chicken slaughterhouse against host strain SFD-01. Transmission electron microscopy revealed that the phage had an 85-nm icosahedral head and a 130-nm long contractile tail. The Felixounavirus SF01 exhibited high stability across pH 3–9. Phage lytic activity at a multiplicity of infection of 0.01 restricted the bacterial growth.4. Whole genome analysis (WGS) identified phage SF01 as a Felixounavirus with 88-kb genome composed of 174 CDS, 20 tRNA genes and with no lysogenic markers, resistance genes or virulence factors. The strict lytic potential of phage SF01 makes it a highly viable option for use in the potential biocontrol of the novel strain S. enterica subsp. enterica serotype 42:z4,z23.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 腸道沙門氏菌（Salmonella enterica）仍然之家禽沙門氏菌症的主要病因，會造成高罹病率與高死亡率。由於腸道沙門氏菌對抗生素產生前所未有的抗藥性，噬菌體已成為替代傳統抗生素治療沙門氏菌症的有力選擇。

2. 在本研究中，從受感染的肉雞中分離出一株菌株，經全基因串接定序（WGS）鑑定該SFD-01菌株為腸道沙門氏菌腸道亞種（S. enterica subsp. enterica）。生物資訊學分析顯示，其基因體大小為 4.6 Mb，具有 4559 個編碼序列（CDS）、77 個 tRNA 及 4 個 rRNA。此外，在該基因體中鑑定出 119 個毒力基因、125 個抗生素抗藥性基因、5 個移動性遺傳元件、2 個前噬菌體以及多個致病島（SPI）複本。

3. 為了解決此問題，從雞隻屠宰場附近的廢水中分離出針對宿主菌株 SFD-01 的噬菌體 SF01。穿透式電子顯微鏡顯示，該噬菌體具有一個 85 奈米的二十面體頭部以及一個 130 奈米長的收縮性尾部。菲利克斯奧微病毒屬（Felixounavirus）的 SF01 在 pH 3–9 之間展現出高度穩定性。在感染多重性（MOI）為 0.01 時，噬菌體的裂解活性可抑制細菌生長。

4. 全基因體分析（WGS）鑑定噬菌體 SF01 為菲利克斯奧微病毒屬（Felixounavirus），其 88-kb 的基因體由 174 個 CDS、20 個 tRNA 基因所組成，且不具溶原性標記、抗藥性基因或毒力因子。噬菌體 SF01 嚴格的裂解潛力，使其成為具備潛力應用於生物防治新型腸道沙門氏菌腸道亞種血清型 42:z4,z23 的高度可行選項。

papers.title: Dietary vitamin C improves reproductive performance by increasing antioxidant capacity, steroid hormone concentration and expression of genes involved in steroid hormone synthesis in Yangzhou geese
papers.abstract: 1. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of dietary ascorbic acid (vitamin C) supplementation on the reproductive performance, follicular development, antioxidant capacity, serum steroid hormone concentration and expression of genes involved in steroid hormone synthesis in Yangzhou geese.2. A total of 540, 221-day-old geese (450 females and 90 males) were randomly divided into five groups that received different diets. Treatments included vitamin C levels of 0, 100, 200, 300 or 400 mg/kg, respectively.3. Dietary vitamin C supplementation led to a highly significant linear increase in laying rate (p < 0.01), with significant improvements detected at 300 mg/kg and 400 mg/kg (p < 0.01). Thus, within the supplement range of 0–400 mg/kg, graded additions of vitamin C linearly improved reproductive performance with economic benefits. In consideration of commercial breeding practices together with the observed physiological and productive indices, dietary vitamin C supplementation at 300 mg/kg was effective.4. Feeding 300 mg/kg prompted oestradiol and progesterone concentrations in both serum and hierarchical follicular yolks (p < 0.05) and the number of primordial follicles increased significantly (p < 0.01). This level of vitamin C in the feed resulted in elevated activity levels of total antioxidant capacity, superoxide dismutase and catalase in both serum and follicles, along with a reduction in malondialdehyde levels.5. Dietary supplementation with 300 mg/kg vitamin C increased the expressions of StAR, HSD3B1 and CYP11A1 in granulosa layer. Similar expression patterns of CYP17A1, CYP19A1, HSD3B1 and HSD17B1 were detected in the theca layer.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究旨在評估日糧中補充抗壞血酸（維生素C）對揚州鵝繁殖性能、卵泡發育、抗氧化能力、血清類固醇激素濃度及類固醇激素合成相關基因表現之影響。
2. 試驗選取 540 隻 221 日齡之揚州鵝（公鵝 90 隻、母鵝 450 隻），隨機分為五組並飼喂不同日糧。處理組之維生素C添加量分別為 0、100、200、300 及 400 mg/kg。
3. 日糧補充維生素C使產蛋率呈極顯著的線性增加（p < 0.01），且在添加 300 mg/kg 和 400 mg/kg 時檢測到顯著改善（p < 0.01）。因此，在 0–400 mg/kg 的補充範圍內，分級添加維生素C能以具經濟效益的方式線性改善繁殖性能。綜合商業育種實務以及觀察到的生理與生產指標，日糧補充 300 mg/kg 的維生素C效果最佳。
4. 飼喂 300 mg/kg 可促進血清及級別卵泡卵黃中的雌二醇與黃體素濃度（p < 0.05），且原始卵泡數量顯著增加（p < 0.01）。此飼料維生素C水平使血清及卵泡中的總抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶和過氧化氫酶活性水平升高，同時降低丙二醛水平。
5. 日糧補充 300 mg/kg 維生素C提高了顆粒層中 StAR、HSD3B1 和 CYP11A1 的表現量。在膜層中也檢測到 CYP17A1、CYP19A1、HSD3B1 和 HSD17B1 具有相似的表現模式。

papers.title: Serum Corticosterone Concentrations and Granulocyte-to-Lymphocyte Ratios in Slaughter Geese Across Transport-Distance Categories: An Exploratory Descriptive Field Study
papers.abstract: Transport exposes poultry to multiple stressors. The declining number of slaughterhouses in the European Union can increase transport distances to slaughter facilities. Transport-related stress responses are documented in chickens and ducks but remain poorly characterized in geese. This exploratory descriptive field study characterized serum corticosterone (CORT) concentrations and the granulocyte-to-lymphocyte (G/L) ratio in pooled blood samples representing 292 slaughter geese from six flocks: one non-transported flock slaughtered on a farm and five commercial flocks transported 1–100, 101–200, 201–300, 301–400, or >400 km. Exploratory pool-level comparisons indicated overall differences in G/L ratios among the five evaluable flocks (p = 0.035), but no pairwise difference remained significant after Bonferroni adjustment. Corticosterone was lower in pooled serum samples from the non-transported flock than in those from the 1–100, 201–300, and >400 km flocks (p < 0.001). However, one flock and one journey per distance category prevented separation of distance effects from flock-, farm-, age- or journey-specific influences. These observations provide important descriptive field data but do not permit conclusions about an independent effect of transport distance. Studies with multiple independent flocks and journeys per distance category are required.
papers.abstract_zh: 運輸會使家禽面臨多種壓力源。歐盟屠宰場數量的減少可能會增加前往屠宰設施的運輸距離。與運輸相關的壓力反應在雞和鴨身上已有記錄，但在鵝身上則尚未得到充分的描述。這項探索性描述性現場研究描述了代表來自六個鵝群共 292 隻屠宰鵝之混合血液樣本中的血清皮質酮（CORT）濃度與嗜顆粒球與淋巴細胞比值（G/L 比值）：一個在農場屠宰的未運輸鵝群，以及五個分別運輸 1–100、101–200、201–300、301–400 或 >400 公里的商業鵝群。探索性的混合樣本層級比較顯示，五個可評估鵝群之間的 G/L 比值存在整體差異（p = 0.035），但在進行邦ferroni（Bonferroni）校正後，沒有任何成對差異達到顯著水準。未運輸鵝群混合血清樣本中的皮質酮低於 1–100、201–300 和 >400 公里鵝群的樣本（p < 0.001）。然而，每個距離類別僅有一個鵝群和一次運輸，使我們無法將距離效應與鵝群、農場、年齡或運輸特異性影響區分開來。這些觀察結果提供了重要的描述性現場數據，但無法得出關於運輸距離之獨立效應的結論。未來需要針對每個距離類別納入多個獨立鵝群和運輸次數的研究。

papers.title: Characterizing Runs of Homozygosity and Inbreeding in American Mink Using SNP Data and Pedigree Information
papers.abstract: Inbreeding increases the likelihood of deleterious recessive alleles becoming homozygous and consequently affecting economically important traits. Runs of homozygosity (ROH), the continuous homozygous segments of the genome and the higher than expected homozygosity (HOM) are genomic indicators of inbreeding, quantified as F ROH and F HOM , respectively. Previous ROH analyses in American mink ( Neogale vison ) were restricted to scaffold‐level references and could not resolve long autozygous segments. In this study, we characterized ROH in 1413 mink genotyped with the Affymetrix Mink 70K panel (50,902 autosomal SNPs after quality control) on the chromosome‐level genome assembly and compared F ROH with F HOM and with pedigree‐based inbreeding (F PED ) derived from 24,633 pedigree records. ROH were detected in all individuals, with a mean of 149.61 ± 13.82 segments per individual. Segments longer than 8 Mb, not detectable in earlier studies of this population, represented 12.86% of all ROH and accounted for 0.10 of the mean F ROH of 0.28. Mean F HOM and F PED were −0.03 and 0.02, respectively. ROH were unevenly distributed across chromosomes and chromosomes 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 11 harboured 78.59% of all segments. The Pearson correlation coefficient was highest (0.72) between F ROH and F HOM and moderate (0.34) between genomic inbreeding and F PED , increasing with ROH length to 0.35 for segments longer than 16 Mb. Because the density of the marker panel limits the resolution of short segments, quantitative inference was restricted to ROH longer than 4 Mb. Our results indicate that recent autozygosity in this closed population is concentrated in a small number of long genomic segments, providing an opportunity to inform mating decisions.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 近親交配會增加有害隱性等立基因成為純合子的機率，進而影響具經濟重要性的性狀。純合連續片段（runs of homozygosity, ROH）是基因體中連續的純合片段，而高於預期的純合度（homozygosity, HOM）則是近親交配的基因體指標，分別以 $F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 來量化。先前對美洲水貂（*Neogale vison*）的 ROH 分析受限於鷹架層級（scaffold-level）的參考基因體，無法解析長型的同源接合（autozygous）片段。在本研究中，我們使用基於染色體層級基因體組裝的 Affymetrix 水貂 70K 晶片（經品質控制後包含 50,902 個體染色體 SNP），對 1,413 隻水貂的 ROH 進行了特性分析，並將 $F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 以及源自 24,633 筆譜系紀錄的譜系近親交配係數（$F_{PED}$）進行比較。所有個體均偵測到 ROH，平均每個個體有 $149.61 \pm 13.82$ 個片段。長於 8 Mb 的片段（在該族群先前的研究中無法被偵測）佔所有 ROH 的 $12.86\%$，並佔平均 $F_{ROH}$（0.28）中的 0.10。平均 $F_{HOM}$ 與 $F_{PED}$ 分別為 -0.03 與 0.02。ROH 在染色體上的分布不均，其中第 1、2、3、4、6 和 11 號染色體包含了所有片段的 $78.59\%$。$F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 之間的皮爾森相關係數最高（0.72），基因體近親交配與 $F_{PED}$ 之間則呈中等相關（0.34），且隨著 ROH 長度增加而上升，對於長於 16 Mb 的片段其相關係數可達 0.35。由於標記晶片的密度限制了短片段的解析度，因此數量推論僅限於長於 4 Mb 的 ROH。我們的結果顯示，這個封閉族群近期的同源接合現象集中於少數幾個長基因體片段中，這為指導交配決策提供了契機。

papers.title: Early-life microbial contact with adult hens modulates cecal microbiota and mitigates host responses to lipopolysaccharide-induced stress in broilers
papers.abstract: Background In commercial production, the absence of adult hens disrupts natural gut colonization, forcing chicks to rely on environmental microbes and potentially compromising the ecological succession essential for health. This study investigated whether early-life adult hen microbial contact could optimize the intestinal community and metabolite profiles, thereby mitigating lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced immunological stress in broilers. Accordingly, 128 one-day-old broilers were assigned to control or adult hen microbial contact groups. Hens were removed on D 10, and LPS was administered on D 18 and D 20, resulting in a 2 × 2 factorial design. Results Adult hen microbial contact did not affect body weight or ileal histomorphology on D 10 or D 21. However, it reshaped the alpha diversity ( P < 0.05) and beta diversity ( P < 0.05) of the cecal microbiota, enriching beneficial genera such as Bacteroides , Prevotellaceae , Rikenellaceae , Muribaculaceae , and Megasphaera , although these were not primarily established through direct adult hen transfer. These microbial alterations were accompanied by increased production of cecal volatile fatty acids ( P < 0.05) and altered tryptophan metabolism ( P < 0.05), characterized by the conversion of serum tryptophan to indoleacetic acid. In the ileum, the adult hen microbial contact upregulated ( P < 0.05) genes associated with mucosal barrier integrity ( MUC13 , CLDN2 ) and antioxidant defense ( SOD2 , FOXO1 ), while independently downregulating ( P < 0.05) hepatic genes involved in redox regulation and autophagy ( GRX5 , LC3-1 ). LPS challenge induced a pronounced ( P < 0.05) antioxidant imbalance in the ileum, characterized by the downregulation of CAT and NRF2 , together with elevated expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines ( IL8 , IFNA , TNFA ), compromising barrier function ( MUC13 , CLDN2 ). Concurrently, the LPS challenge increased ( P < 0.05) the expression of hepatic genes involved in redox regulation and autophagy ( GRX5 , LC3-1 ), consistent with a systemic stress response. Notably, microbial contact attenuated the LPS-induced reduction in valeric acid ( P < 0.05), suggesting a protective effect on microbial metabolite production under immunological stress. Conclusion Adult hen microbial contact did not improve growth performance or ileal histomorphology, but shaped the early-life gut microbiota and associated metabolite profiles, contributing to improved resilience to subsequent immune challenges in broilers.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：在商業化生產中，成年母雞的缺失會打亂自然的腸道定殖，迫使雛雞依賴環境微生物，進而可能危害對健康至關重要的生態演替。本研究旨在探討早期接觸成年母雞微生物是否能優化腸道菌相與代謝物譜，從而減輕脂多醣（LPS）誘導的肉雞免疫壓力。因此，將 128 隻一日齡肉雞分派至對照組或成年母雞微生物接觸組。母雞於第 10 天移出，並於第 18 天和第 20 天注射 LPS，形成 2 × 2 因子設計。結果：成年母雞微生物接觸對第 10 天或第 21 天的體重或迴腸組織形態無顯著影響。然而，它重塑了盲腸微生物相的阿伐多樣性（$\text{P} < 0.05$）與貝塔多樣性（$\text{P} < 0.05$），豐富了諸如擬桿菌屬（*Bacteroides*）、普雷沃菌科（*Prevotellaceae*）、理研菌科（*Rikenellaceae*）、毛螺菌科相關屬（*Muribaculaceae*）和巨球型菌屬（*Megasphaera*）等有益屬，儘管這些菌群主要並非透過成年母雞的直接轉移而建立。這些微生物的改變伴隨著盲腸揮發性脂肪酸產量的增加（$\text{P} < 0.05$）以及色胺酸代謝的改變（$\text{P} < 0.05$），其特徵為血清色胺酸轉化為吲哚乙酸。在迴腸中，成年母雞微生物接觸上調了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）與黏膜屏障完整性（*MUC13*、*CLDN2*）和抗氧化防禦（*SOD2*、*FOXO1*）相關的基因，同時獨立地下調了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）參與氧化還原調節與自噬的肝臟基因（*GRX5*、*LC3-1*）。LPS 攻擊導致迴腸產生顯著的（$\text{P} < 0.05$）抗氧化失衡，其特徵為 *CAT* 和 *Nrf2* 的下調，以及促發炎細胞激素（*IL8*、*IFNA*、*TNFA*）表達的升高，進而損害屏障功能（*MUC13*、*CLDN2*）。同時，LPS 攻擊增加了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）參與氧化還原調節與自噬的肝臟基因（*GRX5*、*LC3-1*）之表達，這與全身性壓力反應一致。值得注意的是，微生物接觸減輕了 LPS 引起的戊酸降低（$\text{P} < 0.05$），這表明其對免疫壓力下微生物代謝物的產生物理保護作用。結論：成年母雞微生物接觸雖未改善生長性能或迴腸組織形態，但塑造了早期腸道微生物相及相關的代謝物譜，有助於提高肉雞對後續免疫挑戰的抵禦能力。

papers.title: Detection and Persistence of Human Semen and DNA on Animal Fur: Implications for Forensic Investigation of Animal Sexual Abuse
papers.abstract: Animal sexual abuse (ASA) involves the sexual molestation of animals by humans. Forensic DNA analysis of human biological fluids on animal fur may provide investigative leads to a potential suspect. This study was the first to longitudinally assess the recovery of human semen and DNA from three fur models: freshly dissected baboon fur, preserved antelope hides and faux fur. Daily swabbing consistently demonstrated that DNA profiles could be generated from semen over the 14-day study period. Samples in baboon fur typically had greater degradation and yielded lower DNA concentrations compared to other fur models investigated. Although the baboon model best represented a deceased animal, experiments beyond 14 days were limited by decomposition. This study highlights the challenge of selecting a suitable fur model and demonstrates that model choice may influence DNA retention over time. Future research should consider models representing living animals and investigate dynamic variables (e.g., movement, body heat) on semen and DNA retention on animal fur. Overall, this study provides proof of concept and constitutes the first baseline data pertaining to evidence retention in the context of ASA. These findings support the application of forensic molecular techniques in ASA investigations.
papers.abstract_zh: 動物性虐待（Animal sexual abuse, ASA）涉及人類對動物的性侵犯。對動物毛皮上的人類生物體液進行法醫DNA分析，可為潛在嫌疑人提供偵查線索。本研究首次採縱向評估，自三種毛皮模型中回收人類精液與DNA：新鮮解剖的狒狒毛皮、保存的羚羊皮以及人造毛皮。每日的拭子採樣持續顯示，在為期14天的研究期間內，皆可自精液取得DNA圖譜。與其他研究的毛皮模型相比，狒狒毛皮中的樣本通常降解較嚴重且產出較低的DNA濃度。儘管狒狒模型最能代表死亡動物，但超過14天的實驗受到腐敗過程的限制。本研究凸顯了選擇合適毛皮模型的挑戰，並證明模型的選擇可能會影響DNA隨時間的保存。未來研究應考慮代表活體動物的模型，並探討動態變數（例如運動、體溫）對動物毛皮上精液與DNA保存的影響。總體而言，本研究提供了概念驗證，並構成了首批與ASA情境下證據保存相關的基準數據。這些發現支持法醫分子技術在ASA調查中的應用。

papers.title: Effects of Bacillus licheniformis Supplementation on Laying Performance, Antioxidant Capacity, and Cecal Microbiota in Post-Peak Laying Hens
papers.abstract: Bacillus licheniformis, a multifunctional probiotic, improves performance in peak laying hens, but its effects during post-peak laying—characterized by declining ovarian function, impaired intestinal barrier, and oxidative stress—remain unclear. This study evaluated the effects of dietary B. licheniformis on laying performance, antioxidant and immune parameters, intestinal morphology, cecal microbiota, and fermentation metabolites in post-peak-phase laying hens. A total of 720 forty-three-week-old laying hens were randomly assigned to four treatments: a basal diet or the basal diet supplemented with B. licheniformis at 2.5 × 109, 5 × 109, or 1 × 1010 CFU/kg for 31 days. Supplementation at 5 × 109 CFU/kg consistently improved the laying rate from 78.96 ± 0.47% to 80.40 ± 0.64% (+1.44 percentage points, p = 0.0091) and decreased the feed-to-egg ratio from 2.53 ± 0.02 to 2.47 ± 0.02 (−2.4 percentage points, p = 0.005). It enhanced systemic antioxidant capacity, as indicated by a decrease in serum MDA (35.8% p = 0.002) and increases in GSH-Px (33.2%, p = 0.002) and SOD (56.0%, p = 0.011). Jejunal and ileal villus height and villus-to-crypt ratio were also increased (p < 0.05). Cecal microbiota shifted toward a higher relative abundance of Clostridia_UCG-014 (p = 0.006) and norank_o_RF39 (p = 0.017) and a lower abundance of Megasphaera (p = 0.009), whereas individual and total VFA concentrations did not differ among groups (p > 0.05). In conclusion, 5 × 109 CFU/kg B. licheniformis exerted the most consistent benefits in post-peak-phase laying hens, likely through the modulation of gut microbiota, intestinal barrier integrity, and antioxidant status. These findings support B. licheniformis as a promising probiotic for sustainable laying-hen production.
papers.abstract_zh: 地衣芽孢桿菌（Bacillus licheniformis）是一種多功能益生菌，能改善產蛋高峰期產蛋雞的生產性能，但其對產蛋高峰期後（以卵巢功能下降、腸道屏障受損及氧化壓力為特徵）產蛋雞的效果仍不清楚。本研究旨在評估飼糧中添加地衣芽孢桿菌對產蛋高峰期後產蛋雞之產蛋性能、抗氧化與免疫參數、腸道形態、盲腸微生物相及發酵代謝產物的影響。試驗選用 720 隻 43 週齡產蛋雞，隨機分為四個處理組：基礎飼糧組，以及基礎飼糧分別添加 2.5 × 10⁹、5 × 10⁹ 或 1 × 10¹⁰ CFU/kg 地衣芽孢桿菌，試驗期為 31 天。結果顯示，添加 5 × 10⁹ CFU/kg 的地衣芽孢桿菌可持續提升產蛋率，從 78.96 ± 0.47% 增加至 80.40 ± 0.64%（+1.44 個百分點，p = 0.0091），並降低料蛋比，從 2.53 ± 0.02 降至 2.47 ± 0.02（−2.4 個百分點，p = 0.005）。此添加量亦增強了全身抗氧化能力，表現為血清丙二醛（MDA）降低（35.8%，p = 0.002），以及麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px，33.2%，p = 0.002）與超氧化物歧化酶（SOD，56.0%，p = 0.011）活性增加。空腸與迴腸的絨毛高度及絨毛高度與隱窩深度比值亦顯著增加（p < 0.05）。在盲腸微生物相方面，Clostridia_UCG-014（p = 0.006）和 norank_o_RF39（p = 0.017）的相對豐度增加，而巨球形菌屬（Megasphaera）的豐度降低（p = 0.009），各組間的個別及總揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）濃度則無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。綜上所述，添加 5 × 10⁹ CFU/kg 的地衣芽孢桿菌對產蛋高峰期後產蛋雞產生最顯著且一致的益處，這可能透過調節腸道微生物相、腸道屏障完整性及抗氧化狀態來實現。這些結果支持地作為促進蛋雞永續生產之潛力益生菌。

papers.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Large-Scale Dairy Farms: Interannual Dynamics, Farm-Level Heterogeneity, and Key Determinants
papers.abstract: The transition to low-emission (LE) dairy production is essential for mitigating agricultural greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. However, the interannual variability and principal drivers of farm-level GHG footprints across intensive dairy farms remain insufficiently characterized, constraining targeted mitigation strategies. This study aimed to (i) quantify interannual variation in on-farm GHG emission intensity, (ii) characterize management contrasts between high- and low-emission farms, (iii) clarify the underlying mechanisms, and (iv) identify optimization pathways. A supplementary sensitivity analysis encompassing upstream emissions associated with feed production was performed using an expanded system boundary to assess the effects of system boundary selection on the estimated GHG emissions. Using 3-year (2021–2023) field data from 22 intensive dairy farms, a standardized farm-level GHG inventory was used to quantify operational GHG emission intensity per unit of fat- and protein-corrected milk (FPCM). The production-weighted mean on-farm operational GHG intensity was 0.86 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM, with enteric methane constituting the dominant emission source. Incorporating upstream emissions associated with feed production contributed an additional 0.427 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM, yielding a total emission intensity of 1.287 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM under the expanded system boundary, representing a 49.7% increase relative to the operational inventory. Feed upstream emissions accounted for 33.2% of the total emissions estimated within the expanded system boundary. Both herd size and energy consumption exhibited increasing trends throughout the study period, whereas the proportion of lactating cows relating to the total herd declined from 46.01% in 2021 to 44.32% in 2023, suggesting that the expansion of the overall herd exceeded the corresponding growth in the lactating cow population. Under the operational system boundary, high-emission (HE) farms exhibited relatively greater contributions to their GHG emission profiles from enteric methane production, electricity consumption, and manure management activities. Conversely, LE farms attained improved performance through higher proportions of lactating cows, greater feed efficiency, and manure anaerobic digestion. Correlation analysis linked herd size, energy consumption, and dry matter intake positively to on-farm GHG emissions. Dietary starch was associated with manure N2O emissions, while feed efficiency was associated with higher energy-related GHG emissions. Overall, herd composition, feeding management practices, energy utilization, and manure management strategies were identified as principal determinants of on-farm GHG emission performance. Furthermore, the sensitivity analysis employing an expanded system boundary demonstrated that incorporating upstream emissions associated with feed production substantially elevates the overall GHG emission intensity expressed per kg FPCM. This study helps address the lack of multi-year farm-level evidence for China’s dairy sector and proposes integrated strategies—herd structure adjustment, precision feeding, clean energy exploitation, and manure management—alongside sustained long-term monitoring, given the pronounced interannual variability. These findings highlight the roles of farm-level GHG inventories in identifying targeted on-farm emission mitigation opportunities and expanded system boundary assessments in quantifying the overall GHG burden associated with the entire dairy production supply chain.
papers.abstract_zh: 轉型至低碳排放（LE）乳牛生產對於減緩農業溫室氣體（GHG）排放至關重要。然而，集約化乳牛場在場級溫室氣體足跡上的年際變異與主要驅動因素仍未得到充分闡明，從而限制了針對性減緩策略的制定。本研究旨在 (i) 量化場內溫室氣體排放強度的年際變異，(ii) 探討高排放與低排放牧場之間的管理差異，(iii) 釐清其潛在機制，以及 (iv) 識別優化途徑。本研究透過擴展系統邊界，進行了一項包含飼料生產相關上游排放的補充敏感度分析，以評估系統邊界選擇對估算溫室氣體排放的影響。基於 22 個集約化乳牛場為期 3 年（2021–2023 年）的實地數據，利用標準化的場級溫室氣體盤查方法，量化了每單位乳脂與乳蛋白校正乳（FPCM）的營運性溫室氣體排放強度。產量加權的場內營運溫室氣體平均強度為 0.86 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，其中腸道發酵產生的甲烷為主要的排放源。納入飼料生產相關的上游排放後，額外增加了 0.427 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，在擴展系統邊界下總排放強度達到 1.287 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，相較於營運盤查增加了 49.7%。飼料上游排放佔擴展系統邊界下總估算排放量的 33.2%。在研究期間，牛群規模與能源消耗均呈上升趨勢，而泌乳牛佔總牛群的比例則從 2021 年的 46.01% 下降至 2023 年的 44.32%，這表明整體牛群的擴張速度超過了泌乳牛群的相應增長。在營運系統邊界下，高排放（HE）牧場在其溫室氣體排放結構中，來自腸道甲烷產生、電力消耗和糞尿管理的貢獻相對較高。相反地，低排放牧場透過提高泌乳牛比例、提高飼料效率以及採用糞尿厭氧消化技術，實現了更佳的環境表現。相關性分析表明，牛群規模、能源消耗和乾物質攝取量與場內溫室氣體排放呈正相關。日糧澱粉與糞尿 N2O 排放有關，而飼料效率則與較高的能源相關溫室氣體排放有關。總體而言，牛群組成、飼養管理實務、能源利用和糞尿管理策略被確定為影響場內溫室氣體排放表現的主要決定因素。此外，採用擴展系統邊界的敏感度分析表明，納入飼料生產相關的上游排放會顯著提高以每公斤 FPCM 計算的整體溫室氣體排放強度。本研究有助於填補中國乳業缺乏多年期場級實證數據的空白，並考慮到明顯的年際變異，提出了整合性策略——包括牛群結構調整、精準飼養、清潔能源開發以及糞尿管理，同時強調需進行持續的長期監測。這些研究結果突顯了場級溫室氣體盤查在識別場內針對性減排機會方面的作用，以及擴展系統邊界評估在量化與整個乳品生產供應鏈相關的整體溫室氣體負擔方面的重要性。

papers.title: Genomic architecture of non-nominal offspring risk in a simulated composite cattle breed
papers.abstract: Background Composite cattle breeds are designed to combine complementary attributes from different founder breeds while retaining part of the heterosis generated by crossbreeding. Brangus cattle are nominally defined as 5/8 Angus and 3/8 Brahman, but the same global breed composition can be produced by different genomic architectures. This distinction may be important because animals with the same Brahman ancestry proportion may differ in ancestry heterozygosity, homozygous ancestry composition and segregation behaviour when used as parents. The objective of this study was to use controlled simulations to evaluate whether genomic architecture affects the risk of producing offspring outside the nominal Brangus ancestry range. Results We simulated two alternative pathways to the same expected Brahman ancestry proportion of 0.375. Although both pathways produced similar mean Brahman ancestry, the direct pathway generated a broader ancestry distribution than the indirect pathway, with a higher proportion of individuals outside the nominal interval. After filtering candidate sires to the nominal interval, formation-pathway-dependent genomic architectures remained evident. In a mixed inter se mating analysis extended to 100 generations and three population-size scenarios, pathway-specific ancestry-state differences were progressively eroded and the standard deviation of Brahman ancestry proportion declined after an early maximum, but non-nominal frequencies remained non-negligible over the simulated time horizon. Family-level simulations showed that matings between nominal parents differed substantially in their probability of producing non-nominal daughters.
