This risk depended on both the distance between the expected family mean and the target ancestry and the block-weighted segregation potential of the parental genomes. An exploratory quasibinomial model supported positive associations between non-nominal risk and displacement from the target and high-variance parental block structures. Finally, a heuristic-assisted simulation-informed sire allocation strategy increased the proportion of nominal daughters relative to random sire allocation, with the greatest gains obtained from broader sire catalogues. Conclusions Nominal breed composition does not define a unique genomic state. In simulated Brangus cattle, animals that were equivalent in global ancestry could differ in genomic architecture and in the offspring ancestry distributions generated by specific matings. These results suggest that composite-breed management should consider not only the ancestry proportion of individual animals, but also the expected outcome of sire–dam pairs.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：複合肉牛品種旨在結合不同創始品種的互補特徵，同時保留雜交產生的部分雜種優勢。布蘭格斯牛（Brangus）的名義品種組成定義為 5/8 安格斯牛與 3/8 婆羅門牛，然而相同的整體品種組成可能由不同的基因體架構所產生。這項區別可能很重要，因為具有相同婆羅門牛血統比例的動物，在作為親本使用時，其血統雜合度、純合血統組成與分離行為可能會有所不同。本研究的目的在於利用控制模擬來評估基因體架構是否會影響產生超出名義布蘭格斯牛血統範圍後代之風險。結果：我們模擬了達到相同預期婆羅門牛血統比例 0.375 的兩種不同途徑。儘管這兩種途徑產生了相似的平均婆羅門牛血統，但直接途徑產生的血統分佈比間接途徑更廣，且落在名義區間之外的個體比例更高。在將候選種公牛篩選至名義區間後，取決於培育途徑的基因體架構仍然十分顯著。在延伸至 100 個世代及三種族群大小情境的混合自交分析中，特定途徑的血統狀態差異逐漸被抹平，且婆羅門牛血統比例標準差在達到早期最大值後下降，但在模擬的時間範圍內，非名義頻率仍然不可忽視。家族層級的模擬顯示，名義親本之間的交配在產生非名義後代母牛的機率上有顯著差異。此風險取決於預期家族平均值與目標血統之間的距離，以及親本基因體的區塊加權分離潛能。探索性擬二項式模型支持非名義風險與偏離目標及高變異親本區塊結構之間的正相關性。最後，與隨機分配種公牛相比，啟發式輔助的模擬資訊種公牛分配策略提高了名義後代母牛的比例，其中以較廣泛的種公牛目錄獲得的增幅最大。結論：名義品種組成並不能定義唯一的基因體狀態。在模擬的布蘭格斯牛中，整體血統相同的動物在基因體架構以及特定交配所產生的後代血統分佈上可能有所不同。這些結果表明，複合品種的管理不僅應考慮個體動物的血統比例，還應考慮公母牛配對的預期結果。

papers.title: Determination and Prediction of Standardized Mineral Availabilities in Different Sources of Soybean Meals for Broilers
papers.abstract: This study was conducted to estimate the standardized mineral availabilities (SMAs) of 10 soybean meals (SBMs) fed to broilers, and prediction models were developed and validated based on chemical properties. A total of 308 broilers (22 d of age), having similar initial body weights, were assigned at random to 11 dietary groups, with 7 replicate cages per group and 4 broilers per cage. On d 26, the broilers were given 4 h access to either a mineral-free diet or 10 test SBM-formulated diets. Fecal collection then proceeded for 52 h for SMA measurement. SMA-prediction models were established via stepwise regression using data from 9 SBMs, with the remaining SBM randomly used to validate the models’ accuracy. Soybean meal source influenced (p < 0.02) SMAs in broilers. Manganese (Mn) exhibited the lowest standardized availability (SA) at 30.4%, whereas calcium (Ca) showed the highest SA at 66.2%. Six prediction models for SAs of potassium (K), Ca, phosphorus (P), zinc (Zn), Mn, and copper (Cu) in SBMs for broilers were developed from the chemical properties, exhibiting R2 values spanning 0.487 to 0.964 (p < 0.04). The prediction model for standardized Ca availability provided the best goodness-of-fit (R2 = 0.964, p < 0.001). By contrast, this model for standardized Cu availability performed the worst (R2 = 0.487, p = 0.037). Except for Zn and Mn, the predicted SAs for Ca, P, K, and Cu were generally consistent with the measured values. Taken together, the constructed prediction models in our work can serve as a reliable tool for quickly predicting the SAs of Ca, P, K, and Cu in SBMs for broilers.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估肉雞餵食 10 種大豆粕（SBM）之標準化礦物質可用率（SMAs），並基於化學特性建立與驗證預測模式。總共 308 隻初始體重相近的肉雞（22 日齡）被隨機分配至 11 個飲食組，每組 7 個重複籠，每籠 4 隻肉雞。在 26 日齡時，肉雞限時 4 小時攝食無礦物質飼糧或 10 種試驗大豆粕配製飼糧。隨後進行 52 小時的糞便收集以測定 SMA。利用其中 9 種大豆粕的數據透過逐步迴歸建立 SMA 預測模式，剩餘的 10 分之 1 大豆粕則隨機用於驗證模式的準確性。大豆粕來源會影響肉雞的 SMA（p < 0.02）。錳（Mn）的標準化可用率（SA）最低，為 30.4%，而鈣（Ca）的 SA 最高，為 66.2%。本研究根據化學特性建立了肉雞大豆粕中鉀（K）、鈣、磷（P）、鋅（Zn）、錳和銅（Cu）等 6 種 SA 的預測模式，其 $R^2$ 值介於 0.487 至 0.964 之間（p < 0.04）。標準化鈣可用率的預測模式具有最佳的配適度（$R^2 = 0.964$，p < 0.001）。相對地，標準化銅可用率的預測模式表現最差（$R^2 = 0.487$，p = 0.037）。除鋅和錳外，鈣、磷、鉀和銅的預測 SA 與實測值大致一致。綜上所述，本研究中所建構的預測模式可作為快速預測肉雞大豆粕中鈣、磷、鉀和銅之 SA 的可靠工具。

papers.title: A Nelore Cattle Structural Variant Catalog
papers.abstract: Structural variants (SVs) contribute more nucleotide divergence between mammalian genomes than single nucleotide polymorphisms, yet no population‐scale, long‐read‐validated SV catalog has been available for Bos indicus cattle. Nelore, the most numerically important indicine breed worldwide, diverges substantially from the taurine‐derived reference genome used for most bovine SV discovery, leaving its structural variation largely uncharacterized. Long‐read sequencing of 20 Nelore bulls with two complementary callers (Sniffles2, SVIM) yielded 82 581 dual‐caller concordant SVs, of which 74 222 insertions and deletions passed independent read‐based validation. Ensembl VEP annotation identified 561 HIGH‐impact variants (0.75% of the catalog) across 7040 protein‐coding genes. Only 22 894 SVs (30.7%), including 147 of 561 HIGH‐impact variants (26.2%), could be tagged by an existing BovineHD SNP ( r 2 ≥ 0.8), showing that routine array genotyping captures a minority of this variation. Intersection with an indicine‐ancestry SNP map identified 6114 SVs (8.2%) enriched in Bos indicus , including 61 HIGH‐impact variants overlapping genes with plausible roles in immune/inflammatory defense and oxidative‐stress response, providing a resource and candidate variant set for genomic selection and tropical‐adaptation studies in indicine cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 相較於單核苷酸多型性，結構變異（SVs）對哺乳動物基因組間的核苷酸差異貢獻更大，然而過去一直缺乏針對印度牛（Bos indicus）的群體規模、長讀長驗證之結構變異目錄。內羅爾牛（Nelore）是全球數量最重要的印度牛品種，與多數牛隻結構變異發現所使用的牛屬參考基因組（源自歐亞牛）存在顯著分化，導致其結構變異在很大程度上仍未被充分解析。本研究對20頭內羅爾公牛進行長讀長定序，並結合兩種互補的呼叫軟體（Sniffles2、SVIM），共得出82,581個雙軟體一致的結構變異，其中74,222個插入與刪除通過了獨立的基於讀長的驗證。Ensembl VEP註釋在7,040個蛋白質編碼基因中識別出561個高影響（HIGH-impact）變異（佔目錄的0.75%）。僅有22,894個結構變異（30.7%）——包含561個高影響變異中的147個（26.2%）——可被現有的BovineHD SNP晶片標記（$r^2 \ge 0.8$），顯示常規晶片基因型分型僅能捕捉此類變異的一小部分。透過與印度牛祖先成分SNP圖譜交集，識別出6114個在印度牛中顯著富集的結構變異（8.2%），其中包括61個高影響變異，這些變異與在免疫/發炎防禦及氧化壓力反應中具有合理功能的基因重疊，為印度牛的基因體選育與熱帶適應研究提供了資源與候選變異集。

papers.title: Mitochondrial Dysfunction Across Multiple Organs in Broilers Exhibiting Wooden Breast Myopathy
papers.abstract: Wooden breast (WB) in broilers has been linked to impaired mitochondrial function in the breast muscle. When mitochondrial function declines, organs receive less ATP and experience oxidative stress. Muscle development is linked to the optimal function of the gut, liver, and pancreas, which depends on adequate ATP to support nutrient absorption and metabolism. The effects of the WB myopathy on other organs and tissues within broilers are relatively unknown. The aim of this study was to investigate factors linked to mitochondrial function in multiple organs from broilers exhibiting WB. From sixty 8-week-old broilers, ten severe WB and ten normal breast muscles were selected for tissue collection (liver, pancreas, three sections of intestine, and breast muscle). Reduced citrate synthase activity and mitochondrial complex-II activity were observed in the muscle, pancreas, liver and duodenum tissues of WB broilers compared to normal broilers. Broilers with WB had reduced glutathione content in the pancreas and all three sections of the intestine when compared to normal broilers. Whole tissue ATP content was decreased in the muscle and liver of WB broilers. Overall, these data suggest that mitochondrial function may be impaired in tissues beyond just the breast muscle in broilers that exhibit the WB myopathy.
papers.abstract_zh: 肉雞的木胸症（Wooden breast, WB）已被認為與胸肌粒線體功能受損有關。當粒線體功能下降時，器官獲得的 ATP 減少並會經歷氧化壓力。肌肉發育與腸道、肝臟和胰臟的最佳功能息息相關，而這有賴於充足的 ATP 來支援營養物質的吸收與代謝。木胸病變對肉雞體內其他器官和組織的影響目前所知相對有限。本研究旨在探討表現出木胸症肉雞多個器官中與粒線體功能相關的因素。從六十隻 8 週齡肉雞中，選出十個嚴重木胸症與十個正常胸肌進行組織採樣（肝臟、胰臟、三段腸道及胸肌）。與正常肉雞相比，木胸症肉雞的肌肉、胰臟、肝臟和十二指腸組織中的檸檬酸合成酶活性和粒線體複合物 II 活性均降低。與正常肉雞相比，木胸症肉雞在胰臟和三段腸道中的穀胱甘肽含量皆減少。木胸症肉雞的肌肉和肝臟中全組織 ATP 含量降低。總體而言，這些數據表明，在表現出木胸病變的肉雞中，粒線體功能受損可能不僅限於胸肌，還擴及其他組織。

papers.title: A Comparison of Conventional Lighting Versus Poultry-Specific Lighting During the Day in Combination With or Without a Blue Light “Moonphase” at Night
papers.abstract: Lighting is a key environmental factor influencing the welfare and productivity of laying hens; however, the combined effects of poultry-specific daytime spectra and dim blue “moonlight” during the scotoperiod remain poorly characterized. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of spectral modification of daytime lighting and the use of dim monochromatic blue light at night on stress, fear, leg health, egg production, egg quality, and feeding activity in aged laying hens. One hundred and twenty 70-wk-old laying hens were assigned to one of four lighting treatments, arranged as a 2 × 2 factorial of daytime spectrum × night-time condition, for 28 d following a 14-d acclimation under common lighting: conventional 3000 K white LEDs (CON); poultry-specific lighting (PSL) combining 3000 K white LEDs with 630 nm red light; CON with dim monochromatic blue light at night (CON-moon); and PSL with dim monochromatic blue light at night (PSL-moon). Plasma corticosterone, heterophil-to-lymphocyte (H/L) ratio, composite asymmetry, tonic immobility, inversion response, tibial breaking strength and bone ash, egg production, egg quality, and AI-quantified feeding activity were measured. By the end of the treatment period, hens under PSL had lower corticosterone concentrations, lower H/L ratios, and less physical asymmetry than hens under conventional light, together with taller albumen and higher Haugh unit values, and they spent less time at the feeder without eating less. Moonlight at night produced a further reduction in the stress indicators and, by the final sampling, heavier eggs with stronger shells. Hen-day egg production and tibial breaking strength were unaffected by lighting. These findings indicate that poultry-specific lighting paired with dim blue moonlight is a practical, noninvasive enrichment strategy that can simultaneously improve welfare and egg quality without compromising production.
papers.abstract_zh: 光照是影響產蛋雞福祉與生產效能的關鍵環境因素；然而，家禽專屬的日間光譜與暗期中微弱藍光「月光」的綜合效應，目前仍少有明確的研究。本研究旨在評估日間光譜調整與夜間使用微弱單色藍光對高齡產蛋雞之壓力、恐懼、腳部健康、產蛋率、雞蛋品質及攝食行為的影響。將一百二十隻 70 週齡產蛋雞隨機分配至四種光照處理中，採日間光譜 × 夜間條件之 2 × 2 因子設計，在共同光照下適應 14 天後進行為期 28 天的試驗：傳統 3000 K 白光 LED（CON）；結合 3000 K 白光 LED 與 630 nm 紅光的家禽專屬光照（PSL）；CON 搭配夜間微弱單色藍光（CON-moon）；以及 PSL 搭配夜間微弱單色藍光（PSL-moon）。本研究測定了血漿皮質酮、嗜異性球與淋巴球比值（H/L 比）、綜合不對稱性、強直性靜止、倒立反應、脛骨斷裂強度與骨灰分、產蛋率、雞蛋品質，以及透過人工智慧（AI）量化的攝食活動。試驗期結束時，與傳統光照相比，處於 PSL 下的產蛋雞具有較低的皮質酮濃度、較低的 H/L 比及較少的身體不對稱性，同時伴隨較高的蛋白高度與豪氏單位數，且牠們在飼槽停留的時間較短但攝食量並未減少。夜間的月光使壓力指標進一步降低，且在最後一次採樣時，產出了較重且蛋殼較強韌的雞蛋。產蛋率與脛骨斷裂強度則不受光照影響。這些研究結果顯示，家禽專屬光照搭配微弱藍光月光是一種實用且無創的環境豐富化策略，能在不影響生產效能的情況下，同時改善福祉與雞蛋品質。

papers.title: Mitogenome Insights Into the Domestication and Phylogeography of Zebu Cattle: A Focus on Pakistani Breeds and Asian Lineages
papers.abstract: Zebu cattle ( Bos indicus ) represent a critical livestock resource in the arid and semi‐arid regions, known for their disease resistance, heat tolerance and physiological hardiness. Despite their agricultural importance, the precise matrilineal evolutionary history, genetic diversity and demographic trajectory remain incompletely resolved within the broader context of South Asian cattle domestication. This study explores the phylogeographic patterns and maternal lineage diversity of zebu cattle through complete mitochondrial genomes (mtDNA), the D‐loop, and hypervariable regions from 50 individuals of 10 indigenous Pakistani breeds. These breeds were classified into three regions: North Pakistan, Central Pakistan/Punjab (Indus Valley region) and South Pakistan (the site of Mohenjo‐Daro). Our data include 183 newly generated sequences and are supplemented with comparative datasets from 19 countries. Analysis reveals South Pakistan, especially the Mehrgarh area, as a key potential domestication epicentre, exhibiting highest nucleotide diversity ( π = 0.01480) across Asian zebu populations, accompanied by ancient maternal lineages estimated to date back approximately 2.17 million years. Highest haplotype diversity was observed in Punjab (0.901 ± 0.014) followed by Southern Pakistan (0.893 ± 0.026). Phylogenetic and demographic analyses (mismatch distribution, Fu's Fs) further support an early dispersal scenario (I1 haplogroup) originating in Mehrgarh and radiating through the Indus Valley into broader Asian lineages. These findings enhance our understanding of the domestication origins of Bos indicus , its implications for breed conservation and sustainable livestock management.
papers.abstract_zh: 瘤牛（*Bos indicus*）是乾旱與半乾旱地區至關重要的家畜資源，以抗病能力、耐熱性及生理韌性聞名。儘管其具備重要的農業價值，但在南亞牛隻馴化的更廣泛背景下，其確切的母系演化歷史、遺傳多樣性與人口統計學軌跡仍未完全釐清。本研究透過來自巴基斯坦 10 個本土品種共 50 個體的完整粒線體基因組（mtDNA）、D 迴圈及高變異區，探討瘤牛的親緣地理模式與母系譜系多樣性。這些品種被歸類為三個區域：巴基斯坦北部、巴基斯坦中部／旁遮普（印度河流域地區）以及巴基斯坦南部（莫亨焦達羅遺址所在地）。我們的數據包含 183 個新產生的序列，並輔以來自 19 個國家的比較數據集。分析顯示，巴基斯坦南部（特別是梅爾加爾地區）是關鍵的潛在馴化中心，其展現出亞洲瘤牛族群中最高的核苷酸多樣性（$\pi = 0.01480$），並伴隨估計可追溯至約 217 萬年前的古老母系譜系。旁遮普觀察到最高的高倍型多樣性（$0.901 \pm 0.014$），其次為巴基斯坦南部（$0.893 \pm 0.026$）。系統發生與人口統計學分析（不匹配分佈、Fu's Fs 檢定）進一步支持一項早期擴散情景（I1 單倍群），即源自梅爾加爾，並透過印度河流域輻射至更廣泛的亞洲譜系。這些發現增進了我們對*Bos indicus*馴化起源的理解，及其對品種保育和永續畜牧管理的意涵。

papers.title: Effect of Selection for High Growth on Resilience of Giant Freshwater Prawn Macrobrachium rosenbergii
papers.abstract: Resilience is the capacity of an animal to be minimally affected by disturbances or to rapidly return to its pre‐disturbance state. To the best of our knowledge, no previous study has investigated resilience in the giant freshwater prawn (GFP, Macrobrachium rosenbergii ). In this study, we aimed to estimate the genetic parameters of resilience indicators, the correlations between resilience and growth and survival traits, and the correlated genetic responses to selection for high growth in the present GFP line. A resilience indicator based on standardised body weight (BW) deviation was analysed in 39,134 individuals (offspring of 810 females and 515 males), specifically the logarithm‐transformed variance (LnVar). The heritability estimate for the resilience indicator (LnVar) was low (0.09 ± 0.03) but statistically significant. The genetic correlations between LnVar and body weight (BW) and total length (TL) were moderate and positive (0.33 ± 0.04 and 0.18 ± 0.01, respectively), whereas those between LnVar and body and carapace widths were negative (−0.28 to −0.32). The correlated response of the resilience indicator (LnVar) to selection for high growth was low but favourable, averaging 0.77%–2.89% over eight generations, or only 0.002 and 0.006 phenotypic and genetic standard deviation units, respectively. In conclusion, this study demonstrates the presence of heritable genetic variation in the resilience indicator derived from BW deviations in the giant freshwater prawn. Selection for high body weight has slightly improved resilience in this species, highlighting the potential to enhance resilience through selective breeding, albeit at a slow rate.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 韌性是指動物受干擾影響極小或能迅速恢復至干擾前狀態的能力。據我們所知，先前並無研究探討巨大淡水蝦（巨蝦，Macrobrachium rosenbergii）的韌性。在本研究中，我們旨在估算韌性指標的遺傳參數、韌性與生長及存活性狀之間的相關性，以及本巨蝦品系對高生長選育的相關遺傳反應。本研究分析了 39,134 隻個體（810 隻雌蝦與 515 隻雄蝦的後代）基於標準化體重（BW）偏差的韌性指標，具體而言即對數轉換變異數（LnVar）。韌性指標（LnVar）的遺傳率估值雖低（0.09 ± 0.03）但具統計顯著性。LnVar 與體重（BW）及總長（TL）之間的遺傳相關性為中等且呈正相關（分別為 0.33 ± 0.04 與 0.18 ± 0.01），而 LnVar 與體寬及頭胸甲寬之間則呈負相關（-0.28 至 -0.32）。韌性指標（LnVar）對高生長選育的相關反應低但屬有利，在八個世代中平均為 0.77% 至 2.89%，表現型和遺傳標準差單位則分別僅增加 0.002 和 0.006。總體而言，本研究證明了巨大淡水蝦中源自體重偏差的韌性指標具有具遺傳性的遺傳變異。對高體重的選育已微幅改善了該物種的韌性，凸顯了透過選育來增強韌性的潛力，儘管進展速度緩慢。

papers.title: Veterinarians’ Perceptions of Farm Animal Pain and Views on Pain Management: Two Cross-Sectional Scenario-Based Surveys of Cattle and Pig Practitioners in Poland
papers.abstract: Two anonymous web-based surveys were administered to veterinarians working with cattle or pigs in Poland between March 2025 and February 2026 (101 responses per survey). Questionnaires assessed demographics, seven pain-related statements (5-point Likert scale), and pain ratings for clinical scenarios (0–10). Analyses used nonparametric tests with Benjamini–Hochberg multiplicity control and exploratory multivariable logistic regression. Agreement that pain mitigation improves recovery was nearly universal (cattle, 100/101; pigs, 95/101). In cattle, difficult calving, thermal disbudding, and castration were most often rated as severely painful (≥8/10; 88/101, 69/101, and 60/101, respectively). In pigs, limb fracture had a median rating of 10 and was rated ≥8/10 by 85/101 respondents, whereas tail-docking ratings varied widely. After multiplicity control, female cattle respondents more strongly endorsed insufficient analgesic options, whereas male pig respondents more strongly endorsed lower pain sensitivity in pigs than in humans. The latter belief correlated with lower mean pain ratings (ρ = −0.298). Among pig veterinarians, routine pain discussion was associated with self-reported knowledge (OR 2.11, 95% CI 1.13–3.93) and perceived limitations in analgesic availability (OR 2.24, 95% CI 1.15–4.37). These findings highlight veterinarians’ support for pain relief and identify areas for continuing education, communication with producers, and practical guidance on pain management.
papers.abstract_zh: 2025年3月至2026年2月間，波蘭針對從事牛隻或豬隻診療的獸醫進行了兩項匿名網路問卷調查（每項調查各獲得101份有效回覆）。問卷評估了受訪者的背景、七項與疼痛相關的陳述（採用5點李克特量表），以及對臨床情境的疼痛評分（0至10分）。分析採用非母數檢定，並以班傑明-霍克伯格（Benjamini–Hochberg）方法進行多重比較控制，同時進行探索性多元羅吉斯迴歸分析。幾乎所有受訪者皆認同緩解疼痛有助於康復（牛隻獸醫 100/101；豬隻獸醫 95/101）。在牛隻方面，難產、熱烙去角和去勢被最常評為劇烈疼痛（≥8/10分；分別為 88/101、69/101 及 60/101）。在豬隻方面，四肢骨折的中位評分為10分，且有 85/101 的受訪者評為≥8/10分，而尾部切除（斷尾）的評分則差異極大。在進行多重比較控制後，女性牛隻獸醫更強烈認同止痛選擇不足，而男性豬隻獸醫則更強烈認為豬隻的疼痛敏感度低於人類。後者的觀念與較低的平均疼痛評分呈負相關（$\rho = -0.298$）。在豬隻獸醫中，例行討論疼痛與自我評估的專業知識（勝算比 OR 2.11，95% 信賴區間 1.13–3.93）及對止痛藥物可取得性的侷限感知（勝算比 OR 2.24，95% 信賴區間 1.15–4.37）呈顯著相關。這些研究結果突顯了獸醫對止痛的支持，並指出了持續教育、與畜牧生產者溝通以及疼痛管理實務指引的改進方向。

papers.title: Effect of Rearing System and Season on Herbage Intake, Performance and Meat Nutritional Quality of Growing Rabbits
papers.abstract: Consumer demand for sustainable and animal-friendly systems has driven interest in alternative livestock management; however, its impact on productive performance and meat quality requires further validation. This study monitored outdoor-reared rabbits during the spring and autumn seasons over a 48 d experimental period, comparing this alternative system to cage-reared rabbits slaughtered at a fixed age (80 d). Forage and energy intakes were evaluated alongside a post-slaughter analysis of muscle lipid content, fatty acid profiles, and tocopherol deposition. Meat oxidative stability was assessed by measuring thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS). Data were analyzed using mixed linear models and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The results demonstrate that pasture-based rabbit systems offer a suitable alternative to conventional cages. Although pasture access significantly reduced growth performance, with average daily gain dropping by up to 7.24 g/day and digestible energy intake decreasing by approximately 6.20 MJ in autumn-reared rabbits, it enhanced meat quality by yielding leaner muscle profiles and higher levels of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs). Furthermore, although pasture-based systems are widely reported to increase physical activity—potentially elevating metabolic rate and oxidative load—the concurrent intake of natural antioxidants from fresh forage effectively maintained high oxidative stability in meat. Ultimately, these findings validate pasture-based systems as a viable approach to delivering high-quality meat within sustainable, welfare-friendly production frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 消費者對永續且動物友善飼養系統的需求，帶動了對替代性家畜管理模式的興趣；然而其對生產性能與肉質的影響仍需進一步驗證。本研究在春季與秋季對戶外飼養的兔子進行了為期48天的實驗監測，將此替代系統與固定屠宰年齡（80日齡）的籠飼兔子進行比較。評估了牧草與能量攝取量，並進行了屠宰後肌肉脂質含量、脂肪酸組成及生育酚沉積的分析。透過測定硫代巴比妥酸反應物（TBARS）來評估肉品的抗氧化穩定性。數據採用混合線性模型與主成分分析（PCA）進行分析。結果顯示，放牧兔隻系統可作為傳統籠飼的合適替代方案。儘管放牧顯著降低了生長性能，秋季飼養兔隻的平均每日增重下降高達7.24公克/天，且可消化能量攝取量減少約6.20百萬焦耳（MJ），但它透過產生較瘦的肌肉組織及較高水準的n-3多元不飽和脂肪酸（PUFAs），提升了肉品品質。此外，雖然廣泛報導指出放牧系統會增加體能活動——可能提高代謝率與氧化負擔，但同時攝取新鮮牧草中的天然抗氧化劑，有效地維持了肉品的高抗氧化穩定性。總體而言，這些發現證實了放牧系統作為在永續且兼顧動物福利的生產框架下提供高品質肉類的可行方法。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Association and Selection Signature Analyses of Hematological and Serum Biochemical Traits in Yunling Cattle
papers.abstract: Yunling cattle, a native breed native to subtropical regions, exhibit remarkable traits such as heat tolerance, strong immunity, and tick resistance. To characterize the genetic architecture of blood physiological and biochemical traits associated with these adaptations, we performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) using whole-genome resequencing data from 97 individuals combined alongside 39 blood traits (30 analysed after quality control). Significant association signals were detected for seven traits: albumin (ALB), homocysteine (CYS), white blood cell count (WBC), bilirubin (BIL), indirect bilirubin (I-BIL), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LD-CHO), and red cell distribution width (RDW). Notably, loci related to leukocyte parameters overlapped with strong selection signals and were mapped to classical bovine leukocyte antigen (BOLA) genes, including BOLA, BOLA-DQB and BOLA-DQA5, which are located within the MHC region and are known to be involved in immune regulation. For lipid-related traits, the strongest signals were identified near RPL22L1 and SLC7A14 on chromosome 1, while additional associated genes included XPOT, SLC16A7, SCAI, SYT14 and ATP2B2. Additionally, regarding metabolic and protein parameters, NHSL1 showed a strong association with bilirubin; this gene has previously been reported to be associated with hypertension. Red blood cell parameters revealed candidate genes such as NAV3, LSAMP, ACACA, and others linked to erythrocyte variation. For Homocysteine-related traits, CIITA was significantly associated with Homocysteine levels; CIITA is known to be involved in immune regulation. In conclusion, this study provides a genome-wide characterization of the genetic architecture of blood traits in Yunling cattle, identifying several candidate genes (e.g., MOB1B, CIITA and BOLA genes) associated with blood physiological and biochemical traits. These candidate loci provide a foundation for further functional validation; validation in larger and independent populations is needed before any application.
papers.abstract_zh: 雲嶺牛為亞熱帶地區的本土品種，展現出耐熱、免疫力強及抗蜱等顯著特徵。為了闡明與這些適應性相關的血液生理及生化性狀之遺傳架構，我們結合了97個體的全基因體重新定序資料與39個血液性狀（經品質控制後分析30個），進行了全基因體關聯分析（GWAS）。在七個性狀中檢測到顯著的關聯訊號：白蛋白（ALB）、同半胱胺酸（CYS）、白血球計數（WBC）、膽紅素（BIL）、間接膽紅素（I-BIL）、低密度脂蛋白膽紅素（LD-CHO）及紅血球分佈寬度（RDW）。值得注意的是，與白血球參數相關的基因座與強烈的選擇訊號重疊，並被定位至經典的牛白血球抗原（BOLA）基因，包含位於MHC區域內且已知參與免疫調節的BOLA、BOLA-DQB及BOLA-DQA5。在脂質相關性狀方面，最強的訊號被識別於第一號染色體上的RPL22L1與SLC7A14附近，其他相關基因則包含XPOT、SLC16A7、SCAI、SYT14及ATP2B2。此外，在代謝與蛋白質參數方面，NHSL1顯示出與膽紅素有強烈的關聯，該基因先前已被報導與高血壓有關。紅血球參數則揭示了與紅血球變異相關的候選基因，如NAV3、LSAMP、ACACA等。在同半胱胺酸相關性狀方面，CIITA與同半胱胺酸濃度顯著相關，而已知CIITA參與免疫調節。總體而言，本研究提供了雲嶺牛血液性狀遺傳架構的全基因體特徵，識別出數個與血液生理及生化性狀相關的候選基因（例如MOB1B、CIITA及BOLA基因）。這些候選基因座為進一步的功能驗證奠定了基礎；在進行任何應用之前，仍需於更大且獨立的群體中進行驗證。

papers.title: A deregression-based approach to integrate multitrait information into a single pooled phenotype for genetic evaluation
papers.abstract: Background Genetic evaluation of complex traits is often challenged by heterogeneous, incomplete or costly phenotyping. Many biological processes require multiple traits to be characterized. Moreover, combining several traits becomes difficult when the configuration of available traits is complex (e.g., increasing number, complex missing patterns), leading to more demanding computations. To overcome these limitations, a deregression-based pooling method was developed to pre-process multitrait information into a single pseudo-phenotype of the target trait (i.e., a pooled phenotype). This method was assessed in a terminal crossbreeding situation in pigs. Results The behavior of estimated breeding values and the accuracy of reliabilities systems were studied on different datasets (i.e., different data availability scenarios - a real and 3 simulated). Three modeling steps were used: (1) a multitrait model generating input for deregressions, (2) an adjusted scalar deregression, combining information into a pooled phenotype using (3) a single trait model applied to this pooled phenotype to assess how these results match the multitrait predictions from step (1). In all data structure scenarios, unadjusted deregression underestimates breeding values and distorts reliabilities. In contrast, applying expansion and reliability-alignment factors as adjustments restored the distributions and scale of estimated breeding values, yielding a near-perfect agreement with the multitrait model. Across all simulated scenarios, including the one with the complete absence of the target trait, the adjusted deregression process achieved the highest correlations between true and estimated breeding values. Conclusions The deregression-based process provides an effective and flexible approach for combining heterogeneous multitrait information into a unique pooled phenotype in a single trait setting, while maintaining genetic scale and reliability of the target trait in a multiple trait setting. Unlike classical deregression, the adjusted deregression process prevents overshrinking, maintains accuracy and reproduces the behavior of a multitrait evaluation. This pre-processing would be a practical solution for integrating complex or partially recorded traits into routine genetic evaluation pipelines. This method is applicable even if the main target trait is limited or missing, provided that moderately to highly correlated traits are available. The strategy could be extended to other situations as long as any double-counting can be avoided.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：複雜性狀的遺傳評估經常受到異質性、不完整或高成本表型分析的挑戰。許多生物過程需要對多個性狀進行表徵。此外，當可用性狀的配置很複雜（例如：性狀數量增加、複雜的缺失模式）時，結合多個性狀會變得很困難，從而導致更高的計算需求。為了解決這些限制，本研究開發了一種基於去迴歸（deregression）的合併方法，將多性狀資訊預先處理為目標性狀的單一偽表型（即合併表型）。此方法在豬隻的終端雜交情況下進行了評估。
結果：本研究在不同的資料集（即不同的資料可用性情境——1個真實資料集與3個模擬資料集）上，研究了估計育種值（EBV）的表現以及信賴度系統的準確性。使用了三個建模步驟：(1) 生成去迴歸輸入的多性狀模型；(2) 調整後的純量去迴歸，使用(3) 應用於該合併表型的單性狀模型將資訊結合成合併表型，以評估這些結果如何與步驟(1)的多性狀預測相匹配。在所有資料結構情境中，未調整的去迴歸會低估育種值並扭曲信賴度。相比之下，應用擴展與信賴度對齊因子作為調整，恢復了估計育種值的分布與尺度，產生與多性狀模型幾近完美的ㄧ致性。在所有模擬情境中（包括完全缺乏目標性狀的情境），調整後的去迴歸過程在真實育種值與估計育種值之間實現了最高的相關性。
結論：基於去迴歸的過程提供了一種有效且具彈性的方法，可在單一性狀框架下將異質的多性狀資訊結合為獨特的合併表型，同時在多性狀框架下維持目標性狀的遺傳尺度與信賴度。與傳統的去迴歸不同，調整後的去迴歸過程可防止過度縮減（overshrinking）、維持準確性並重現多性狀評估的行為。這種預先處理對於將複雜或部分記錄的性狀整合到常規遺傳評估流程中將是一種實用的解決方案。即使主要的目標性狀受限或缺失，只要有中度至高度相關的性狀可供使用，此方法仍然適用。只要能避免任何重複計算，此策略亦可擴展應用於其他情境。

papers.title: The rate and spectrum of germline mutations in chicken from a commercial pedigree line
papers.abstract: Background Pedigree-based studies of germline mutations provide a direct understanding of the origin and consequences of genetic variation, and allow quantification of how mutations affect functional variation. Here, we use whole-genome sequencing data from 194 chicken ( Gallus gallus ) trios from a commercial pedigree line to estimate the germline mutation rate and spectrum, and to characterize patterns of mutational variation across the genome and genes, aiming to rank protein coding genes by their expected contributions to mutational variance ( V m ). Results We estimated a mutation rate of µ = 3.49 × 10 −9 mutations per nucleotide site per generation. A goodness-of-fit test (χ 2 13 = 10.97, P = 0.61) indicated that the number of new mutations per generation follows a Poisson distribution ( λ = 6.22). A read-based phasing approach revealed a strong sex bias, with males contributing approximately twice as many mutations as females. Microchromosomes showed a point estimate of mutation rate approximately 8% higher than macrochromosomes, likely owing to their higher GC content and a mutation spectrum dominated by C→T transitions. From this spectrum, we built a codon transition matrix and show that genes vary widely in their propensity to mutation based on codon composition, likely reflecting large differences in their contributions to V m . Specifically, we found that genes involved in immunity and development rank among those most prone to non-silent mutations. Conclusions Our results reveal predictable patterns of gene-level mutational variation and provide a framework for anticipating how new mutations generate functional variation. By bridging quantitative genetics and molecular biology, we provide a mechanistic basis for variation in V m across the genome, showing that heterogeneity in V m can arise from gene-specific features, particularly codon composition and mutational target size. These metrics offer a way to rank genes and prioritize genetic variants by their expected contributions to biological functions as a consequence of de novo mutation. This provides a new basis for informed management of genetic variation in breeding populations and for understanding the evolutionary dynamics of functionally important genes.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 基於譜系的生殖細胞突變研究能直接幫助我們理解遺傳變異的來源與後果，並允許量化突變如何影響功能性變異。在此，我們利用來自商業育種譜系中 194 個雞（Gallus gallus）三人組（trios）的全基因組定序數據，來估算生殖細胞突變率與突變譜，並表徵整個基因組及基因的突變變異模式，旨在根據蛋白質編碼基因對突變變異數（$V_m$）的預期貢獻進行排序。結果 我們估算出每個核苷酸位點每世代的突變率為 $\mu = 3.49 \times 10^{-9}$。適配度檢定（$\chi^2_{13} = 10.97, P = 0.61$）顯示，每個世代的新突變數量遵循卜瓦松分佈（$\lambda = 6.22$）。基於讀段（read-based）的定相方法揭示了強烈的性別偏向，雄性貢獻的突變數量約為雌性的兩倍。微小染色體的突變率點估計值比大型染色體高出約 8%，這可能歸因於它們較高的 GC 含量以及以 C→T 轉換為主導的突變譜。由此突變譜出發，我們建立了密碼子轉換矩陣，並表明基因根據密碼子組成在突變傾向上有很大差異，這可能反映了它們對 $V_m$ 貢獻的巨大差異。具體而言，我們發現參與免疫和發育的基因在最易發生非同義突變的基因中名列前茅。結論 我們的結果揭示了基因層面突變變異的可預測模式，並為預測新突變如何產生功能性變異提供了框架。透過連結量化遺傳學與分子生物學，我們為整個基因組中 $V_m$ 變異提供了機械式的基礎，表明 $V_m$ 的異質性可源自基因特異性特徵，特別是密碼子組成和突變標靶大小。這些指標提供了一種方法，可根據從頭突變（de novo mutation）對生物功能的預期貢獻來對基因進行排序並對遺傳變異進行優先排序。這為育種族群中遺傳變異的知情管理以及理解功能重要基因的演化動態提供了新的基礎。

papers.title: Rethinking poultry production: innovations, challenges, and pathways to a sustainable future
papers.abstract: SUMMARYAs global demand for poultry continues to rise, sustainable practices in poultry production have become an urgent priority to reduce the sector’s environmental footprint. While poultry is among the most efficient animal protein sources, significant environmental challenges remain, particularly regarding resource efficiency, energy use, waste management, and emissions. This review provides an integrated analysis of sustainable poultry production by combining environmental, technological, and regional perspectives. Feed production contributes approximately 60 to 70% of the environmental footprint of poultry systems, while improvements in feed conversion ratio (FCR) and precision nutrition offer substantial opportunities for resource optimisation. The review evaluates key innovations, including alternative protein sources, energy-efficient systems, carbon reduction strategies, and improved waste management practices. It also examines global and regional sustainability challenges, particularly climate change impacts and adaptive strategies across diverse production systems. While emerging solutions such as renewable energy integration, precision farming, and genetic advancements show strong potential, their large-scale implementation remains constrained by economic and regulatory factors. This review identifies priority pathways, including feed system transformation, circular resource management, and climate-resilient production strategies, as essential for achieving sustainable and resilient poultry production systems.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要

隨著全球對家禽的需求持續上升，家禽生產的可持續實踐已成為減少該產業環境足跡的當務之急。儘管家禽是最具效率的動物蛋白質來源之一，但仍面臨顯著的環境挑戰，特別是在資源效率、能源使用、廢棄物管理和排放方面。本綜述結合環境、技術與區域觀點，對可持續家禽生產進行了綜合分析。飼料生產約佔家禽系統環境足跡的 60% 至 70%，而飼料轉換率（FCR）的改善與精準營養則為資源最佳化提供了巨大的機會。本綜述評估了關鍵創新，包括替代蛋白質來源、節能系統、減碳策略以及改進的廢棄物管理實踐。同時，亦探討了全球與區域性的可持續性挑戰，特別是氣候變遷的影響以及不同生產系統中的調適策略。儘管諸如再生能源整合、精準農業和基因改良等新興解決方案展現出強大的潛力，但其大規模實施仍受限於經濟與法規因素。本綜述指出了優先發展的路徑，包括飼料系統轉型、循環資源管理以及具氣候韌性的生產策略，這些皆為實現可持續且具韌性的家禽生產系統不可或缺的要素。

papers.title: In Ovo Folic Acid Injection Modulates Hatchability, Hematobiochemical Profiles, Immune Status, and Intestinal Histomorphology of Day-Old Broiler Chicks
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of in ovo folic acid administration on hatchability, physiological profiles, and intestinal development in day-old Cobb broiler chicks. A total of 600 embryonated eggs were assigned to five treatments: an uninjected control, a saline control, and three folic acid levels (50, 100, and 150 µg/egg) injected into the amnion on day 18 of incubation. Folic acid administration significantly improved hatchability, with 50 and 100 µg/egg achieving higher rates (98.83% and 99.45%) than the control (98.06%; p = 0.0405), alongside a linear increase in chick length (p = 0.0097). In contrast, egg weight, chick weight, and chick yield were unaffected (p > 0.05). Folic acid stimulated linear increases in the relative weight of the bursa of Fabricius, total white blood cells, lymphocytes, and serum IgM concentrations (p < 0.05). Erythrocyte counts, hemoglobin, and packed cell volume also increased linearly (p ≤ 0.0003). Serum biochemical profiling revealed linear increases in total protein, albumin, and thyroid hormones (T3 and T4), alongside linear declines in glucose, cholesterol, and creatinine (p ≤ 0.0028). Additionally, folic acid supplementation reduced serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT). Systemic oxidative stress was reduced, marked by decreased malondialdehyde (MDA) and enhanced total antioxidant capacity (TAC) and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) activity (p < 0.05), peaking at 100 µg/egg. Furthermore, intestinal villus height, crypt depth, and surface area were significantly increased (p ≤ 0.0003), peaking at 100–150 µg/egg. Collectively, these findings indicate that in ovo folic acid supplementation supports physiological adaptation during the peri-hatch period and promotes intestinal development in newly hatched broiler chicks. It is recommended that modern hatcheries utilize an optimal dosage within the range of 100 to 150 µg/egg during late incubation to maximize hatchability, immune function, antioxidant defenses, and gut absorptive capacity.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了胚胎內（in ovo）注射葉酸對剛孵化之 Cobb 肉雞之孵化率、生理特性及腸道發育的影響。試驗共使用 600 枚受精蛋，隨機分配至五個處理組：未注射對照組、生理食鹽水對照組，以及於孵化第 18 天注射三種不同劑量葉酸（分別為每枚雞蛋 50、100 及 150 µg）至羊膜中。結果顯示，葉酸注射顯著改善了孵化率，其中 50 與 100 µg/egg 組的孵化率（98.83% 與 99.45%）高於對照組（98.06%；p = 0.0405），同時雛雞身長也呈線性增加（p = 0.0097）。相對地，蛋重、雛雞重及雛雞孵化率（chick yield）則不受影響（p > 0.05）。葉酸刺激了法氏囊相對重量、總白血球數、淋巴細胞及血清 IgM 濃度的線性增加（p < 0.05）。紅血球計數、血紅素及紅血球容積比亦呈線性增加（p ≤ 0.0003）。血清生化分析顯示，總蛋白、白蛋白及甲狀腺荷爾蒙（T3 與 T4）呈線性增加，而血糖、膽固醇及肌酸酐則呈線性下降（p ≤ 0.0028）。此外，葉酸補充降低了血清天門冬胺酸轉胺酶（AST）與丙胺酸轉胺酶（ALT）的濃度。全身性氧化壓力獲得緩減，表現為丙二醛（MDA）降低，且總抗氧化能力（TAC）及麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px）活性增強（p < 0.05），並在 100 µg/egg 組達到峰值。再者，腸道絨毛高度、隱窩深度及表面積均顯著增加（p ≤ 0.0003），並於 100–150 µg/egg 組達到峰值。綜上所述，這些結果表明，胚胎內補充葉酸有助於支持圍孵化期（peri-hatch period）的生理適應，並促進剛孵化肉雞的腸道發育。建議現代孵化場在孵化後期使用 100 至 150 µg/egg 範圍內的最佳劑量，以最大化孵化率、免疫功能、抗氧化防禦及腸道吸收能力。

papers.title: Egg Morphology as a Phenotypic Indicator of Chick Sex and Early Growth in Thai Native Chickens
papers.abstract: Egg morphological characteristics have been associated with hatchability, chick quality, and sex-related variation; however, their relationships with juvenile growth in indigenous chickens remain unclear. This study evaluated associations among egg morphology, hatch weight, chick sex, and early growth in Thai native Pradu Hang Dum chickens. A total of 139 chicks were evaluated for egg length, egg width, egg weight, eggshell surface area, shape index, hatch weight, body weight, and chest circumference. Pearson correlation, multiple linear regression, logistic regression, receiver operating characteristic analysis, and exploratory path analysis were applied. Egg length was positively associated with body weight and chest circumference at 8 weeks, whereas shape index was negatively associated with both traits. Egg weight was strongly correlated with hatch weight (r = 0.721, p < 0.001). After adjustment for chick sex, egg weight and shape index were not independently associated with body weight at 8 weeks, whereas sex showed a strong association; the model explained 41.0% of the observed variation. For chest circumference, shape index and sex remained significant, and the model explained 18.0% of the variation. Logistic regression showed significant associations between egg morphometric traits and chick sex, with similar within-sample discrimination for shape index alone (AUC = 0.808) and the model combining egg length and width (AUC = 0.814). Exploratory path analysis showed significant paths from egg weight to hatch weight, hatch weight to 8-week body weight, sex to 8-week body weight, and 8-week body weight to chest circumference. Overall, egg morphology provided population-specific phenotypic information associated with chick sex and early development, but its independent value for explaining juvenile growth was limited after accounting for sexual dimorphism.
papers.abstract_zh: 雞蛋形態特徵與孵化率、雛鳥品質及性別相關變異有關；然而，其與本土雞隻幼期生長之間的關係仍不清楚。本研究評估了泰國原生黑尾土雞（Pradu Hang Dum）的蛋形態、孵化重、雛鳥性別與早期生長之間的關聯。共評估了 139 隻雛鳥的蛋長、蛋寬、蛋重、蛋殼表面積、形狀指數、孵化重、體重與胸圍。應用了皮爾森相關分析、多元線性迴歸、邏輯斯迴歸、受試者工作特徵曲線分析及探索性路徑分析。蛋長與 8 週齡的體重和胸圍呈正相關，而形狀指數則與這兩個性狀呈負相關。蛋重與孵化重高度相關（$r = 0.721, p < 0.001$）。在調整雛鳥性別後，蛋重與形狀指數與 8 週齡體重無獨立相關性，而性別則顯示出強烈的關聯；該模型解釋了觀察到的變異之 41.0%。就胸圍而言，形狀指數與性別仍具顯著性，且該模型解釋了 18.0% 的變異。邏輯斯迴歸顯示蛋形態測定性狀與雛鳥性別之間具有顯著關聯，僅使用形狀指數（$\text{AUC} = 0.808$）與結合蛋長和蛋寬的模型（$\text{AUC} = 0.814$）在樣本內具有相似的鑑別力。探索性路徑分析顯示，顯著的路徑包含從蛋重到孵化重、孵化重到 8 週齡體重、性別到 8 週齡體重，以及 8 週齡體重到胸圍。總體而言，蛋形態提供了與雛鳥性別和早期發育相關的族群特異性表現型資訊，但在考量性別二型性後，其解釋幼期生長的獨立價值有限。

papers.title: Preliminary Tolerability Assessment of Continuous Dietary Meloxicam in Broilers
papers.abstract: The anti-inflammatory activity of antimicrobial growth promoters (AGPs) has been proposed as one mechanism contributing to their beneficial effects on broiler performance, raising interest in pharmacological modulation of inflammation as a non-antibiotic strategy. This proof-of-concept dose-escalation study evaluated the safety of prolonged dietary exposure to meloxicam (MLX) and explored its effects on performance. Seventy one-day-old male Cobb 500 broilers were allocated to five treatments (n = 14): basal diet (BD), BD supplemented with 55 ppm zinc bacitracin (ZB), or MLX at 0.4, 1.2, or 3.6 mg/kg body weight. Birds were monitored for 42 days, with growth performance, hematology, serum biochemistry, and histopathology evaluated. No consistent treatment-related hematological alterations occurred, and serum biochemistry was unaffected at day 21. At day 42, MLX produced dose-related changes in albumin, calculated globulin, and alanine aminotransferase, while alkaline phosphatase showed a quadratic response. Feed intake differed at selected time points, but MLX did not consistently alter growth performance. Performance also did not differ from the ZB. No apparent treatment-related patterns of histopathological lesions were identified in the birds examined. No overt toxicity was detected under the conditions and sample sizes evaluated, although selected biochemical responses at day 42 warrant further investigation. These preliminary findings support studies with defined inflammatory challenges and specific pharmacodynamic markers but do not establish the safety or growth-promoting efficacy of prolonged dietary MLX administration.
papers.abstract_zh: 抗菌生長促進劑（AGP）的抗發炎活性被認為是其促進肉雞生效率機制之一，這引發了人們對利用抗發炎藥理調節作為非抗生素策略的興趣。本概念驗證劑量遞增研究旨在評估長期飲食攝取美洛昔康（meloxicam, MLX）的安全性，並探討其對生效率的影響。將七十隻一日齡Cobb 500雄性肉雞隨機分配至五個處理組（n = 14）：基礎日糧（BD）、添加 55 ppm 札尼克霉素（zinc bacitracin, ZB）之基礎日糧，以及添加 0.4、1.2 或 3.6 mg/kg 體重 MLX 之基礎日糧。試驗對肉雞進行了 42 天的監測，並評估其生長表現、血液學、血清生化值及組織病理學。在試驗期間未觀察到與處理相關的一致性血液學改變，且在第 21 天時血清生化值未受影響。在第 42 天時，MLX 引起了白蛋白、計算出的球蛋白和丙胺酸轉胺酶呈劑量相關的變化，而鹼性磷酸酶則呈二次方反應。攝食量在特定時間點有所不同，但 MLX 並未持續改變生長表現。生長表現與 ZB 組亦無顯異。在所檢視的雞隻中，未發現明顯與處理相關的組織病理學病變模式。在所評估的條件和樣本量下，未檢出明顯的毒性，儘管在第 42 天時觀察到的部分生化反應仍需進一步探討。這些初步結果支持以明確的發炎挑戰和特定藥效學標記進行的研究，但並未確立長期在飲食中投予 MLX 的安全性或促進生長的功效。

papers.title: Former Foodstuff-Based Diets on the Quality and Sensory Properties of Eggs from Laying Hens
papers.abstract: In recent years, former food products (FFPs) have been gaining attention as alternative feed ingredients for more sustainable production systems. This study evaluated the impact of including FFPs on the quality of eggs produced by laying hens. A total of 180 Lohmann Brown® hens were divided into three groups and fed a control diet (CON), a diet containing 20% FFPs (T20), and a diet containing 40% FFPs (T40). Eggs, collected between 31 and 33 weeks of age, were evaluated for physical, chemical, and sensory characteristics. Egg weight, shape index, yolk and albumen weight, and edible portion were comparable (p > 0.05) among the groups. Moreover, shell thickness, shell weight, and shell proportion were unaffected (p > 0.05) by dietary treatments. Yolk color was affected by FFP inclusion, with reduced (p < 0.05) yellowness in the supplemented groups, likely due to the lower dietary xanthophyll content resulting from the partial replacement of corn. The inclusion of FFPs had limited effects on the sensory quality of the eggs, with differences (p < 0.05) in yolk color and albumen texture. These findings highlight the potential of FFPs as a viable feed ingredient in laying hen diets. Further research is needed to confirm their applicability in different diets and farming conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年來，食品加工副產物（former food products, FFPs）作為實現更具永續性生產系統的替代飼料原料，備受關注。本研究評估了在產蛋雞日糧中添加 FFPs 對產蛋品質的影響。試驗共選用 180 隻羅曼褐（Lohmann Brown®）產蛋雞，隨機分為三組，分別餵食對照日糧（CON）、添加 20% FFPs 的日糧（T20）以及添加 40% FFPs 的日糧（T40）。收集雞隻 31 至 33 週齡產下的雞蛋，並評估其物理、化學及感官特性。結果顯示，各組間的蛋重、形狀指數、蛋黃與蛋白重量以及可食部分均無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。此外，日糧處理對蛋殼厚度、蛋殼重量及蛋殼比例也沒有顯著影響（p > 0.05）。FFPs 的添加影響了蛋黃顏色，補充組的黃色度降低（p < 0.05），這可能歸因於部分替代玉米導致日糧中葉黃素含量降低。FFPs 的添加對雞蛋感官品質的影響有限，僅在蛋黃顏色和蛋白質地上觀察到差異（p < 0.05）。這些研究結果突顯了 FFPs 作為產蛋雞日糧中可行飼料原料的潛力。未來仍需進一步研究，以確認其在不同日糧和飼養條件下的適用性。

papers.title: Familial Robertsonian Translocation Involving Two Autosomes in Swiss Entlebucher Mountain Dogs
papers.abstract: In domestic animals, chromosomal aberrations are well-documented causes of disorders that result in impaired fertility, malformations, and economic losses. The chromosomes of an alleged sub-fertile bitch of the Entlebucher mountain dog breed should be checked for such aberrations. Metaphase chromosomes were prepared from short-term lymphocyte cultures and microscopically analyzed for numeric or gross structural abnormalities using chromosome banding and chromosome painting probes. The analyses showed that the bitch was a carrier for a Robertsonian translocation involving chromosome 1 and a very small autosome, that could not be identified. The same aberration was detected in three related dogs including a rare case of homozygosity. Human carriers of Robertsonian translocations usually appear normal but seem to have a risk for offspring with genetic imbalances. Much less is known about the consequences of Robertsonian translocations in dogs. Nevertheless, it is of the utmost importance to identify dogs with chromosomal abnormalities and exclude them from breeding in order to prevent the transmission to the next generations. Therefore, the chromosomes of dogs with reproduction problems should always be checked for abnormalities in order to strengthen breeding programs and improve animal welfare.
papers.abstract_zh: 在家畜中，染色體變異是導致生育力受損、畸形和經濟損失等疾病的有據可查之原因。本研究旨在檢查一隻疑似生育力低下的恩特布赫山犬（Entlebucher mountain dog）母犬是否帶有此類染色體變異。透過短期淋巴球培養製備中期分裂染色體，並利用染色體分帶與染色體塗染探針，進行數目或巨觀結構異常的顯微鏡分析。分析結果顯示，該母犬為涉及第 1 號染色體及一個無法識別之極小型體染色體的羅伯森轉位（Robertsonian translocation）帶原者。在另外三隻相關犬隻中也檢測到相同的變異，其中包括一個罕見的純合子案例。人類的羅伯森轉位帶原者通常表現正常，但似乎帶有生育遺傳失衡後代的風險。關於犬隻羅伯森轉位後果的了解則相對較少。然而，識別出具有染色體異常的犬隻並將其排除於繁殖之外，以防止傳遞給下一代，至關重要。因此，對於有生殖問題的犬隻，應始終檢查其染色體是否異常，以強化育種計畫並改善動物福祉。

papers.title: Corn Stover Replacement with Quercus rugosa Woody Biomass: Growth Performance, Carcass Characteristics, and Meat Quality of Finishing Lambs
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the growth performance, blood metabolites, carcass characteristics, meat quality, and economic responses of finishing lambs fed diets in which condensed tannin-containing woody biomass (CTWB) from Quercus rugosa partially or completely replaced corn stover (CS) in the fibrous fraction. Forty-eight intact male Dorper × Katahdin lambs (initial body weight: 33.01 ± 1.23 kg), housed in 24 pens with two lambs per pen, received diets containing 0, 8, 16, or 24% CTWB (CTWB-0, CTWB-8, CTWB-16, and CTWB-24, respectively) for 42 d during 2013–2014. The 24% inclusion level replaced all the CS and supplied a calculated contribution of 6.29 g of condensed tannins/kg dry matter (DM) from CTWB. Dry-matter intake (DMI) was greater with CTWB-24 than with CTWB-0 and CTWB-16 (1.34 vs. 1.17 and 1.18 kg DM/d, respectively; p = 0.021). Growth and gain-to-feed ratio did not differ among treatments (p ≥ 0.240). Blood urea nitrogen concentrations were lower with CTWB-24 than with CTWB-8 (p = 0.014). Carcass weights did not differ (p ≥ 0.779), nor did cooling loss or dressing percentage (p = 0.459 and 0.060, respectively). An overall treatment effect was observed for muscle a* (p = 0.049), without differences between individual treatments; dorsal fat b* did not differ (p = 0.051), nor did water loss, pH, or shear-force measurements (p ≥ 0.103). Calculated diet cost decreased from 0.301 to 0.282 USD/kg DM between CTWB-0 and CTWB-24, but this reduction did not translate into lower total feed cost per lamb (p = 0.150). Carcass income and income over feed cost (IOFC) also did not differ (p ≥ 0.895); IOFC was 205.56 and 202.21 USD/lamb, respectively. Complete replacement of CS with 24% CTWB was accompanied by greater DMI, while no significant differences were detected in growth, carcass weight, or IOFC in this trial with six pens assigned per treatment. These findings do not establish equivalence among diets, and the limited replication means that biologically relevant differences cannot be ruled out.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了肉羊在日糧中以含縮合單寧的紅櫟（Quercus rugosa）木質生質物（CTWB）部分或完全取代纖維組分中的玉米秸稈（CS）時，其生長性能、血液代謝物、屠體特性、肉質與經濟效益之反應。試驗選用48隻完整的杜泊×卡塔丁公羊（初始體重：33.01 ± 1.23 kg），飼養於24間羊欄中（每欄2隻），於2013至2014年間分別餵食含有0%、8%、16%或24% CTWB之日糧（分別為 CTWB-0、CTWB-8、CTWB-16 與 CTWB-24），試驗期為42天。24%的添加水準取代了所有的 CS，且經計算由 CTWB 提供了每公斤乾物質（DM）6.29 克的縮合單寧。CTWB-24 組的乾物質採食量（DMI）高於 CTWB-0 與 CTWB-16 組（分別為 1.34 對 1.17 與 1.18 kg DM/d；p = 0.021）。各處理組間的生長性能與增重飼料比則無顯異（p ≥ 0.240）。CTWB-24 組的血液尿素氮濃度低於 CTWB-8 組（p = 0.014）。屠體重無顯著差異（p ≥ 0.779），冷卻損失與屠宰率亦然（分別為 p = 0.459 與 0.060）。肌肉的紅度（a* 值）觀察到整體處理效應（p = 0.049），但個別處理組間無顯著差異；背部脂肪的黃度（b* 值）無顯著差異（p = 0.051），滴水損失、pH 值或剪切力測定亦同（p ≥ 0.103）。計算之日糧成本從 CTWB-0 的 0.301 美元/kg DM 下降至 CTWB-24 的 0.282 美元/kg DM，但此降低並未轉化為每隻羊較低的總飼料成本（p = 0.150）。屠體收益與扣除飼料成本後之收益（IOFC）亦無顯著差異（p ≥ 0.895）；IOFC 分別為 205.56 與 202.21 美元/隻。在此每處理分配6欄的試驗中，以 24% CTWB 完全取代 CS 伴隨著較高的 DMI，但在生長、屠體重或 IOFC 方面未檢測出顯著差異。這些發現並未確立各日糧之間的等效性，且有限的重複次數意味著無法排除具生物學相關性的差異。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide Characterization of Heterozygosity‐Rich Regions in Kazakh Native Sheep Breeds
papers.abstract: Heterozygosity‐rich regions (HRR) are genomic segments characterized by high heterozygosity that may arise from admixture, introgression, or balancing selection and may harbor loci associated with adaptation and fitness‐related traits. This study aimed to characterize HRR patterns in five Kazakh sheep breeds using a publicly available OvineSNP50 genotyping dataset. After quality control, ~25 000 SNPs were retained for 1634 Akzhaiyk, 1089 Edilbay, 532 Kazakh Fine‐Wool, 932 Kazakh Semi‐Coarse, and 282 Saryarka sheep. HRR were detected separately in each breed using the sliding‐window approach in detectRUNS R package, with a minimum segment length of 250 kb, at least 10 SNPs per window and segment, and a maximum of two opposing homozygous and one missing SNP per window. The average number of HRR per individual ranged from 40.75 ± 6.38 in Saryarka to 54.75 ± 7.34 in Kazakh Fine‐Wool sheep. HRR lengths ranged from 259.07 kb to 3.26 Mb, with an average of 0.7 Mb across breeds. Seventeen HRR islands, defined as regions shared by HRR in at least 25% of individuals within a breed, were identified, including regions on chromosomes 8 and 17 shared across all breeds. Genes overlapping these islands were associated with cellular homeostasis, immunity, metabolism, growth, and stress response, while the HRR islands overlapped with QTL associated with health, wool characteristics, and reproduction. These findings highlight the potential of HRR analysis to identify candidate genomic regions relevant to adaptation and economically important traits, providing insights for the conservation and genetic improvement of Kazakh sheep populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 富含雜合性區域（Heterozygosity‐rich regions, HRR）是以高雜合性為特徵的基因組片段，可能源自基因滲入、滲透或平衡選擇，並可能包含與適應及適應度相關性狀關聯的位點。本研究旨在利用公開可得的 OvineSNP50 基因型資料集，表徵五個哈薩克綿羊品種中的 HRR 模式。經過品質控制後，分別保留了 1634 隻阿克扎伊克綿羊（Akzhaiyk）、1089 隻埃迪爾拜綿羊（Edilbay）、532 隻哈薩克細毛羊（Kazakh Fine‐Wool）、932 隻哈薩克半粗毛羊（Kazakh Semi‐Coarse）以及 282 隻薩雷阿拉克綿羊（Saryarka）的大約 25,000 個 SNP。使用 detectRUNS R 套件中的滑動視窗方法，在各品種中分別偵測 HRR，最小片段長度設定為 250 kb，每個視窗和片段至少包含 10 個 SNP，每個視窗最多允許兩個相反的純合子 SNP 和一個缺失的 SNP。每個個體的平均 HRR 數量從薩雷阿拉克綿羊的 40.75 ± 6.38 到哈薩克細毛羊的 54.75 ± 7.34 不等。HRR 長度介於 259.07 kb 至 3.26 Mb 之間，各品種的平均長度為 0.7 Mb。共鑑定出 17 個 HRR 熱點區（定義為在品種內至少 25% 的個體中共享的 HRR 區域），其中包括跨所有品種共享的第 8 號和第 17 號染色體上的區域。與這些熱點區重疊的基因與細胞恆定、免疫、代謝、生長和壓力反應相關，同時這些 HRR 熱點區與和健康、羊毛特性及繁殖相關的 QTL 重疊。這些發現凸顯了 HRR 分析在識別與適應及經濟重要性狀相關的候選基因組區域方面的潛力，為哈薩克綿羊族群的保育和遺傳改良提供了見解。

papers.title: In Vitro Pre-Cecal Digestion and Cecal Degradation of Pea Hulls, Artichoke Bracts, Date Flesh, and Date Pits for Rabbit Nutrition
papers.abstract: Rising feed costs and the need for more sustainable livestock production have increased interest in co-products as alternative feed resources for rabbits. However, their nutritional value may be underestimated when evaluated only through pre-cecal enzymatic digestion, without considering cecal degradation. This study comparatively characterized pea hulls, artichoke bracts, date flesh, and date pits (three independent sources each, n = 3) and evaluated their nutritional potential using a sequential in vitro procedure combining pre-cecal enzymatic digestion with cecal degradation. Date flesh, characterized by high non-fibrous carbohydrate and low fiber, showed the highest pre-cecal enzymatic dry matter and organic matter digestibility (89.44% and 89.58%, respectively), with minimal additional contribution from cecal degradation. Pea hulls contained the highest crude protein (24.97% of dry matter) and showed high additional degradation of structural carbohydrates during the cecal phase, reaching cumulative neutral detergent fiber and acid detergent fiber digestibility (47.18% and 41.90%, respectively). Artichoke bracts showed moderate pre-cecal enzymatic digestibility and substantial additional utilization during cecal degradation. Date pits had the highest fiber, lignin, and tannin concentrations and the lowest pre-cecal enzymatic digestibility, although cecal degradation partially improved their nutrient utilization. Overall, these in vitro results suggest that cecal degradation can contribute substantially to the digestibility of residual structural carbohydrates in fiber co-products.
papers.abstract_zh: 飼料成本不斷上升以及對更具永續性之畜產的需求，增加了人們對將副產物作為家兔替代飼料資源的興趣。然而，若僅透過迴盲瓣前（pre-cecal）酵素消化進行評估，而未考量盲腸降解作用，其營養價值可能會被低估。本研究比較了豌豆殼、朝鮮薊總苞片、棗肉和棗核（每種各三個獨立來源，n = 3）的特性，並使用結合迴盲瓣前酵素消化與盲腸降解的依序體外程序，評估其營養潛力。棗肉具有高非纖維性碳水化合物與低纖維之特徵，顯示出最高的迴盲瓣前酵素乾物質與有機物質消化率（分別為 89.44% 和 89.58%），而盲腸降解所提供的額外貢獻極少。豌豆殼含有最高之粗蛋白質（占乾物質的 24.97%），並在盲腸階段表現出結構性碳水化合物的高度額外降解，其累積中性洗劑纖維與酸性洗劑纖維消化率分別達到 47.18% 和 41.90%。朝鮮薊總苞片顯示出中等的迴盲瓣前酵素消化率，並在盲腸降解期間有顯著的額外利用。棗核則具有最高的纖維、木質素和單寧濃度以及最低的迴盲瓣前酵素消化率，儘管盲腸降解部分改善了其營養利用率。總體而言，這些體外結果顯示，盲腸降解能對纖維副產物中殘餘結構性碳水化合物的消化率產生顯著的貢獻。

papers.title: Gene editing technologies in poultry: advances, applications, and future prospects
papers.abstract: SUMMARYThe chicken is an important model organism for research and a major global source of animal protein (eggs and meat). Recently developed genome-editing technologies have allowed the production of genetically engineered animals for agriculture and food production. Genome editing in chicken is a promising approach to enhance growth, disease resistance, productivity, and welfare traits. In this review, we explore the recent progress of gene-editing technologies in poultry production, such as CRISPR/Cas9 and base editing. Genome editing in poultry has been applied to improve traits, analyse gene function and boost resistance to disease. While significant progress has been made, there are still bottlenecks in the scaling up and regulatory approval of gene-edited poultry. This review highlights the latest developments in genome editing technologies and discusses ethical, regulatory and biosafety issues, such as animal welfare, food safety and environmental risks.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
雞是重要的研究模式生物，也是全球動物蛋白質（蛋與肉類）的主要來源。近期發展的基因編輯技術使得生產用於農業與食品生產的基因改造動物成為可能。在家禽中進行基因編輯是提升生長、抗病力、生產力與福利性狀的前瞻性方法。在本篇綜論中，我們探討了基因編輯技術在家禽生產中的最新進展，例如 CRISPR/Cas9 與鹼基編輯。家禽的基因編輯已被應用於改良性狀、分析基因功能以及增強對疾病的抵抗力。儘管已取得顯著進展，但在基因編輯家禽的規模化生產與法規批准方面仍存在瓶頸。本篇綜論重點介紹了基因編輯技術的最新發展，並探討了倫理、法規與生物安全等議題，例如動物福利、食品安全與環境風險。

papers.title: Dietary inclusion of a fermented rapeseed–seaweed blend alters immunity and intestinal microbial activity but not Ascaridia galli burden in laying hens
papers.abstract: 1. Dietary components that are pre-fermented with lactic acid bacteria have recently attracted attention and may positively affect performance and gut health in poultry. This study investigated whether a commercial feed ingredient (EP199), containing fermented rapeseed meal, wheat bran and seaweed, could control worm burden, intestinal microbiota profiles and intestinal fermentation patterns, as well as immune profiles of layers infected with Ascaridia galli.2. A total of 192, 20 week old Bovans Brown laying hens were randomly allocated into four treatment groups; control diet vs. EP199 diet and experimentally infected (EXP) vs. naturally infected (NAT). The EP199 diet partly replaced rapeseed cake at 6%. The infected hens were either naturally exposed to A. galli contaminated litter or received oral administration of 764 embryonated A. galli eggs per hen at 20 weeks of age for 12 weeks.3. Performance was unaffected by EP199 or infection. However, hens fed the EP199 diet had a significantly lower egg production 3-12 weeks post-infection (pi) compared to the control group (86.1% vs. 90.1%, P=0.044). There was no effect on intestinal worm burden (x=7.98 worms per hen) or immune competence, as assessed by mitogen activation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC). Despite similar nutrient profiles of the two diets, the hens fed the EP199 diet had significantly higher caecal levels of specific short chain fatty acids: acetic acid (79.8 vs. 71.0 mmol/kg digesta; P=0.020), propionic acid (35.0 vs. 30.1 mmol/kg digesta; P=0.005) and n-butyric acid (17.3 vs. 14.7 mmol/kg digesta; P=0.015).4. Compared to the control group, hens fed EP199 had a lower humoral A. galli-specific immune response, in terms of IgY serum titres at 10 weeks (2812 vs. 5291; P=0.002) and 12 weeks (10546 vs. 17668; P=0.025) pi. Hens fed the EP199 diet showed a significantly higher frequency of activated CD4+CD8+ T cells (28.7% vs. 21.9%; P=0.045).5. Feeding EP199 at 6% did not have an effect on severity of A. galli infection. However, EP199 showed an immunomodulatory effect and altered caecal microbial activity. Infection method (experimental vs. natural) influenced both the worm burden and immune parameters.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 經乳酸菌預發酵的飲食成分近年來備受關注，其可能對家禽的生產性能和腸道健康產生正面影響。本研究旨在探討一種包含發酵油菜籽粕、小麥麩皮和海藻的商業飼料原料（EP199），是否能控制感染雞蛔蟲（Ascaridia galli）之產蛋雞的蟲體負荷量、腸道微生物相概況、腸道發酵模式以及免疫概況。

2. 本試驗共使用192隻20週齡的Bovans Brown產蛋雞，隨機分配至四個處理組：對照飼料組對比EP199飼料組，以及試驗感染（EXP）對比自然感染（NAT）。EP199飼料以6%的比例部分取代油菜籽餅。感染組的母雞於20週齡起，分別自然暴露於受A. galli汙染的墊料中，或每隻母雞經口投予764個具感染力的A. galli蟲卵，持續12週。

3. 生產性能不受EP199或感染的影響。然而，與對照組相比，餵食EP199飼料的母雞在感染後（pi）3至12週的產蛋率顯著較低（86.1% 對比 90.1%，P=0.044）。透過周邊血液單核細胞（PBMC）的有絲分裂原活化評估，腸道蟲體負荷量（x=7.98 隻蟲/每隻母雞）或免疫能力均未受影響。儘管兩種飼料的營養成分相近，但餵食EP199飼料的母雞其盲腸中特定短鏈脂肪酸濃度顯著較高：乙酸（79.8 對比 71.0 mmol/kg 食糜；P=0.020）、丙酸（35.0 對比 30.1 mmol/kg 食糜；P=0.005）及正丁酸（17.3 對比 14.7 mmol/kg 食糜；P=0.015）。

4. 與對照組相比，餵食EP199的母雞在感染後第10週（2812 對比 5291；P=0.002）與第12週（10546 對比 17668；P=0.025）之血清A. galli特異性IgY效價較低，顯示其體液免疫反應較低。餵食EP199飼料的母雞表現出顯著較高的活化型CD4+CD8+ T細胞頻率（28.7% 對比 21.9%；P=0.045）。

5. 以6%比例餵食EP199對A. galli感染的嚴重程度沒有影響。然而，EP199顯示出免疫調節作用並改變了盲腸微生物活性。感染方法（試驗感染對比自然感染）同時影響了蟲體負荷量與免疫參數。

papers.title: Decoding the lncRNA landscape in bovine mastitis: insights into immune regulation and gene networks underlying host response
papers.abstract: Background Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are critical regulatory elements of gene expression and play a crucial role in immune regulation of disease, such as bovine mastitis. With this study we evaluated expression profile of lncRNAs in subclinical intramammary infection (sIMI) from two pathogens: Streptococcus agalactiae ( S. agalactiae ; Sa+) and Prototheca spp. (P+) and predicted their interaction with protein coding genes in 31 Holstein cows. Quantitative trait loci (QTL) annotation and enrichment analysis was carried out on the lncRNAs partner genes for a comprehensive overview of their potential association with phenotypic traits. Finally, Partial Correlation and Information Theory (PCIT) and Regulatory Impact Factor (RIF) algorithms were adopted to assess co-expression network of differentially expressed lncRNAs (DELs) and genes (DEGs). Results A total of 211, 146, 353 and 184 DELs were identified when comparing Sa+ vs. Neg, P+ vs. Neg, Sa+ vs. P+, and uninfected vs. infected animals (Mast vs. Neg), respectively. Most of these DELs were mainly located within genic regions, and 78% had not been previously annotated in the bovine reference genome. Overall S. agalactiae infection modulated both immune and metabolic pathways (lipid metabolism, extracellular matrix synthesis), whereas Prototheca spp. infection activated immune signaling networks (B-cell and innate immunity). Unique lncRNAs induced by Sa+ were predicted to target genes controlling fatty acid synthesis and milk fat QTLs, while P+-induced lncRNAs were found associated mostly with immune genes and somatic cell count QTLs. The co-expression network also revealed shared lncRNAs between the two types of infection suggesting a core response: both infections converge on common hub genes (e.g., EBF1 , BTLA ), indicating potential conserved host-defense mechanisms. Conclusions These results suggest that, despite distinct lncRNA expression patterns, the downstream regulatory pathways—particularly those linked to immune function—may converge toward a shared host response during subclinical intramammary infections. Together, these findings underscore the complexity of lncRNA-mediated regulation in the bovine mammary gland and highlight the need for functional studies to clarify the biological roles of these novel transcripts.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 長鏈非coding RNA（lncRNAs）是基因表現的關鍵調節元件，並在疾病的免疫調節中扮演至關重要的角色，例如牛乳房炎。本研究評估了來自兩種病原體：無乳鏈球菌（Streptococcus agalactiae，Sa+）與藻樣原體屬（Prototheca spp.，P+）引起的亞臨床乳房內感染（sIMI）中 lncRNAs 的表現圖譜，並預測其與 31 頭荷 Holstein 乳牛中蛋白質編碼基因的交互作用。對 lncRNA 伴侶基因進行了數量性狀基因座（QTL）註釋與富集分析，以全面了解其與表型性狀的潛在關聯。最後，採用偏相關與資訊理論（PCIT）以及調節影響因子（RIF）演算法來評估差異表現 lncRNAs（DELs）與基因（DEGs）的共表現網路。結果 在比較 Sa+ 對 Neg、P+ 對 Neg、Sa+ 對 P+ 以及未感染對感染動物（Mast 對 Neg）時，分別鑑定出總共 211、146、353 和 184 個 DELs。這些 DELs 大多位於基因區域內，且有 78% 尚未在牛隻參考基因組中被註釋。整體而言，無乳鏈球菌感染同時調節了免疫與代謝途徑（脂質代謝、細胞外基質合成），而藻樣原體屬感染則活化了免疫訊號傳遞網路（B 細胞與先天免疫）。預測由 Sa+ 誘導的獨特 lncRNAs 其標的為控制脂肪酸合成與乳脂 QTL 的基因，而 P+ 誘導的 lncRNAs 則被發現主要與免疫基因及體細胞數 QTL 有關。共表現網路也揭示了兩種感染之間共有的 lncRNAs，暗示了一種核心反應：這兩種感染皆匯聚於共同的樞紐基因（例如 EBF1、BTLA），顯示出潛在且保守的宿主防禦機制。結論 這些結果表明，儘管具有不同的 lncRNA 表現模式，但在亞臨床乳房內感染期間，下游調節途徑（特別是那些與免疫功能相關的途徑）可能會匯聚成共同的宿主反應。綜上所述，這些發現強調了牛乳房中 lncRNA 介導調節的複雜性，並突顯了進行功能性研究以闡明這些新穎轉錄本生物學角色的必要性。

papers.title: Postbiotics enhance immune competence in black rockfish (Sebastes schlegelii): linking innate immunity, apoptosis, and resistance to bacterial infection
papers.abstract: Background This study investigated the functional potential and safety of postbiotics derived from Latilactobacillus curvatus NBL2305 as a dietary feed additive for juvenile black rockfish ( Sebastes schlegelii ). Fish were fed diets supplemented with NBL2305-derived postbiotics, and their effects on growth performance, immune responses, antioxidant capacity, apoptosis-related gene expression, intestinal microbiota, and disease resistance were evaluated. Results Supplementation with postbiotics significantly improved growth performance and feed utilization, as indicated by increased weight gain and specific growth rate, along with a reduced feed conversion ratio. Innate immune responses were enhanced, as demonstrated by elevated activities of myeloperoxidase, superoxide dismutase, and lysozyme together with the upregulated expression of immune-related genes, including il8 , il1b , tnfa , tnfsf13b , and nfkb1 . In addition, postbiotic treatment modulated apoptosis-related gene expression in the liver, characterized by the downregulation of pro-apoptotic genes ( bax , tp53 , and casp3 ) and the upregulation of anti-apoptotic genes ( bcl2 and xiap ), indicating an anti-apoptotic gene expression profile. The postbiotics also exhibited strong antimicrobial activity against major fish pathogens and considerable antioxidant capacity. These functional effects were further supported by an in vivo challenge test, in which the postbiotic-fed group showed significantly higher survival following Edwardsiella tarda infection. No adverse effects were observed in serum biochemical parameters, somatic indices, or histopathological analyses, supporting the short-term safety of supplementation under the experimental conditions evaluated. Moreover, the intestinal microbiota composition remained stable, with selective enrichment of beneficial taxa. Conclusions Collectively, these findings demonstrate that NBL2305-derived postbiotics are safe and effective functional feed additives that enhance growth, modulated innate immune responses, and disease resistance in aquaculture species.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 本研究旨在探討源自彎曲乳桿菌（Latilactobacillus curvatus）NBL2305 的後生元（postbiotics）作為幼黑鯛（Sebastes schlegelii）飼料添加劑的功能潛力與安全性。試驗魚餵食添加了 NBL2305 衍生後生元的飼料，並評估其對生長表現、免疫反應、抗氧化能力、細胞凋亡相關基因表現、腸道菌相及抗病能力的影響。結果 添加後生元顯著改善了生長表現和飼料利用率，表現為增重與特定生長率增加，同時飼料轉換率降低。先天性免疫反應顯現出提升，髓過氧化酶、超氧化物歧化酶及溶菌酶的活性升高，且免疫相關基因（包含 *il8*、*il1b*、*tnfa*、*tnfsf13b* 與 *nfkb1*）的表現量亦上調。此外，後生元處理調節了肝臟中細胞凋亡相關基因的表現，其特徵為促凋亡基因（*bax*、*tp53* 與 *casp3*）表現下調，而抗凋亡基因（*bcl2* 與 *xiap*）表現上調，顯示出抗凋亡的基因表現譜。該後生元對主要魚類病原菌亦展現出強效的抗菌活性與顯著的抗氧化能力。這些功能性效果進一步獲得活體攻毒試驗的證實，在感染遲緩愛德華氏菌（*Edwardsiella tarda*）後，餵食後生元的組別顯示出顯著較高的存活率。在血清生化參數、形質指數或組織病理學分析中皆未觀察到不良影響，支持了在所評估之試驗條件下短期添加的安全性。此外，腸道菌相組成保持穩定，並有益菌群獲得選擇性富集。結論 總體而言，這些發現表明 NBL2305 衍生的後生元是安全且有效的功能性飼料添加劑，能促進水產養殖物種的生長、調節先天性免疫反應並提高抗病能力。

papers.title: Investigating the Relationship Between Hoof, Liver, and Cardiac Abnormalities in Bos taurus Grain-Fed Beef Cattle < 30 Months in a Natural Program with No Antibiotics or Growth Promotants
papers.abstract: Our primary objective was to determine the relationship between hoof, liver, and cardiac abnormalities in a group of natural-fed cattle at slaughter. Bos taurus beef cattle (N = 1312), without dairy phenotype, were evaluated for abnormalities at a slaughter establishment in the Great Plains region of the United States (elevation: 563 m). Cattle were enrolled in a vegetarian-fed program that prohibited implants, diet-included hormones, and beta-adrenergic agonists. Generalized linear mixed models were used to determine the prevalence of each abnormality within other abnormalities. There was no detectable difference (p ≥ 0.1630) to support an association between the proportion of cattle with each hoof score within each heart or liver score. Cattle with no liver abscesses were more prevalent (p = 0.0355) among cattle with normal cardiac morphology (Heart Score (HS)1) (94.37 ± 1.19% (mean ± SE)) than cattle with HS2 (very mild remodeling) (88.6 ± 1.42%). Further research is needed to understand this observed difference between two similar heart scores and to further explore contributing factors to these production diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究的主要目的是探討自然飼養肉牛在屠宰時蹄部、肝臟和心臟異常之間的關聯性。本研究評估了美國大平原地區（海拔：563公尺）一處屠宰場的肉用牛（Bos taurus）（N = 1312，不具乳牛表現型）之異常情況。這些牛隻納入一項禁止使用生長植入劑、飼料添加荷爾蒙及乙型受體促效劑的素食飼養計畫中。本研究採用廣義線性混合模型，以判定各項異常與其他異常之間的盛行率。結果顯示，並無可偵測的差異（p ≥ 0.1630）足以支持心臟或肝臟各評分中牛隻蹄部評分比例之間的關聯性。在心臟形態正常（心臟評分 [HS] 1）的牛隻中，無肝膿瘍的牛隻比例（94.37 ± 1.19% [平均值 ± 標準誤]）顯著高於具備 HS2（極輕微重塑）的牛隻（88.6 ± 1.42%）（p = 0.0355）。未來需要更多研究來釐清這兩個相近心臟評分之間所觀察到的差異，並進一步探討這些生產疾病的成因。

papers.title: Porcine Adenovirus-Based Viral Vectors for Swine Vaccines: A Scoping Review and Future Perspectives
papers.abstract: Porcine adenoviruses (PAdVs) are promising but still underdeveloped viral-vector platforms for swine vaccine development. Compared with human adenovirus-based vectors, PAdV vectors may offer potential advantages in host association, veterinary relevance, and mucosal delivery while avoiding direct reliance on common human adenovirus backbones. This review summarizes current knowledge on PAdV biology, vector engineering, vaccine applications, immune responses, translational challenges, and future priorities. Early studies showed that recombinant PAdV vectors can express heterologous antigens from important swine pathogens, including classical swine fever virus, pseudorabies virus, and transmissible gastroenteritis virus. The strongest direct proof-of-concept evidence comes from recombinant PAdV expressing classical swine fever virus E2/gp55, which induced neutralizing antibodies and protection in pigs. Comparative adenovirus-vectored swine vaccine studies support the broader feasibility of adenoviral antigen delivery for porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome, porcine epidemic diarrhea, swine influenza, and African swine fever, but these data should not be interpreted as direct validation of PAdV for these diseases. Major gaps remain in anti-PAdV immunity, genetic stability, biosafety, shedding, target-animal safety, DIVA compatibility, manufacturing, and regulatory readiness. Recent advances in PAdV-5 reverse genetics provide new opportunities for modern vector design.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬腺病毒（Porcine adenoviruses, PAdVs）是具潛力但發展尚不成熟的病毒載體平台，可用於開發豬用疫苗。與基於人類腺病毒的載體相比，PAdV載體在宿主相關性、獸醫學相關性及黏膜遞送方面可能具有潛在優勢，同時避免直接依賴常見的人類腺病毒骨架。本綜述總結了目前關於PAdV生物學、載體工程、疫苗應用、免疫反應、轉化挑戰及未來優先事項的知識。早期研究表明，重組PAdV載體能夠表現重要豬隻病原體的異源抗原，包括傳統豬瘟病毒、偽狂犬病病毒和傳染性胃腸炎病毒。最強而有力的直接概念驗證證據來自於表現傳統豬瘟病毒E2/gp55的重組PAdV，該載體能在豬隻體內誘導中和抗體與保護力。比較腺病毒載體豬用疫苗的研究支持了將腺病毒抗原遞送應用於豬繁殖與呼吸綜合症、豬流行性下痢、豬流行性感冒及非洲豬瘟的更廣泛可行性，但這些數據不應被解讀為PAdV針對這些疾病的直接驗證。在抗PAdV免疫力、基因穩定性、生物安全性、排毒、標靶動物安全性、DIVA相容性、製造工藝及法規準備度方面，仍存在重大缺口。PAdV-5反向 genética（反向遺傳學）的最新進展為現代載體設計提供了新契機。

papers.title: Dietary Chitosan Oligosaccharides Modulate Oxidative Status, Inflammatory and Apoptosis-Related Markers in Immune Organs of Heat-Stressed Broilers
papers.abstract: Chitosan oligosaccharides (COS) have antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities. This study characterized immune-organ responses associated with dietary COS in broilers exposed to cyclic heat stress (HS). A total of 192 birds were assigned to four groups (six cages/group; eight birds/cage): control (CON; 24 ± 1 °C), HS (34 ± 1 °C for 10 h/day), HS + 200 mg/kg COS, and HS + 400 mg/kg COS. Each treatment was replicated in three rooms, with two cages per room. One bird per cage was sampled after the final heat-stress bout and a 12 h fast (n = 6/group). Outcomes comprised organ indices and qualitative histology; serum corticosterone; splenic and thymic SOD, CAT, GSH-Px, and MDA; and heat-shock-, cytokine-, and apoptosis-related mRNA. Data were analyzed using a linear mixed model with treatment as a fixed effect and room nested within treatment as a random effect; Tukey-adjusted comparisons followed a significant omnibus test. Treatment was assigned at room level, the CON versus HS contrast was confounded with room temperature condition, and only three rooms were available per treatment, so all inferential comparisons are exploratory. Relative to unsupplemented HS, both COS doses increased spleen and bursa indices (p < 0.05), lowered serum corticosterone (p < 0.01), increased SOD and CAT activities (p < 0.01) and GSH-Px activity (p < 0.05), and lowered MDA (p < 0.05). COS groups also showed tissue- and dose-dependent shifts in mRNA. The 200 mg/kg group generally showed the largest reductions in pro-inflammatory transcripts, whereas 400 mg/kg produced the most consistent thymic apoptosis-related transcript pattern; no single dose was optimal across all endpoints. Dietary COS was therefore associated with altered immune-organ indices, measured oxidative status, and stress-, cytokine-, and apoptosis-related transcription under HS. Because no thermoneutral + COS group was included and room-level replication was limited, these findings require validation with replicated rooms, protein measurements, and functional immune endpoints.
papers.abstract_zh: 殼寡糖（COS）具有抗氧化及免疫調節活性。本研究旨在探討肉雞暴露於週期性熱應激（HS）下，日糧添加COS對其免疫器官反應的影響。試驗共選用192隻肉雞，隨機分配至四個組別（每組6個籠位，每籠8隻）：對照組（CON；24 ± 1 °C）、熱應激組（HS；34 ± 1 °C，持續10小時/天）、HS + 200 mg/kg COS組，以及HS + 400 mg/kg COS組。每個處理設有3個重複室，每室有2個籠位。在最後一次熱應激結束並禁食12小時後，每籠採樣1隻雞（n = 6/組）。檢測指標包括器官指數與定性組織學；血清皮質酮；脾臟與胸腺中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、過氧化氫酶（CAT）、麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶（GSH-Px）及丙二醛（MDA）；以及熱休克、細胞因子和細胞凋亡相關的mRNA表現。數據採用線性混合模型進行分析，以處理為固定效應，嵌套於處理內的室為隨機效應；顯著的綜合檢定後進行Tukey調整比較。由於處理係以室為單位指派，CON與HS之對比與室溫條件相互混淆，且每個處理僅有3個室可供使用，因此所有推論性比較均屬探索性質。與未補充COS的HS組相比，兩種劑量的COS均能增加脾臟與法氏囊指數（p < 0.05）、降低血清皮質酮（p < 0.01）、提高SOD與CAT活性（p < 0.01）及GSH-Px活性（p < 0.05），並降低MDA含量（p < 0.05）。COS組亦表現出具組織與劑量依賴性的mRNA轉錄變化。200 mg/kg組通常在促發炎轉錄本的降低幅度上最大，而400 mg/kg組則產生最一致的胸腺細胞凋亡相關轉錄本模式；就所有測定指標而言，並無單一劑量表現最優。因此，在熱應激下，日糧添加COS與免疫器官指數、所測之氧化狀態，以及壓力、細胞因子和細胞凋亡相關轉錄的改變有關。由於本研究未納入適溫（thermoneutral）+ COS組，且室級別的重複數有限，這些發現尚需透過具重複室的試驗、蛋白質測定以及功能性免疫指標進一步驗證。

papers.title: Longitudinal Genotype Replacement, Recombination and Neutralizing Epitope Variations in Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea Virus at a Commercial Pig Farm in Guangxi, China
papers.abstract: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) causes severe enteric disease in piglets. The spike (S) gene is the major target of neutralizing antibodies and a hotspot for genetic variation. In this study, eight PEDV S-gene sequences were obtained from a commercial pig farm in Guangxi, China, between 2021 and 2025. Phylogenetic analysis assigned all sequences to the G2 genotype, with G2c, G2d, and G2b subclusters detected at different time points. Recombination analysis identified sequence-level recombination signatures in the G2c sequences, with G2b-like and G2d-like sequences as parental relatives. Several amino acid substitutions were located within or adjacent to the COE and SS2 neutralizing epitopes, and N-glycosylation site variations were observed among subclusters. Structural predictions suggest that these combined changes may alter surface antigenic properties and confer immune evasion potential, though functional validation using neutralization assays is still required. These findings provide field-derived evidence for PEDV genetic evolution and recombination within a single swine herd, and support rational vaccine-strain evaluation and on-farm biosecurity strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬流行性下痢病毒（PEDV）會在仔豬身上引起嚴重的腸道疾病。棘蛋白（S）基因是中和抗體的主要標靶，也是基因變異的熱點。在本研究中，自2021年至2025年期間，從中國廣西的一個商業養豬場獲得了八個PEDV S基因序列。親緣 phylogenetic 分析將所有序列歸類於G2基因型，並在不同時間點檢測到G2c、G2d和G2b次群集。重組分析在G2c序列中識別出序列層級的重組特徵，其中以G2b樣和G2d樣序列作為親緣來源。多個胺基酸置換位於COE和SS2中和抗原表位內或其鄰近區域，且在各次群集中觀察到N-糖基化位點的變異。結構預測表明，這些綜合變化可能會改變表面抗原特性並賦予免疫逃脫的潛力，儘管仍需利用中和試驗進行功能驗證。這些發現為單一豬群內PEDV的基因演化與重組提供了來自現場的證據，並有助於合理的疫苗株評估與場內生物安全策略。

papers.title: New Insights into Avian Aerodynamic Valving: CT-Based CFD Analysis of Bronchial Airflow in the Domestic Chicken
papers.abstract: The avian respiratory system, characterized by its caudocranial unidirectional pulmonary airflow, has long fascinated scientists. To date, the mechanisms underlying the unidirectional airflow and the formation of aerodynamic valving, especially the expiratory valve, remain poorly understood. To provide new insights into pulmonary airflow characteristics and to deepen our understanding of the role of aerodynamic valving in generating unidirectional pulmonary airflow, the respiratory tract of a domestic chicken was reconstructed based on CT-scanned data. CFD simulations were performed under various conditions after validation of the numerical model. Flow parameters were analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively during inspiration and expiration phases, respectively. The results showed that the coupled interaction of the distinctive bronchial topology and air-sac pressure conditions preferentially routed inspired air toward the caudal-sac pathways during inspiration. During expiration, aerodynamic valving was primarily associated with a momentum barrier generated by the cranial-sac airstream, which suppressed retrograde caudal-sac airflow through the primary bronchus and redirected it toward the dorsobronchial outlets leading to the physiological paleopulmonic pathway. Moreover, the ‘segmentum accelerans’ structure facilitated the formation of aerodynamic valving, whereas its removal did not abolish major-bronchial flow rectification, although higher air-sac boundary pressures were required during expiration. Finally, fluid density substantially affected inspiratory aerodynamic valving, whereas its effect on the critical pressures associated with expiratory valving remained below 5%.
papers.abstract_zh: 鳥類呼吸系統具備尾向頭的單向肺部氣流特徵，長期以來一直令科學家著迷。迄今為止，單向氣流背後的機制以及空氣動力學瓣膜（尤其是呼氣瓣膜）的形成，仍所知有限。為了深入了解肺部氣流特性，並加深我們對空氣動力學瓣膜在產生單向肺部氣流中作用的理解，本研究基於斷層掃描（CT）數據重建了家雞的呼吸道。在驗證數值模型後，於各種條件下進行了計算流體力學（CFD）模擬。分別對吸氣和呼氣階段的流動參數進行了定性和定量分析。結果表明，獨特的支氣管拓樸結構與氣囊壓力條件的耦合交互作用，在吸氣過程中優選將吸入的空氣引導至尾囊路徑。在呼氣過程中，空氣動力學瓣膜主要與由頭囊氣流產生的動量障礙有關，該障礙抑制了通過主支氣管的逆行尾囊氣流，並將其重新導向通往生理古肺（paleopulmonic）路徑的背支氣管出口。此外，「加速段」（segmentum accelerans）結構促進了空氣動力學瓣膜的形成，而移除該結構並未消除主支氣管的氣流整流作用，儘管在呼氣過程中需要更高的氣囊邊界壓力。最後，流體密度顯著影響吸氣空氣動力學瓣膜，而其對與呼氣瓣膜相關的臨界壓力的影響則保持在 5% 以下。

papers.title: Comparative In Vitro Characterization of the Nutritional and Functional Properties of Commercially Available Black Soldier Fly Larvae Meal and Soybean Meal
papers.abstract: This study provided an integrated comparative characterization of the nutritional and in vitro functional characteristics of commercially available defatted black soldier fly larvae meal (DF-BSFLM), full-fat black soldier fly larvae meal (FF-BSFLM), and soybean meal (SBM). DF-BSFLM had the highest crude protein concentration (55.70%), whereas in vitro crude protein digestibility was 72.87%, 75.26%, and 88.75% for DF-BSFLM, FF-BSFLM, and SBM, respectively. FF-BSFLM had the highest ether extract concentration (37.09%) and predicted apparent metabolizable energy (AME) value (21.92 MJ/kg), followed by DF-BSFLM (15.86 MJ/kg) and SBM (10.98 MJ/kg). SBM had higher concentrations of several essential amino acids, including leucine, isoleucine, arginine, and phenylalanine, whereas DF-BSFLM had higher concentrations of methionine and valine. FF-BSFLM had the highest saturated fatty acid content (57.57%) and lauric acid concentration (18.79%), whereas SBM had the highest polyunsaturated fatty acid content (51.71%). DF-BSFLM had the highest total Folin–Ciocalteu-reactive content (64.6 mg GAE/g) and DPPH radical-scavenging activity (48.2 mg TE/g), compared with 40.9 mg TE/g for SBM and 27.7 mg TE/g for FF-BSFLM. Overall, the tested ingredients exhibited distinct nutritional and in vitro functional profiles. These findings provide a product-level comparison of commercially available BSFLM products with SBM. Because the FF- and DF-BSFLM products were obtained commercially rather than generated from a common batch under controlled conditions, the observed differences cannot be attributed exclusively to defatting. Furthermore, each ingredient was represented by a single commercial batch, and the analytical replicates do not establish product-level variability. Further studies involving multiple independent commercial batches and controlled in vivo trials are needed to assess product variability and evaluate nutrient bioavailability, standardized ileal amino acid digestibility, energy utilization, and physiological responses in poultry.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究綜合比較了市售脫脂黑水虻幼蟲粉（DF-BSFLM）、全脂黑水虻幼蟲粉（FF-BSFLM）與黃豆粕（SBM）的營養及體外功能特性。DF-BSFLM的粗蛋白質濃度最高（55.70%），而DF-BSFLM、FF-BSFLM和SBM的體外粗蛋白質消化率分別為72.87%、75.26%和88.75%。FF-BSFLM的乙醚萃取物濃度最高（37.09%），預測之表觀代謝能（AME）值也最高（21.92 MJ/kg），其次依序為DF-BSFLM（15.86 MJ/kg）與SBM（10.98 MJ/kg）。SBM含有較高濃度的多種必需胺基酸，包括白胺酸、異白胺酸、精胺酸和苯丙胺酸，而DF-BSFLM則含有較高濃度的甲硫胺酸和纈胺酸。FF-BSFLM的飽和脂肪酸含量（57.57%）與月桂酸濃度（18.79%）最高，SBM的多元不飽和脂肪酸含量則最高（51.71%）。與SBM（40.9 mg TE/g）和FF-BSFLM（27.7 mg TE/g）相比，DF-BSFLM具有最高的福林-西奧卡托總反應物質含量（64.6 mg GAE/g）及DPPH自由基清除活性（48.2 mg TE/g）。整體而言，受試原料展現出截然不同的營養與體外功能特性。這些研究結果提供了市售黑水虻幼蟲粉產品與黃豆粕在產品層級上的比較。由於全脂與脫脂黑水虻幼蟲粉產品係購自市面，而非在控制條件下由同一批次生產，因此所觀察到的差異不能單純歸因於脫脂製程。此外，每種原料僅代表單一商業批次，分析重複並不代表產品層級的變異度。未來需要更多涵蓋多個獨立商業批次及控制良好的活體試驗研究，以評估產品變異度，並評估家禽對營養素的生物利用率、標準化迴腸胺基酸消化率、能量利用率及生理反應。

papers.title: Ruminant Species Composition and Reported Methane Intensity in Global Milk Production: A 186-Country Decomposition Under Alternative Allocation Boundaries
papers.abstract: Methane intensity of milk is often compared across ruminant species, but the Food and Agriculture Organization Corporate Statistical Database (FAOSTAT) identifies a dairy herd only for cattle; for buffalo, goats, sheep and camels it reports whole-herd methane. For 186 countries in 2020–2023 we allocated non-bovine herd methane to milk using country-specific shares of animals in milk. This reduced pooled intensity ratios to cattle from 2.9–17.9 to 1.1–5.2, and cattle had the lowest reported milk-allocated intensity in 53 of 107 multispecies countries (89 under whole-herd allocation). In the screened primary analysis (one implausible Mongolian sheep-milk series excluded), the world ratio decreased by 0.64 g CH4 kg−1; the three-factor decomposition attributed +0.48 g CH4 kg−1 to country shares, −0.10 to species mix and −1.02 to within-species intensity. With the series retained, the corresponding components were +0.57, −1.43 and +0.21. Cross-species comparisons are accounting constructs until boundaries and influential records are explicit.
papers.abstract_zh: 反芻動物間的乳品甲烷強度經常被進行比較，但聯合國糧食及農業組織企業統計資料庫（FAOSTAT）僅針對牛隻識別出乳牛群；對於水牛、山羊、綿羊和駱駝，則僅報告全群甲烷排放量。針對 2020–2023 年間的 186 個國家，我們利用各國泌乳動物的比例，將非牛類畜群的甲烷分配至乳品。這使合併強度比值從牛隻的 2.9–17.9 降至 1.1–5.2；在 107 個多物種國家中，牛隻在 53 個國家中擁有最低的報告乳品分配強度（若採用全則為 89 個）。在篩選後的主要分析中（排除一筆不合理的蒙古綿羊乳系列資料），全球比值減少了 0.64 g CH4 kg−1；三因子分解顯示，國家佔比貢獻了 +0.48 g CH4 kg−1，物種組成貢獻了 −0.10，物種內部強度則貢獻了 −1.02。若保留該系列資料，相應的組成份則分別為 +0.57、−1.43 與 +0.21。在明確界線與具影響力的記錄之前，跨物種比較僅屬會計建構。

papers.title: Isolation and characterization of rabbit intramuscular preadipocytes: Establishing a foundation for studies of intramuscular fat metabolism
papers.abstract: , confirming their differentiation potential. This study establishes a comprehensive protocol for isolating rabbit intramuscular preadipocytes, providing a foundational tool for investigating the molecular mechanisms of adipogenesis in lagomorphs. The model supports future studies on genetic and nutritional strategies to enhance rabbit meat quality while preserving its lean characteristics.
papers.abstract_zh: 肌內脂肪（IMF）顯著影響肉品品質，進而牽動風味、嫩度與多汁性。儘管針對牛、豬等家畜的相關研究已相當廣泛，兔類肌內脂肪的調控機制卻仍所知有限。本研究建立了一套標準化的體外方法，利用酵素消化法與差速離心法，自3日齡海科萊兔的背最長肌中分離並鑑定肌內前脂肪細胞。選擇3日齡新生兔進行最初的實驗方案開發，是由於其具有較高的前驅細胞豐度與組織可及性，這有助於方法的最佳化並確保穩定的細胞得率。分離出的細胞展現出典型的前脂肪細胞形態，並表現出包括PREF-1、PPARγ與Leptin在內的關鍵標記，此點已透過即時螢光定量PCR（RT-qPCR）與免疫螢光染色獲得證實。在進行成脂誘導後，細胞展現出漸進式的脂質累積（如油紅O染色所示），並顯示出PPARG、C/EBPa及FABP4表現量上調，從而證實其分化潛能。本研究建立了一個分離兔肌內前脂肪細胞的完整實驗方案，為探討兔形目動物脂肪生成之分子機制提供了基礎工具。此模型為未來的基因與營養策略研究提供了支持，有助於在維持兔肉瘦肉特性的同時提升其肉品品質。

papers.title: In silico evaluation of selected plant-based compounds as potent dual target inhibitors against highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus
papers.abstract: 1. Influenza viruses remain a serious global health issue due to their high morbidity and mortality rates.
