papers.abstract_zh: 有主戶外犬隻的絕育計畫旨在減少不受控制的繁殖與隨之而來的棄養，但族群層級的證據仍然有限。本研究檢視了2022年實施的韓國政府資助絕育計畫與收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數之間的短期關聯，使用了來自229個行政區從2019年至2024年的年度資料（共1,374筆行政區-年份觀察值）。結果變項為每10萬名居民收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數。本研究使用雙向固定效果（TWFE）與雙差分（DID）模型，評估了社會經濟相關因素、計畫實施情況以及實施數量。由於無法完全建立平行的介入前趨勢、計畫分配並非隨機，且缺乏符合資格的有主戶外犬隻族群數據，因此估計值被解釋為生態學上的相關性。在主要的線性TWFE模型中，計畫的實施與實施數量皆與收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數無顯著關聯，城鄉分層分析也得出相似的無顯著效果發現。以基準需求規模調整的敏感度分析在合併樣本與城鄉樣本中產生了正向關聯，顯示結果對分母選擇與模型設定具敏感性。各省的分析結果具異質性但不一致。整體而言，分析未提供該計畫與短期減少之間具一致性的證據。未來評估應測量符合資格的有主戶外犬隻涵蓋率、使用更長的追蹤期，並在更廣泛的犬隻族群管理架構下評估絕育效果。

papers.title: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Effects of Dietary DHA and EPA on the Hepatic Response to Unpredictable Chronic Stress in Atlantic Salmon (Salmo salar L.)
papers.abstract: Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) are key long-chain omega-3 fatty acids in fish nutrition, but their differential effects on Atlantic salmon under unpredictable chronic stress (UCS) remain unclear. This study compared hepatic responses to DHA- and EPA-rich diets under unstressed and UCS conditions. Atlantic salmon post-smolts were fed a low-EPA+DHA, DHA-rich, or EPA-rich diet for 10 weeks, followed by 3 weeks of UCS. Liver transcriptomes were analyzed by RNA sequencing, and selected genes were validated by quantitative reverse transcription PCR. Growth did not differ among dietary groups. Under unstressed conditions, the DHA-rich diet induced more differentially expressed genes than the EPA-rich diet (67 vs. 29) and affected pathways related to fatty acid metabolism, autophagy, cholesterol homeostasis, and antioxidant defense. After UCS, the EPA-rich diet induced a broader hepatic transcriptional response than the DHA-rich diet (205 vs. 57 differentially expressed genes), with only 12 genes shared between the two comparisons. Both diets affected fatty acid- and steroid-biosynthesis-related pathways, while gene-level responses were diet-specific. These findings reveal distinct, stress-dependent hepatic responses to dietary DHA and EPA and may inform future optimization of their nutritional provision in Atlantic salmon production.
papers.abstract_zh: 二十碳五烯酸（EPA）與二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）是大西洋鮭魚營養中的關鍵長鏈 omega-3 脂肪酸，但它們對處於不可預測之慢性壓力（UCS）下的大西洋鮭魚之差異性影響仍不清楚。本研究比較了在無壓力與 UCS 條件下，富含 DHA 與富含 EPA 飲食的肝臟反應。大西洋鮭魚後 smolt 分別投餵低 EPA+DHA、富含 DHA 或富含 EPA 的飼料 10 週，隨後進行 3 週的 UCS。利用 RNA 定序分析肝臟轉錄體，並透過即時定量反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應（qRT-PCR）驗證部分基因。各飲食組間的生長情形無顯著差異。在無壓力條件下，富含 DHA 的飲食比富含 EPA 的飲食誘導出更多的差異表現基因（67 個對 29 個），並影響與脂肪酸代謝、自噬作用、膽固醇恆定及抗氧化防禦相關的通路。在 UCS 之後，富含 EPA 的飲食比富含 DHA 的飲食誘導出更廣泛的肝臟轉錄反應（205 個對 57 個差異表現基因），且兩者比較中僅有 12 個基因重疊。兩種飲食皆影響與脂肪酸及類固醇生物合成相關的通路，而基因層面的反應則具飲食特異性。這些發現揭示了飲食中 DHA 與具壓力依賴性的相異肝臟反應，並可為未來優化大西洋鮭魚生產中的營養供給提供參考。

papers.title: Berberine Protects Brain Endothelial Barrier via β-Catenin: A Network Pharmacology in Pigs and In Vitro Mechanistic Analysis
papers.abstract: Glaesserella parasuis (G. parasuis) is an important swine pathogen that causes Glässer’s disease, of which meningitis is among the most severe clinical symptoms. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying G. parasuis-induced meningitis remain poorly understood. In this study, we employed a network pharmacology-based strategy combined with in vitro experimental validation to investigate the protective effects and mechanisms of berberine against G. parasuis meningitis. Network pharmacology analysis identified CTNNB1 (encodes the β-catenin protein) as a core target among multiple candidate targets. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses revealed that the predicted targets of berberine are significantly associated with inflammatory signaling (mitogen-activated protein kinase MAPK/nuclear factor kappa B NF-κB) and stress-response pathways (forkhead box O FoxO/p53), suggesting a multifaceted protective mechanism against G. parasuis-induced blood–brain barrier (BBB) disruption. Molecular docking results combined with drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assays demonstrated that berberine binds directly to β-catenin with high affinity (docking score = −7.52 kcal/mol), as evidenced by enhanced proteolytic stability of β-catenin upon berberine (2.5, 10, and 20 μg/mL) treatment. To further validate the functional relevance, we introduced zonula occludens-1 (ZO-1), a representative tight junction protein, as a functional verification indicator. Our results demonstrated that G. parasuis infection significantly downregulated the expression of both ZO-1 and β-catenin in human brain microvascular endothelial cells (hBMECs), while berberine (2.5, 10, and 20 μg/mL) treatment effectively reversed this downregulation in a concentration-dependent manner. These findings reveal that berberine exerts its protective effects against G. parasuis meningitis by targeting CTNNB1 to restore intercellular junctional integrity—including tight junctions (ZO-1) and adherens junctions (β-catenin)—thereby preserving BBB function. This study provides a mechanistic basis for the development of berberine as a promising alternative therapeutic agent against G. parasuis meningitis.
papers.abstract_zh: 副豬嗜血桿菌（*Glaesserella parasuis*）是一種重要的豬隻病原菌，會引起格氏病（Glässer's disease），其中腦膜炎是最嚴重的臨床症狀之一。然而，副豬嗜血桿菌引發腦膜炎的分子機制仍所知有限。在本研究中，我們採用基於網絡藥理學的策略結合體外實驗驗證，探討小蘗鹼（berberine）對副豬嗜血桿菌性腦膜炎的保護作用及機制。網絡藥理學分析識別出 CTNNB1（編碼 $\beta$-catenin 蛋白質）為多個候選標靶中的核心標靶。基因本體論（Gene Ontology, GO）與京都基因與基因體百科全書（KEGG）富集分析顯示，小蘗鹼預測的標靶與發炎訊息傳遞（絲裂原活化蛋白質激酶 MAPK / 核因子卡巴 B NF-$\kappa$B）及壓力反應路徑（叉頭框 O FoxO / p53）顯著相關，這表明其具有針對副豬嗜血桿菌誘導之血腦屏障（BBB）破壞的多方面保護機制。分子模擬對接（molecular docking）結果結合藥物親和力反應標靶穩定性（DARTS）分析顯示，小蘗鹼以高親和力直接結合至 $\beta$-catenin（對接分數 = −7.52 kcal/mol），經小蘗鹼（2.5、10 和 20 μg/mL）處理後 $\beta$-catenin 的蛋白質水解穩定性增強即證明了這一點。為了進一步驗證其功能相關性，我們引入了具代表性的緊密連接蛋白質——胞質僵直蛋白-1（zonula occludens-1, ZO-1）作為功能驗證指標。我們的結果表明，副豬嗜血桿菌感染顯著下調了人類大腦微血管內皮細胞（hBMECs）中 ZO-1 與 $\beta$-catenin 的表達，而小蘗鹼（2.5、10 和 20 μg/mL）處理則以濃度依賴的方式有效逆轉了這種下調。這些發現揭示了小蘗鹼透過標靶 CTNNB1 以恢復細胞間連接完整性——包含緊密連接（ZO-1）與黏附連接（$\beta$-catenin）——從而發揮對副豬嗜血桿菌性腦膜炎的保護作用，並維持血腦屏障功能。本研究為將小蘗鹼開發為對抗副豬嗜血桿菌性腦膜炎之有潛力的替代治療藥物提供了機制基礎。

papers.title: The Most Effective Molnupiravir Dosage for Eliminating Feline Calicivirus from Cats with and Without Chronic Gingivostomatitis
papers.abstract: Feline chronic gingivostomatitis (FCGS) and gingival hyperplasia are extremely painful conditions for which there is no universally recognised cause or cure. Feline calicivirus (FCV) was detected by RT-qPCR in two pet Domestic Shorthair cats with FCGS and isolated from mouth swabs of 14 cats following a gingivitis and fading kitten outbreak in a British Shorthair and Maine Coon breeding cattery. Oral inflammation was graded 0 (healthy) to 4 (FCGS). Nine of 16 gingivitis cases presented with FCGS. Mean inflammation grade significantly improved (p < 0.001) from 3.1 ± 1.0 to 0.3 ± 0.5 when cats became FCV negative. Eleven of 16 (69%) cats gained weight. Cats became FCV negative following antiviral treatment with molnupiravir (n = 15) and nitazoxanide (n = 1). (Nitazoxanide (31–48 mg/kg q24h for 70 days) failed to stop FCV shedding in three other cats.) Across 38 treatment courses, FCV shedding ceased with once daily oral molnupiravir doses of 22–39 mg/kg in 5/10 (50%); 40–55 mg/kg in 14/16 (88%); and >55 mg/kg in 8/12 (67%). Subclinically infected cats became FCV negative after 14 days molnupiravir, but gingivitis cases required longer (p = 0.005). Three cattery cats were reinfected and relapsed. Conclusion: Molnupiravir at a dose of 40–55 mg/kg q24h stopped FCV shedding, enabling recovery of some gingivitis cases.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓慢性齒齦口炎（FCGS）與齒齦增生是極度疼痛的疾病，目前尚無全球公認的病因或療法。本研究在兩隻患有 FCGS 的家貓（米克斯）體內以 RT-qPCR 檢測出貓卡里西病毒（FCV），並從一個英國短毛貓與緬因貓繁殖貓舍中發生齒齦炎及幼貓衰弱疫情後的 14 貓隻口腔拭子中分離出該病毒。口腔發炎程度評分為 0 分（健康）至 4 分（FCGS）。16 例齒齦炎病例中有 9 例表現出 FCGS。當貓隻的 FCV 轉為陰性時，平均發炎評分顯著改善（p < 0.001），從 3.1 ± 1.1 降至 0.3 ± 0.5。11 隻貓（69%）體重增加。貓隻在接受抗病毒藥物莫納皮拉韋（molnupiravir，n = 15）與硝唑尼特（nitazoxanide，n = 1）治療後，FCV 轉為陰性。（硝唑尼特〔31–48 mg/kg，每 24 小時一次，療程 70 天〕未能阻止其他三隻貓排出 FCV）。在 39 個治療療程中，透過每日口服一次莫納皮拉韋，停止 FCV 排毒的比例分別為：劑量 22–39 mg/kg 者占 5/10（50%）；劑量 40–55 mg/kg 者占 15/16（94%）；劑量 >55 mg/kg 者占 10/13（77%）。無臨床症狀感染貓在接受莫納皮拉韋治療 14 天後 FCV 轉為陰性，但齒齦炎病例需要更長的療程（p = 0.005）。三隻貓舍貓隻再次感染並復發。結論：劑量為 40–55 mg/kg、每 24 小時一次的莫納皮拉韋能停止 FCV 排毒，使部分齒齦炎病例得以康復。

papers.title: Correction to “ MiR ‐376c‐3p Targets STRBP mRNA to Regulate Cashmere Goat Hair Follicle Stem Cell Proliferation and Multipotency by Inhibiting the Wnt/β‐catenin and BMP Signalling Pathways”
Integrating Heat Stress into Circular Livestock Production and Life Cycle Assessment: Toward a Heat-Stress Circularity Index
papers.abstract: Heat stress (HS) constrains livestock production under climate change, impairing health, welfare, productivity and survival. Because fixed resource use is then spread over less output, HS is also a systems-level sustainability problem. This narrative review, based on a targeted search of PubMed, Web of Science and Scopus (2013–2026), proposes a framework linking climate exposure, animal responses, resource flows, circular interventions and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) across dairy cattle, pigs, poultry and small ruminants, and grades the evidence behind each link. A decomposition of meta-analytic data indicates that HS raises the impact per kg of milk by approximately 3–12% during heat-stress periods, mainly through non-feed burdens. Monte Carlo analysis shows that the direction of this effect is robust, whereas its magnitude depends mainly on the feed share of the total burden. A Heat-Stress Circularity Index (HSCI) is operationalized with explicit metrics, normalization bounds, a geometric aggregation rule and a minimum-welfare gate. A worked example shows that system rankings depend on the aggregation rule, and a pilot application to a commercial Mediterranean pig farm shows that heat-season piglet and weaner mortality triggers the welfare gate despite moderate productivity retention. Evidence is strong for physiological responses but absent for LCA under measured heat stress; five falsifiable hypotheses, with the corresponding validation designs and sample sizes, are therefore proposed.
papers.abstract_zh: 氣候變遷下的熱緊迫（HS）限制了畜牧生產，並損害了動物健康、福祉、生產力與存活率。由於固定資源的使用分散在較少的產出上，熱緊迫同時也是一個系統層面的永續性問題。本篇敘事性文獻回顧基於對 PubMed、Web of Science 與 Scopus（2013–2026年）的標的性檢索，提出了一個串聯乳牛、豬隻、家禽與小型反芻動物之氣候暴露、動物反應、資源流向、循環介入措施與生命週期評估（LCA）的架構，並評定各個連結背後的證據等級。對統合分析數據的分解顯示，在熱緊迫期間，熱緊迫使每公斤乳品的環境衝擊提高了約 3–12%，主要係透過非飼料負擔所致。蒙地卡羅分析顯示，此效應的方向相當穩健，而其幅度則主要取決於飼料佔總負擔的比例。熱緊迫循環性指數（HSCI）透過明確的指標、常態化界限、幾何聚合規則與最低福利閥值來具體實施。一個實例示範表明，系統排名取決於聚合規則；而對地中海地區某商業養豬場的試點應用則顯示，熱季時仔豬與保育豬的死亡率觸發了福利閥值，儘管其生產力保持在moderate（中等）水準。生理反應的證據相當扎實，但在實測熱緊迫下的 LCA 證據則有所欠缺；因此，本文提出了五個可否證的假設，並附帶相應的驗證設計與樣本大小。

papers.title: Automated Acoustic Monitoring of Oestrus in Dairy Cows and Sows: Behavioural Evidence, Signal Processing, and Detection Methods
papers.abstract: Oestrus detection determines insemination timing and reproductive efficiency in dairy cow and sow herds, yet manual observation and single-sensor systems remain vulnerable to weak behavioural expression and commercial barn conditions. This structured narrative review organises evidence across biological plausibility, acoustic acquisition, barn interference, feature representation, recognition models, multimodal fusion, decision support, and on-farm validation. Searches of PubMed and Crossref through 3 October 2026 produced 373 records and 339 unique records after deduplication. Of the core database records, 16 met the direct relevance criteria, and 78 supplementary biological, engineering, and methodological sources were incorporated through backward citation searching and targeted contextual retrieval, yielding 94 cited sources. Dairy cow evidence most consistently supports increased vocalisation rate around the oestrus climax and individual acoustic monitoring under defined conditions. Sow evidence depends more strongly on boar stimulation, the standing reflex, and multimodal labels, positioning acoustics mainly as an auxiliary behavioural cue. Reported direct recognition accuracies range from 91.25% to 98.92%, but heterogeneous labels and predominantly internal validation prevent statistical pooling or claims of commercial generalisability. Acoustic monitoring is best positioned as an early-warning and verification layer rather than a standalone predictor of ovulation or optimal insemination timing. Priority needs are standardised reference labels, leakage-resistant animal- and farm-level validation, device robustness, multimodal uncertainty handling, open benchmarks, and evaluation of reproductive and economic outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 發情偵測決定了乳牛與母豬群體的授精時機與繁殖效率，然而人工觀察與單一感測器系統仍易受到微弱行為表現及商業畜舍環境的限制。本結構化敘述性文獻回顧整合了生物學合理性、聲學擷取、畜舍干擾、特徵表示、辨識模型、多模態融合、決策支援以及場域驗證等面向的證據。透過 PubMed 與 Crossref 檢索截至 2026 年 10 月 3 日的文獻，共產生 373 筆記錄，經去除重複後剩餘 339 筆獨特記錄。在核心資料庫記錄中，有 16 筆符合直接相關性標準，並透過逆向引用檢索與針對性情境文獻擷取納入 78 筆補充性的生物學、工程學與方法學來源，總計引用 94 個來源。乳牛的證據最一致地支持在發情高峰期發聲率增加，以及在特定條件下進行個別聲學監測。母豬的證據則較強烈依賴公豬刺激、靜立反射與多模態標記，將聲學定位為主要的輔助行為線索。報告的直接辨識準確度介於 91.25% 至 98.92% 之間，但異質性標記與以內部驗證為主的情況，妨礙了統計合併或商業泛用性的聲稱。聲學監測最適合作為早期預警與驗證層，而非作為排卵或最佳授精時機的獨立預測指標。當務之急包括標準化參考標記、具抗洩漏能力的動物與牧場層級驗證、裝置強韌性、多模態不確定性處理、開放基準，以及對繁殖與經濟效益的評估。

papers.title: From Trauma to Innovation: A Comparative History of Limb Amputation and Prosthetics in Humans and Ungulates from Historical and Zooarchaeological Perspectives
papers.abstract: Amputation and prosthetics represent vital themes in the history of medicine and zooarchaeology, reflecting the boundaries of therapeutic capabilities and evolving human–animal relationships. This study provides a comprehensive, comparative historical analysis of limb amputation procedures, surgical tools, haemostasis, and prosthetic rehabilitation in both humans and ungulates. A narrative literature review was conducted across electronic databases (PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Google Scholar, and the Cochrane Library) and digital repositories to evaluate archaeological evidence, ancient legal frameworks, and medieval/early modern medical and veterinary treatises. The historical evolution reveals striking cross-disciplinary technical analogies. Early modern surgical instruments (amputation knives and saws) and basic haemostatic approaches (fire cauterization transitioning to vascular ligation) developed along parallel trajectories in human and veterinary surgeries. However, the post-operative application of prosthetics reveals sharp biomechanical contrasts. While human prosthetics primarily addressed locomotion and cosmetics, veterinary prosthetics in heavy ungulates (horses and cattle) faced critical biological barriers, most notably contralateral limb overload leading to laminitis. Conversely, modern cases in lighter species (donkeys, alpacas, and sheep) demonstrate significantly higher adaptive success. Integrating human medical milestones with veterinary history provides a holistic framework for understanding paleopathologies and the cultural shift from culling injured livestock toward advanced, empathetic veterinary bioengineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 截肢與義肢是醫學史與動物考古學中的重要主題，反映了治療能力的界限以及不斷演變的人與動物關係。本研究針對人類與有蹄類動物的四肢截肢手術、手術器械、止血方法與義肢復健，提供了一項全面性的比較歷史分析。本研究透過電子資料庫（PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus、Google Scholar與Cochrane Library）及數位典藏進行敘事性文獻回顧，以評估考古證據、古代法律架構以及中世紀／近代早期的醫學與獸醫專著。歷史演變揭示了驚人的跨學科技術類比。近代早期的手術器械（截肢刀與鋸子）以及基本的止血方法（從火灼止血法過渡到血管結紮術）在人類與獸醫外科手術中沿著平行的軌跡發展。然而，義肢的術後應用則展現出鮮明的生物力學對比。人類義肢主要解決行動與美觀問題，而重型有蹄類動物（馬與牛）的獸醫義肢則面臨關鍵的生物學障礙，其中最顯著的是對側肢體負荷過重導致的蹄葉炎。相反地，較輕物種（驢、羊駝與綿羊）的現代案例則展現出顯著較高的適應成功率。將人類醫學里程碑與獸醫歷史相結合，為理解古病理學以及從淘汰受傷牲畜轉向先進、具同理心的獸醫生物工程之文化轉變，提供了一個全方位的架構。

papers.title: Allele and Genotype Frequencies of Production Trait SNPs in Crossbred Heifers of the Colombian Caribbean
papers.abstract: The Colombian Caribbean dual-purpose livestock system (Bos taurus × Bos indicus) is an important source of milk and beef, yet molecular characterization of trait-associated markers remains limited. This study characterized allele and genotype frequencies of 29 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) associated with meat quality and milk production traits in 1585 crossbred heifers from five departments of the Colombian Caribbean. DNA was extracted from hair follicles and genotyped with the Axiom™ Bovine 100K Array. Markers spanned genes for muscle growth and proteolysis (CAPN1, CAST, MSTN), energy metabolism (LEP, DGAT1), and milk protein composition (CSN2, CSN3, PAEP, GH1, GHR, ABCG2). Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium (HWE) was assessed by chi-squared test. Of the 29 markers, 21 were polymorphic and testable: 19 conformed to HWE and 2 deviated (PAEP_239, PAEP_312). The remaining 8 were monomorphic. Approximately 48% of loci showed very high favorable allele frequencies (q > 0.99 or p > 0.99), whereas 52% maintained intermediate heterozygosity. CSN3_526 reached near-fixation of the favorable B allele (q = 0.996), consistent with selection for cheese yield, whereas CAST_282 and CAST_2870 showed high heterozygosity (f(AB) ≈ 0.47–0.48), indicating substantial remaining variation at these loci. These findings provide the first descriptive dual meat-and-milk SNP frequency profile for these crossbred heifers and a molecular baseline for the future development of bioeconomic selection indices in tropical dual-purpose systems. Frequencies are reported at the pooled and department-stratified levels; the results are descriptive and require phenotypic validation before any inference on marker effects or suitability for selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 哥倫比亞加勒比海地區的肉乳兼用型家畜系統（Bos taurus × Bos indicus）是牛奶和牛肉的重要來源，然而針對性狀關聯標記的分子特徵研究仍相當有限。本研究旨在探討來自哥倫比亞加勒比海五個省份的 1585 頭雜交女牛中，29 個與肉質及產乳性狀相關之單核苷酸多型性（SNP）的等位基因及基因型頻率。本研究從毛囊中萃取 DNA，並使用 Axiom™ Bovine 100K 晶片進行基因分型。這些標記涵蓋了與肌肉生長及蛋白質水解（CAPN1、CAST、MSTN）、能量代謝（LEP、DGAT1）以及乳蛋白組成（CSN2、CSN3、PAEP、GH1、GHR、ABC​​G2）相關的基因。哈代－溫堡平衡（HWE）透過卡方檢定進行評估。在這 29 個標記中，有 21 個具多型性且可進行檢定：19 個符合 HWE，2 個偏離（PAEP_239、PAEP_312）。其餘 8 個為單型性。大約 48% 的基因座顯示出極高的有利等位基因頻率（q > 0.99 或 p > 0.99），而 52% 的基因座則維持中等雜合度。CSN3_526 的有利 B 等位基因頻率接近固定（q = 0.996），這與針對起司產量的選育一致，而 CAST_282 和 CAST_2870 則顯示出高雜合度（f(AB) ≈ 0.47–0.48），表明這些基因座仍保有顯著的變異。這些發現提供了這些雜交女牛的首份兼具肉與乳性狀之描述性 SNP 頻率概況，並為未來在熱帶肉乳兼用系統中發展生物經濟選育指數奠定了分子基準。頻率數據分別以合併及分省層級進行報告；本結果具描述性，在對標記效應或選育適宜性進行任何推論之前，尚需進行表現型驗證。

papers.title: Inclusion of Palm Kernel Cake in Supplements for Grazing Lambs on Growth Performance, Digestibility, Nitrogen Balance, Blood Metabolites and Meat Quality
papers.abstract: Palm kernel cake (PKC), a byproduct produced in various countries, has been studied for its potential use as animal feed. This study aimed to assess the effects of PKC as a feed supplement on Santa Inês lambs raised on pasture (Panicum maximum cv. Massai). Forty uncastrated lambs were included in a completely randomized design and allocated to four treatments consisting of feed supplements with different levels of PKC included (0.0, 150, 300, and 450 g/kg). The intake of dry matter, neutral detergent fiber, and non-fibrous carbohydrates and the time spent ruminating decreased linearly as the level of PKC increased. Digestibility of the ether extract improved, fecal levels and intake of nitrogen decreased, and microbial protein remained consistent with PKC inclusion. The final body weight, total weight gain, and average daily weight gain decreased quadratically with PKC inclusion levels. Marbling and meat color improved with the inclusion of PKC in the diet. Lambs grazing and supplemented with control rations exhibited superior performance compared to those consuming supplements with PKC content. Including PKC at levels up to 450 g/kg in feed supplement for grazing lambs may reduce feed intake and animal performance without affecting blood metabolites. However, it enhances meat redness, which may appeal to consumers. Its use may be advantageous during critical dry periods for the maintenance feeding of grazing animals.
papers.abstract_zh: 棕櫚仁粕（PKC）是多個國家生產的副產物，其作為動物飼料的潛在用途已被廣泛研究。本研究旨在評估在放牧（Massai幾內亞草，*Panicum maximum* cv. Massai）飼養條件下，以棕櫚仁粕作為飼料補充劑對聖伊內斯（Santa Inês）綿羊的影響。試驗納入四十隻未去勢綿羊，採完全隨機設計，並分配至四種處理組，其飼料補充劑含有不同水準的棕櫚仁粕（0.0、150、300及450 g/kg）。隨著棕櫚仁粕添加水準的增加，乾物質、中性洗劑纖維和非纖維性碳水化合物的攝入量以及反芻時間均呈線性下降。粗脂肪的消化率有所改善，糞便中的氮含量與氮攝入量則皆下降，而微生物蛋白質在添加棕櫚仁粕後保持穩定。終端體重、總增重和平均日增重隨著棕櫚仁粕添加水準呈二次方下降。在日糧中添加棕櫚仁粕可改善大理石紋（油花）和肉色。與食用含棕櫚仁粕補充劑的綿羊相比，放牧並補充對照飼糧的綿羊表現出更優異的生產性能。在放牧綿羊的飼料補充劑中添加高達 450 g/kg 的棕櫚仁粕可能會降低採食量和動物表現，但不會影響血液代謝物。不過，它能增強肉品的紅度，這可能較受消費者青睞。在乾旱等關鍵時期，將其用於放牧動物的維持飼養可能具有優勢。

papers.title: Deep Learning Models for FAMACHA©-Based Anemia Screening in Goats
papers.abstract: Haemonchus contortus infection is a major cause of anemia in goats and can reduce productivity, reproductive performance, and animal welfare. The FAMACHA© system supports on-farm anemia screening by visually assessing ocular conjunctival color, but scoring can vary with evaluator experience, and lighting conditions. This study developed a smartphone-oriented deep learning framework for FAMACHA©-based anemia screening in goats using ocular conjunctival images. The dataset included 1995 FAMACHA©-labeled images from 141 meat and dairy goats collected across three acquisition campaigns. For the binary screening task, FAMACHA© scores of 4–5 were assigned to the anemic screening class, whereas scores of 1–3 were assigned to the non-anemic screening class. The pipeline combined U-Net-based conjunctiva segmentation with classification using six ImageNet-pretrained backbones: ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, Swin-T, EfficientNet-B0, MobileNetV4-Small, and MobileViT-v2-1.0. Models were evaluated using animal-level dataset splitting, nested cross-validation, validation-selected thresholds, goat-level cluster bootstrap confidence intervals and goat-block paired permutation tests. U-Net with a ResNet-34 encoder achieved a foreground IoU of 0.7342 and a Dice coefficient of 0.8372 for conjunctiva segmentation. On the held-out test set, ViT-B/16 achieved the highest anemia recall (0.924), accuracy (0.861), and anemia-class F1-score (0.879). However, MobileNetV4-Small performed closely, with 0.847 accuracy, a 0.861 F1-score, and the highest specificity (0.825). U-Net-ResNet34 combined with MobileNetV4-Small yielded the lowest estimated combined inference latency of 479.04 ms per image, calculated from separately measured segmentation and classification latencies on a Samsung SM-A556E smartphone using TensorFlow Lite. A Pearson’s correlation analysis showed a strong positive association between fecal egg count and FAMACHA© score (r = 0.7082, R2 = 0.5015, p < 0.0001). These results suggest that ocular-conjunctival imaging can support FAMACHA©-based anemia screening in goats, with ViT-B/16 serving as the strongest recall-oriented model and MobileNetV4-Small as a practical candidate for low-latency on-device inference under the tested smartphone configuration.
papers.abstract_zh: 捻轉血矛線蟲（*Haemonchus contortus*）感染是山羊貧血的主要原因，並會降低生產性能、繁殖表現和動物福利。FAMACHA©系統透過視覺評估眼結膜顏色來支援牧場端的貧血篩檢，但評分結果可能會隨評估人員的經驗和光照條件而有所不同。本研究開發了一種基於智慧型手機的深度學習框架，利用眼結膜影像進行山羊的FAMACHA©貧血篩檢。資料集包含來自三個採集梯次、共 141 隻肉山羊與乳山羊的 1995 張具 FAMACHA© 標籤的影像。在二元篩檢任務中，FAMACHA© 評分 4–5 分被歸類為貧血篩檢類別，而 1–3 分則歸類為非貧血篩檢類別。該處理流程結合了基於 U-Net 的結膜分割，以及使用六個在 ImageNet 上預訓練的主幹網路進行分類：ResNet-50、ViT-B/16、Swin-T、EfficientNet-B0、MobileNetV4-Small 和 MobileViT-v2-1.0. 模型評估採用動物層級的資料集分割、巢狀交叉驗證、驗證集選定的閾值、山羊層級群聚拔靴（cluster bootstrap）信賴區間以及山羊區塊配對置換檢定。使用 ResNet-34 編碼器的 U-Net 在結膜分割上取得了 0.7342 的前景交併比（IoU）和 0.8372 的戴斯係數（Dice coefficient）。在保留的測試集上，ViT-B/16 取得了最高的貧血召回率（0.924）、準確度（0.861）以及貧血類別 F1 分數（0.879）。然而，MobileNetV4-Small 的表現亦相當接近，具備 0.847 的準確度、0.861 的 F1 分數，以及最高 特異度（0.825）。結合 U-Net-ResNet34 與 MobileNetV4-Small 產生的估計綜合推論延遲最低，每張影像為 479.04 毫秒，此數據是使用 TensorFlow Lite 在 Samsung SM-A556E 智慧型手機上分別測量分割與分類延遲計算而得。皮爾森相關分析顯示糞便蟲卵數與 FAMACHA© 評分之間具有強烈的正相關（r = 0.7082, R2 = 0.5015, p < 0.0001）。這些結果表明，眼結膜成像可用於支援山羊基於 FAMACHA© 的貧血篩檢，其中 ViT-B/16 可作為最強的導向召回率模型，而 MobileNetV4-Small 則是所測試的智慧型手機配置下，適用於低延遲裝置端推論的實用候選模型。

papers.title: Courtship Behavior and Induced Spawning Dynamics of the Freshwater Shark, Wallago attu, in Captivity: Implications for Silurid Reproductive Strategies
papers.abstract: The vulnerable catfish Wallago attu, a commercially important freshwater species in Southeast Asia, faces population decline due to habitat degradation and overfishing. This study is the first to document the courtship behavior and induced spawning of W. attu under captive conditions in circular spawning tanks. The hormonal induction was achieved using a combination of salmon gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogue and domperidone (0.5 mL kg−1 for females; 0.2 mL kg−1 for males). Males exhibited dominant courtship behavior, characterized by aggressive chasing and U-shaped body wrapping around the female’s abdomen for 5.15 ± 0.17 s, leading to synchronized gamete release. The latency period prior to the onset of spawning occurred within a time frame of 9–10 h following hormonal administration. The findings indicate that the removal of brooders following egg release resulted in a significantly higher rate of fertilization and hatching, with a percentage of 88.12 ± 0.26%, as compared to 67.78 ± 1.78% in tanks that contained brooders This observation suggests the presence of egg predation. Plastic strings functioned as effective artificial substrates, enhancing fertilization (86.42 ± 1.18%) and hatching (89.28 ± 0.80%) in comparison to aquatic weeds. The findings presented herein provide a foundation of information upon which the establishment of efficient captive breeding and hatchery protocols for W. attu can be based. Such protocols will in turn support the conservation of the species and the sustainable development of aquaculture.
papers.abstract_zh: 具商業重要性的東南亞淡水物種──易危鯰魚黑翅琵琶魚（*Wallago attu*），因棲地退化與過漁而面臨族群數量下降。本研究首次記錄了黑翅琵琶魚在圓形產卵池之人工飼養條件下的求偶行為與催產。荷爾蒙催產係使用鮭魚促性腺激素釋放激素類似物與嗎酮之混合物（雌魚為 0.5 mL kg−1；雄魚為 0.2 mL kg−1）。雄魚展現出優勢的求偶行為，其特徵為具侵略性的追逐，並以 U 形身體纏繞雌魚腹部達 5.15 ± 0.17 秒，進而促成同步釋放配子。荷爾蒙給藥後的產卵潛伏期出現在 9 至 10 小時的時間範圍內。研究結果顯示，產卵後移除親魚可顯著提高受精率與孵化率，其百分比達 88.12 ± 0.26%，相較之下，含有親魚的水槽則為 67.78 ± 1.78%。此觀察結果暗示存在卵掠食現象。與水草相比，塑膠繩能作為有效的人工基質，提高受精率（86.42 ± 1.18%）與孵化率（89.28 ± 0.80%）。本文所呈現之發現為建立黑翅琵琶魚高效人工繁殖與孵化場操作規程奠定資訊基礎。此類操作規程將進一步支持該物種之保育及水產養殖的可持續發展。

papers.title: Dietary phosphorus source reprograms the kidney-intestine axis to dictate calcium-phosphorus efficiency and egg production in aging hens
papers.abstract: Background The decline in egg production in aging hens poses a significant challenge to sustainable poultry production. Given that evidence suggests the phosphorus source affects late‑lay performance, we tested the hypothesis that the dietary phosphorus source is a decisive regulator sustaining performance by reprogramming systemic mineral homeostasis. Using a systems biology approach, we analyzed the coordinated expression of eleven key mineral transporter genes across the duodenum, jejunum, ileum, and kidney of hens fed dicalcium phosphate (DCP) or tricalcium phosphate (TCP). Results During weeks 5–8, hens fed DCP showed significant declines in egg production (β = −3.11/week, P < 0.001) and egg weight (β = −0.47 g/week, P = 0.049), unlike the stable TCP group. TCP induced an efficient "precision conservation" phenotype, characterized by the co-upregulation of key duodenal phosphorus and calcium transporters ( NaPi-IIb , PiT2; NCX1 , PMCA1b ), a gene set identified as the top predictor of performance. Conversely, DCP triggered a costly "compensatory salvage" state, scattering expression to duodenal calcium channels ( TRPV5 , TRPV6 ) and renal compensatory genes ( NCX1 , CALB1 ). Network analysis pinpointed these renal genes as a central, performance-limiting hub. Conclusion We conclude that TCP sustains production by programming a systemically efficient homeostatic strategy, thereby explaining the established performance benefit at a molecular level. This establishes a new principle for layer nutrition: phosphorus source selection must consider its role as a physiological signal that modulates homeostasis. This strategy mitigates age-related decline and enhances resource allocation to production.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：高齡母雞產蛋量下降對永續家禽生產構成了重大挑戰。鑑於有證據表明磷源會影響後期產蛋表現，我們假設日糧磷源是透過重新編程全身礦物質恆定來維持生產表現的決定性調節因子。我們採用系統生物學方法，分析了餵食磷酸氫鈣（DCP）或磷酸三鈣（TCP）的母雞在十二指腸、空腸、迴腸和腎臟中十一個關鍵礦物質轉運蛋白基因的協調表達。結果：在第 5 至 8 週期間，與表現穩定的 TCP 組不同，餵食 DCP 的母雞之產蛋量（β = −3.11/週，P < 0.001）和蛋重（β = −0.47 克/週，P = 0.049）均顯現顯著下降。TCP 誘導出高效的「精準保存」表現型，其特徵在於十二指腸關鍵磷和鈣轉運蛋白（ NaPi-IIb 、 PiT2 ； NCX1 、 PMCA1b ）的共同上調，這組基因被確定為生產表現的最佳預測指標。相反地，DCP 則引發了消耗性的「代償性回收」狀態，將表達分散至十二指腸鈣通道（ TRPV5 、 TRPV6 ）和腎臟代償基因（ NCX1 、 CALB1 ）。網路分析將這些腎臟基因精確定位為一個核心的、限制表現的樞紐。結論：我們得出結論，TCP 透過編程全身高效的恆定策略來維持生產，從而在分子水平上解釋了既定的生產表現優勢。這為蛋雞營養確立了一項新原則：磷源選擇必須考慮其作為調節恆定之生理信號的角色。此策略可減緩與年齡相關的機能衰退，並增強資源分配以提升生產力。

papers.title: Acute Heat Stress Disrupts Hepatic Homeostasis and Gut Microbiota in Early-Juvenile Asian Swamp Eels (Monopterus albus)
papers.abstract: Water temperature is a critical environmental determinant of aquatic organism survival. The Asian swamp eel (Monopterus albus), a major aquaculture species, is highly vulnerable to acute summer heat stress at the early-juvenile stage. Juveniles exposed to 32 °C for 96 h (versus 25 °C controls) exhibited 3498 differentially expressed hepatic genes, with enrichment in amino acid metabolism, immune regulation, and apoptosis pathways; immunity, metabolism, and ion binding were top enriched functions. Key genes linked to immune activation, apoptosis, and metabolic reprogramming were upregulated. Gut 16S rRNA profiling revealed increased microbial diversity and taxonomic shifts indicative of microbiota disruption. These findings show that acute heat stress disrupts hepatic homeostasis via coordinated inflammatory, apoptotic, and metabolic responses while altering gut microbiota, offering an integrated view of thermal resilience mechanisms in early-life-stage teleosts.
papers.abstract_zh: 水溫是決定水生生物存活的關鍵環境因素。黃鱔（Monopterus albus）作為重要的水產養殖物種，在稚魚階段對夏季急性熱緊迫高度敏感。暴露於 32 °C 達 96 小時（相較於 25 °C 對照組）的稚魚，其肝臟表現出 3498 個差異表現基因，主要富集於胺基酸代謝、免疫調節及細胞凋亡路徑；免疫、代謝和離子結合為前三主要的富集功能。與免疫活化、細胞凋亡和代謝重編程相關的關鍵基因顯現上調。腸道 16S rRNA 定序顯示微生物多樣性增加以及象徵菌相失調的分類群轉變。這些發現表明，急性熱緊迫透過協調的發育、細胞凋亡和代謝反應破壞肝臟恆定，同時改變腸道微生物相，為早期生活史硬骨魚類的熱耐受機制提供了整合性的觀點。

papers.title: Silent Infection, Early Warning: Animals as Candidate Sentinels for Crimean–Congo Haemorrhagic Fever Surveillance—A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) is a widely distributed tick-borne arbovirus maintained in an enzootic cycle involving wild and domestic mammals and ixodid ticks, particularly Hyalomma. This systematic review synthesised 390 eligible publication-level reports published from 2015 through 31 August 2026, comprising 351 independent quantitative reports and 39 linked/nonadditive publications. The evidence tables contained 150 animal, 106 tick and 180 human records across 69 countries. Serology dominated animal investigations; among reports with species-specific raw counts, antibody positivity was highest in camels (72.9%; 3918/5377 across 23 reports), followed by red deer (41.4%) and cattle (25.1%). Among 106 tick reports, CCHFV-positive Hyalomma and Rhipicephalus were reported in 80 (75.5%) and 41 (38.7%), respectively. Human sensitivity analyses yielded median estimates of 3.8% for antibody positivity, 13.6% for direct/composite viral detection and 20.0% for case fatality. These summaries are descriptive rather than pooled prevalence estimates. Overall, the evidence supports livestock and tick surveillance as complementary components of One Health surveillance, while prospective temporal studies are needed to establish predictive early-warning performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 克里米亞－剛果出血熱病毒（Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, CCHFV）是一種廣泛分布的蜱媒蟲媒病毒，維持於包含野生與家養哺乳動物及硬蜱（特別是璃眼蜱屬）之動物傳染病循環中。本系統性文獻回顧綜合分析了自2015年至2026年8月31日間發布的390篇符合條件之出版物級別報告，包含351份獨立定量報告以及39份相關／非累加出版物。證據表格包含來自69個國家的150筆動物、106筆蜱蟲及180筆人類紀錄。血清學調查在動物研究中佔主體；在具有物種特異性原始計數的報告中，抗體陽性率以駱駝最高（72.9%；涵蓋23份報告中的3918/5377），其次為赤鹿（41.4%）與牛（25.1%）。在106份蜱蟲報告中，分別有80份（75.5%）和41份（38.7%）報告檢出CCHFV陽性的璃眼蜱屬（Hyalomma）與扇頭蜱屬（Rhipicephalus）。人類敏感性分析得出之抗體陽性率、直接／綜合病毒檢出率及病例致死率的中位數估計值分別為3.8%、13.6%和20.0%。這些總結屬於描述性而非合併盛行率估計值。整體而言，此證據支持將家畜與蜱蟲監測作為「同一健康」（One Health）監測的互補組成部分，同時需要前瞻性時間序列研究來確立預測性早期預警效能。

papers.title: Wildlife as a Potential Reservoir of Paratuberculosis: Molecular Evidence of Mycobacterium avium Subspecies paratuberculosis in a Biosphere Reserve, the Sudan
papers.abstract: Mycobacterium avium subspecies paratuberculosis (MAP) causes paratuberculosis (PTB), a chronic wasting enteritis of domestic and wild ruminants. Although the disease and/or its aetiology have been reported in livestock in the Sudan, they have not been investigated in wild animals. This study investigated MAP DNA prevalence in the Dinder National Park (DNP) to provide baseline data on PTB in wildlife. Fresh faecal samples (n = 274) of wild ruminants were collected from the ground around the six major water ponds of the DNP (44–48 samples/pond). Faecal DNA was extracted using a rapid extraction protocol and tested for MAP DNA using a real-time recombinase-aided amplification (RAA) assay. The vegetation structure around the ponds was observed and described. MAP DNA detection rates around the ponds ranged between 64.4% and 22.9%, with an overall apparent prevalence of 37.9% and a sensitivity/specificity-adjusted sample positivity of 42.4%. The faecal samples belonged to Reedbuck (Redunca redunca), Warthog (Phacochoerus aethiopicus), Waterbuck (Kobus defasa), African Buffalo (Syncerus caffer), Oribi (Ourebia ourebia), and among which MAP DNA detection rates were 39.4% (28/71), 39.1% (18/46), 38.0% (27/71), 37.5% (12/32) and 35.2% (19/54), respectively. The vegetation pattern around the ponds showed a notable difference that was consistent with MAP DNA detection. These results are consistent with the potential role of wildlife in paratuberculosis maintenance and transmission. Future investigations, including genotyping, would identify possible cross-transmission of the pathogen at the wildlife-domestic animal interface.
papers.abstract_zh: 副結核分枝桿菌禽結核亞種（*Mycobacterium avium* subspecies *paratuberculosis*, MAP）會引起副結核病（paratuberculosis, PTB），這是一種發生在家畜和野生反芻動物身上的慢性消耗性腸炎。儘管蘇丹的家畜已有人員通報該疾病及其病因，但對於野生動物的研究尚屬空白。本研究調查了丁德爾國家公園（Dinder National Park, DNP）中 MAP DNA 的盛行率，以為野生動物副結核病提供基準數據。從 DNP 六個主要水塘周圍的地面採集了野生反芻動物的新鮮糞便樣本（n = 274，每個水塘 44–48 個樣本）。使用快速萃取方案萃取糞便 DNA，並利用即時重組酶輔助擴增（real-time recombinase-aided amplification, RAA）檢測 MAP DNA。觀察並描述了水塘周圍的植被結構。水塘周圍的 MAP DNA 檢出率介於 64.4% 至 22.9% 之間，總體表面盛行率為 37.9%，經敏感度／特異度調整後的樣本陽性率為 42.4%。糞便樣本分別來自葦羚（*Redunca redunca*）、疣豬（*Phacochoerus aethiopicus*）、水羚（*Kobus defasa*）、非洲水牛（*Syncerus caffer*）以及鸝羚（*Ourebia ourebia*），其 MAP DNA 檢出率分別為 39.4% (28/71)、39.1% (18/46)、38.0% (27/71)、37.5% (12/32) 和 35.2% (19/54)。水塘周圍的植被模式呈顯著差異，這與 MAP DNA 的檢出情形相符。這些結果與野生動物在副結核病維持與傳播中扮演的潛在角色相符。未來的研究（包括基因型分型）將有助於識別該病原體在野生動物與家畜交界處的可能交叉傳播。

papers.title: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Brucellosis: Diagnosis, Genomic Analysis, Epidemiological Prediction and Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Brucellosis, a globally significant zoonosis caused by Brucella, poses a substantial impediment to the sustainable development of the livestock industry and threatens public health security. Traditional control and prevention strategies for brucellosis suffer from fundamental limitations. These include the time-consuming, biosafety risks associated with bacterial culture and the difficulty in differentiating between natural infection and vaccine-induced immunity with serological tests. There remains a challenge in accurately distinguishing vaccine strains from wild-type strains via genotyping methods. Furthermore, current practice relies on manual reporting and empirical judgment without real-time data support. Consequently, these challenges could hinder early detection and reduce the efficiency of large-scale screening, which leads to imprecise outbreak tracing and fails to meet the practical demands of modern livestock production for rapid diagnosis, intelligent prevention and control. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies have been widely applied in the field of veterinary microbiology, which could offer novel technical pathways for the prevention and control of brucellosis. This paper reviews the latest research progress in the application of AI for the rapid diagnosis of brucellosis, genomic analysis and antimicrobial resistance prediction of Brucella, epidemiological risk early warning and the development of drugs and vaccines. We further analyze the current limitations of AI in brucellosis research including the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets, insufficient model interpretability and low efficiency in on-site translation and implementation. The paper provides an outlook on the future development of AI-based intelligent prevention and control systems for brucellosis, which offer a theoretical reference and innovative perspectives for the fundamental research and clinical application of AI technologies. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first review to integrate AI applications across the entire chain of brucellosis prevention and control and to propose a conceptual framework for AI-driven intelligent brucellosis management.
papers.abstract_zh: 布魯氏菌病是由布魯氏菌屬引起、具有全球重要性的人畜共通傳染病，對畜牧業的可持續發展構成重大阻礙，並威脅公共衛生安全。傳統的布魯氏菌病防控策略存在根本上的侷限性，包括細菌培養耗時且伴隨生物安全風險，以及血清學檢測難以區分自然感染與疫苗誘導免疫。透過基因分型方法準確區分疫苗株與野生型菌株仍是一大挑戰。此外，現行實務依賴人工通報與經驗判斷，缺乏即時數據支援。因此，這些挑戰可能妨礙早期檢測並降低大規模篩檢的效率，導致疫情追蹤不夠精準，無法滿足現代畜牧生產對快速診斷、智慧化防控的實際需求。近年來，人工智慧（AI）與機器學習（ML）技術已廣泛應用於獸醫微生物學領域，為布魯氏菌病的防控提供了新穎的技術途徑。本文綜述了人工智慧在布魯氏菌病快速診斷、布魯氏菌基因體分析與抗生素抗藥性預測、流行病學風險預警以及藥物和疫苗開發應用方面的最新研究進展。我們進一步分析了人工智慧在布魯氏菌病研究中的現有限制，包括高品質標註數據集的匱乏、模型可解釋性不足，以及現場轉化與實施效率低下。本文對基於人工智慧的布魯氏菌病智慧化防控系統的未來發展進行了展望，為人工智慧技術的基礎研究與臨床應用提供了理論參考與創新視角。據我們所知，這是第一篇整合布魯氏菌病全鏈條防控中人工智慧應用，並提出人工智慧驅動之布魯氏菌病智慧化管理概念框架的綜述文獻。

papers.title: Association Between Body Condition Score and Early Radiographic Osteotomy Healing Following Tibial Plateau Leveling Osteotomy in Dogs: A Retrospective Study
papers.abstract: Body condition may be associated with postoperative orthopedic outcomes, but its relationship with early radiographic osteotomy healing following tibial plateau leveling osteotomy (TPLO) remains unclear. This retrospective study evaluated the association between preoperative body condition score (BCS) and early radiographic outcomes after TPLO for canine cranial cruciate ligament disease. Seventy-six stifles from 68 dogs with eligible radiographs obtained 42–70 days postoperatively were included. Radiographic osteotomy healing was assessed using a TPLO-specific modified Radiographic Union Scale for Tibial fractures (mRUST), and tibial plateau angle (TPA) was measured preoperatively, immediately postoperatively, and at follow-up. Seventy-one stifles were evaluable for mRUST and 72 for follow-up TPA. Higher BCS was associated with lower mRUST after adjustment for age, body weight, and follow-up interval (β = −0.433 per BCS point; 95% CI, −0.565 to −0.301; p < 0.001). Higher BCS was also associated with a modestly greater postoperative TPA change in the prespecified secondary analysis (β = +0.340° per BCS point; 95% CI, 0.021–0.659; p = 0.037). Higher preoperative BCS was associated with lower early radiographic osteotomy healing scores and a greater increase in TPA during follow-up after TPLO.
papers.abstract_zh: 體態可能與術後骨科預后相關，但其與脛骨高原平整術（TPLO）後早期放射學截骨癒合的關係仍不清楚。本回顧性研究評估術前體態評分（BCS）與犬隻前十字韌帶疾病接受TPLO後早期放射學預后之間的關聯。納入了68隻犬的76個膝關節，其具備術後42至70天獲得的合格X光片。使用TPLO專用的改良式脛骨骨折癒合評分量表（mRUST）評估放射學截骨癒合情況，並在術前、術後立即及追蹤時測量脛骨高原角（TPA）。76個膝關節中有71個可評估mRUST，72個可評估追蹤TPA。在調整年齡、體重和追蹤間隔後，較高的BCS與較低的mRUST相關（每個BCS分點之 $\beta = -0.433$；95% CI, $-0.565$ 至 $-0.301$；$p < 0.001$）。在預先指定的次要分析中，較高的BCS亦與較大的術後TPA變化幅度輕度相關（每個BCS分點之 $\beta = +0.340^\circ$；95% CI, $0.021$ 至 $0.659$；$p = 0.037$）。較高的術前BCS與TPLO後較低的早期放射學截骨癒合評分以及追蹤期間較大的TPA增加量相關。

papers.title: From Microbiome Associations to Deployable Precision Probiotics in Animals: A Critical Narrative Review and Proposed Causal Evidence Framework for Next-Generation Probiotic Development
papers.abstract: Next-generation probiotics (NGPs) are promoted as precision tools for animal health, yet the term is often applied to uncommon taxa before causality, safety and target-species efficacy are established. This critical narrative review reframes animal NGPs as a development pathway rather than a taxonomic category. A structured PubMed search was last run on 14 September 2026 with a publication date cutoff of 1 September 2026 and was supplemented by citation tracing and targeted searches of authoritative sources. From the screened literature, 45 representative and conceptually informative sources were purposively selected for the final narrative synthesis; the review was not intended to provide systematic or exhaustive coverage. The detailed synthesis focused on terrestrial farm and companion animals, whereas equine, rabbit and aquaculture studies were treated as boundary evidence. We evaluate how strain-resolved metagenomics, culturomics, metatranscriptomics, metaproteomics, metabolomics, host transcriptomics, machine learning, metabolic modeling and perturbation systems can move discovery beyond association. Studies across animal sectors show many biomarkers but limited causal validation, strain tracking, formulation data, multisite trials and ecological safety assessment. We propose an author-developed conceptual framework comprising a cumulative evidence ladder, from reproducible associations to field-ready deployment, and the ANIMAL-NGP reporting checklist (Animal endotype, Native ecological fit, Identity and genomic safety, Mechanism, Administration and manufacturing, and Longitudinal validation). These tools are intended to align claims with evidence and require prospective application and external validation. Multi-omics should therefore function as an evidence-navigation system, not as a substitute for causality.
papers.abstract_zh: 新一代益生菌（NGPs）被推廣為促進動物健康的精準工具，然而在確立其因果關係、安全性與標的物種效用之前，此術語往往就被應用於罕見的分類群。本篇批判性敘述性文獻回顧將動物新一代益生菌重新界定為一條發展途徑，而非一個分類學範疇。結構化 PubMed 檢索最後於 2026 年 9 月 14 日執行，出版日期截止至 2026 年 9 月 1 日，並輔以引文追蹤及對權威來源的針對性檢索。從篩選出的文獻中，有目的性地選出 45 篇具代表性且具概念性資訊的來源進行最終的敘述性綜合；本回顧並非旨在提供系統性或全面性的涵蓋。詳細的綜合分析聚焦於陸生家畜與伴侶動物，而馬、兔及水產養殖的研究則被視為邊界證據。我們評估了菌株解析巨基因體學、培養體學、巨轉錄體學、巨蛋白質體學、代謝體學、宿主轉錄體學、機器學習、代謝建模與擾動系統如何能推動發現超越單純的相關性。跨動物領域的研究顯示，許多生物標記但有限的因果驗證、菌株追蹤、配方數據、多中心試驗與生態安全性評估。我們提出了一個由作者發展的概念框架，包含一個從可重複的相關性到可現場部署的累積證據階梯，以及 ANIMAL-NGP 報告檢核表（動物內表現型 [Endotype]、原生生態適應性 [Native ecological fit]、身分與基因體安全性 [Identity and genomic safety]、機制 [Mechanism]、給藥與製造 [Administration and manufacturing]、以及縱向驗證 [Longitudinal validation]）。這些工具旨在使宣稱與證據一致，並需要前瞻性應用與外部驗證。因此，多體學應作為一個證據導航系統，而非因果關係的替代品。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Snake Species Identification to Support Snakebite Treatment: A Comparative Study of Efficient CNN and Vision Transformer Architectures
papers.abstract: Snakebite envenoming is a neglected tropical disease that affects millions of people each year, and species identification is a critical component in choosing the correct antivenom. In this study, six convolutional neural network and vision transformer architectures are compared for the image-based snake species classification task on the SnakeCLEF 2024 dataset, which contains 1599 snake species observed in 209 countries. We use knowledge distillation to boost accuracy without increasing inference cost, and incorporate country-level geographic location through a closed-form Bayesian fusion of the classifier’s output with location-conditioned species-occurrence priors. Location fusion reduced the classification error rate by over 40% across all architectures, and knowledge distillation provided a further improvement. The best model, CAFormer-S18, obtained an accuracy of 81.71% using both image and country-level location. We also compare the single-image inference latency on a smartphone and a Raspberry Pi 5, revealing that the latency of real-world, on-device deployments is significantly influenced by the interplay of model architecture and inference toolchain. Our top-performing model can infer in about 1 s on both devices, demonstrating that fine-grained species identification of snakes is feasible for real-time use in snakebite treatment and, when combined with an additional object detection stage, in wildlife monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛇咬傷中毒是一種被忽視的熱帶疾病，每年影響數百萬人，而物種辨識是選擇正確抗蛇毒血清的關鍵環節。在本研究中，我們針對 SnakeCLEF 2024 資料集（包含在 209 個國家中觀察到的 1599 種蛇類）的基於影像之蛇類物種分類任務，比較了六種卷積神經網路與視覺轉換器架構。我們使用知識蒸餾來提升準確率而不增加推論成本，並透過將分類器輸出與國家層級的地點條件物種出現先驗機率進行封閉式貝氏融合，納入了國家層級的地理位置。地點融合使所有架構的分類錯誤率降低了 40% 以上，而知識蒸餾則帶來了進一步的改善。表現最好的模型 CAFormer-S18 同時使用影像與國家層級地點時，獲得了 81.71% 的準確率。我們亦比較了智慧型手機和 Raspberry Pi 5 上的單張影像推論延遲，結果顯示現實世界中裝置端部署的延遲顯著受到模型架構與推論工具鏈交互作用的影響。我們表現最佳的模型在兩款裝置上皆可以大約 1 秒的時間完成推論，這證明瞭細粒度的蛇類物種辨識適用於蛇咬傷治療的即時使用，且若結合額外的物件偵測階段，亦可應用於野生動物監測。

papers.title: A Newly Established Fin Cell Line from Tomato Hind (Cephalopholis sonnerati) and Transcriptome Profiling Characterizing Its Response to Vibrio harveyi Infection
papers.abstract: The tomato hind (Cephalopholis sonnerati) is an emerging mariculture species increasingly threatened by Vibrio harveyi infection, yet in vitro tools for studying its immune defense remain limited. Here, we established a novel fin-derived fibroblast-like cell line, designated Tomato hind Grouper Fin (TGF), from C. sonnerati using the tissue explant method. TGF cells have been stably subcultured for more than 83 passages in Leibovitz’s L-15 medium supplemented with 20% fetal bovine serum at 28 °C. Species authentication via mt-co1 barcoding confirmed 99.9% sequence identity, and karyotype analysis revealed a diploid chromosome number of 2n = 48, matching the donor species. TGF cells exhibited robust post-thaw viability (>80%) and were amenable to exogenous nucleic acid delivery, with higher efficiency for siRNA than plasmid DNA. To evaluate immune competence, TGF cells were challenged with V. harveyi, and transcriptomic profiling was performed at 60, 90, and 120 min post-infection. A total of 1876 differentially expressed genes were identified at 120 min. KEGG enrichment analysis revealed sustained activation of Toll-like receptor, NOD-like receptor, NF-κB, TNF, and IL-17 signaling pathways across all time points. The TGF cell line represents a valuable in vitro resource for studying host–pathogen interactions of C. sonnerati.
papers.abstract_zh: 紅斑格（Cephalopholis sonnerati）是一種新興的海水養殖魚種，正面臨哈維氏弧菌（Vibrio harveyi）感染日益嚴重的威脅，然而用於研究其免疫防禦的體外（in vitro）工具仍然有限。本研究利用組織塊培養法，從紅斑格建立了一個全新的鰭源成纖維細胞樣細胞株，命名為紅斑格石斑魚鰭細胞（Tomato hind Grouper Fin, TGF）。TGF 細胞在含有 20% 胎牛血清的 Leibovitz’s L-15 培養基中、28 °C 條件下已穩定繼代超過 83 代。透過 mt-co1 DNA條形碼進行物種鑑定，確認其序列相似度達 99.9%；核型分析顯示其二倍體染色體數為 2n = 48，與供體物種相符。TGF 細胞展現出良好的解凍後存活率（>80%），且適合外源性核酸遞送，其中 siRNA 的轉染效率高於質體 DNA。為評估其免疫能力，本研究以哈維氏弧菌攻擊 TGF 細胞，並在感染後 60、90 和 120 分鐘進行轉錄體分析。在 120 分鐘時共鑑定出 1876 個差異表現基因。KEGG 富集分析顯示，Toll 樣受體、NOD 樣受體、NF-κB、TNF 和 IL-17 等信號傳遞途徑在所有時間點皆持續被活化。TGF 細胞株為研究紅斑格宿主與病原體交互作用提供了一項寶貴的體外研究資源。

papers.title: Estimation of Greenhouse Gas Emission Factor During Hanwoo Manure Composting
papers.abstract: Accurate estimation of climate-altering gases, such as methane and nitrous oxide, from livestock waste treatment is critical for establishing national inventories. This study aims to monitor and analyze the emission characteristics of these gases during the treatment process at an operational Hanwoo (Korean cattle for beef) farm in Republic of Korea to develop country-specific metrics. A full-scale compost shed was modified into a 2400 m3 flux chamber equipped with fans to control airflow at 183 m3·min−1. Real-time gas concentrations were measured using enhanced-performance laser-based analyzers across summer, autumn, and winter. The results indicated that mean emissions for both methane and nitrous oxide were highest in summer, followed by winter, and lowest in autumn. Daily patterns revealed higher hourly mean emissions during the morning and afternoon. The final estimated emission factors were 1.28 kgCH4·head−1·yr−1 and 0.039 kgN2O· head−1·yr−1. These values are relatively lower than those reported in previous studies. These values were lower than those reported in several previous studies. Differences in facility scale and operating conditions may partly explain this result; however, potential underestimation due to non-uniform airflow should also be considered.
papers.abstract_zh: 準確估計畜牧廢棄物處理過程中產生的氣候變遷相關氣體（如甲烷和氧化亞氮）對於建立國家清冊至關重要。本研究旨在監測與分析大韓民國一座營運中的韓牛（肉牛）農場在處理過程中這些氣體的排放特徵，以建立符合國情的係數。研究將一座全尺寸堆肥舍改造為 2400 立方公尺的通量室，並配備風扇以將氣流控制在每分鐘 183 立方公尺。利用高效能雷射分析儀，在夏季、秋季和冬季對即時氣體濃度進行了測量。結果顯示，甲烷和氧化亞氮的平均排放量均以夏季最高、冬季次之、秋季最低。每日變化模式顯示，早晨和下午的每小時平均排放量較高。最終估算的排放係數分別為每頭每年 1.28 公斤甲烷（1.28 kgCH4·head−1·yr−1）以及每頭每年 0.039 公斤氧化亞氮（0.039 kgN2O·head−1·yr−1）。這些數值相對低於先前研究所報告的結果。設施規模和營運條件的差異或許能部分解釋此結果；然而，非均勻氣流可能導致的低估亦應納入考量。

papers.title: Free-Ranging Cat Predation on Wildlife in East Asia: A Scoping Review of Ecological Evidence and Knowledge Gaps
papers.abstract: Free-ranging domestic cats (Felis catus) interact with wildlife through predation and other ecological pathways, yet evidence of their associated effects has not been comprehensively synthesized in East Asia. This scoping review mapped empirical evidence on free-ranging cat predation and associated ecological effects in East Asia, characterized its geographic distribution and inferential strength, and identified knowledge gaps. Five databases, including region-specific databases, were searched through June 2026, and reference lists of included full-text sources were hand-searched. Of 9326 records identified, 31 sources met the inclusion criteria: 28 from the pre-specified East Asian region and 3 global or multinational sources with independently extractable East Asia-specific data. Diet- and carcass-based studies documented consumption of diverse wildlife taxa, whereas fewer evaluated prey abundance or other population-level outcomes. Reported predation estimates varied substantially among studies, reflecting differences in cat category, ecological setting, and methodology. Evidence was concentrated in Japan, with the clearest conservation concerns reported from Japanese island ecosystems involving endemic or IUCN-listed threatened species. Human-mediated factors and management practices were recurrent contextual themes; however, direct evidence linking these factors to wildlife outcomes was limited. Overall, the evidence base was geographically and methodologically uneven, underscoring the need for standardization, broader regional coverage, and improved documentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 放山家貓（Felis catus）透過掠食及其他生態途徑與野生動物互動，然而其相關影響的證據尚未在東亞進行全面綜合。本範疇性文獻回顧（scoping review）旨在梳理東亞地區有關放山貓掠食及其相關生態影響的實證資料、描繪其地理分佈與推論強度，並識別知識缺口。本研究檢索了包括區域專屬資料庫在內的五個資料庫（截至2026年6月），並手動檢索了納入之全文文獻的參考文獻列表。在識別出的9,326筆記錄中，有31篇文獻符合納入標準：28篇來自預先指定的東亞地區，3篇為可獨立萃取東亞專屬資料的全球性或跨國文獻。基於食性與屍體的研究記錄了貓隻對多樣化野生動物分類群的消耗，但評估獵物豐度或其他族群層面結果的研究較少。研究所報告的掠食估計值差異甚大，反映出貓隻類別、生態環境與方法的差異。證據集中於日本，其中最明確的保育疑慮來自涉及特有種或IUCN列名受脅物種的日本島嶼生態系。人為因素與管理實務是反覆出現的背景主題；然而，將這些因素與野生動物結果直接連結的證據相當有限。整體而言，現有證據基礎在地理分佈與方法學上存在落差，凸顯了標準化、擴大區域涵蓋範圍以及改進記錄方式的迫切需求。

papers.title: Still Valid: Clearance of Pseudocapillaroides xenopi from a Xenopus laevis Colony Using the 1997 Levamisole Immersion Protocol
papers.abstract: Pseudocapillaroides xenopi is a capillariid nematode of the epidermis of Xenopus spp. and a cause of “flaky” or “gray skin disease” in laboratory colonies. The only published regimen for eradicating it from an entire colony, which is a levamisole immersion, dates from 1997. We report its unmodified application in a colony of approximately 480 adult female X. laevis. An index animal with pale, roughened skin and severe weight loss was diagnosed by PCR. Screening all 42 cohabitants of three tanks each holding one animal with macroscopic skin abnormalities gave a prevalence of 21.4% (9/42), with seven of them clinically inconspicuous. Two four-day levamisole baths (12 mg/L) ten days apart, with tank cleaning and dedicated equipment, were applied colony-wide. Post-treatment skin scrapings were negative in 42/42 animals, gross lesions resolved, body weight was maintained and no further cases have occurred. The 1997 protocol remains fully effective. As the untreated infection is ultimately fatal and the alternative to treatment is depopulation, a regimen that reliably clears a colony is also a refinement.
papers.abstract_zh: Pseudocapillaroides xenopi 是一種會寄生於爪蟾屬（Xenopus spp.）表皮的毛細線蟲，也是實驗動物群體中引起「鱗片狀」或「灰皮膚病」的病因。目前唯一發表可用於從整個群體中根除該寄生蟲的療程為左旋咪唑（levamisole）浸泡法，發表於 1997 年。我們報導了該方案在一個約有 480 隻成年雌性非洲爪蟾（X. laevis）群體中的未修改應用。透過 PCR 診斷出一隻具有皮膚蒼白、粗糙且體重嚴重下降的指標動物。篩檢了三個飼養槽中共 42 隻同居動物（每槽各有一隻具有肉眼可見皮膚異常的動物），盛行率為 21.4%（9/42），其中 7 隻在臨床上並無顯著症狀。全群實施了兩次為期四天、間隔十天的左旋咪唑藥浴（12 mg/L），並配合清洗飼槽及專用設備。治療後，42/42 隻動物的皮膚刮片檢查結果皆為陰性，巨觀病灶消失，體重維持正常，且未再發生其他病例。1997 年的方案依然完全有效。由於未治療的感染最終會致命，且治療的替代方案是撲殺，因此能夠可靠地清除群體感染的療程同時也是一種動物福利的精進（refinement）。

papers.title: Integrative Multi‐Omics Analysis Identifies Candidate MicroRNA Regulatory Networks Associated With High‐Altitude Adaptation in Tibetan Pigs
papers.abstract: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are key posttranscriptional regulators of gene expression and play important roles in physiological responses to hypoxia, particularly in the cardiovascular system. However, the regulatory roles of miRNAs in cardiopulmonary tissues during high‐altitude adaptation remain poorly understood. Tibetan pigs are a high‐altitude‐adapted breed with strong hypoxia tolerance, making them an ideal model for investigating the molecular mechanisms underlying high‐altitude adaptation. In this study, we compared miRNA expression profiles between Tibetan pigs and low‐altitude Meishan pigs and integrated multi‐omics data to investigate miRNA‐mediated regulatory networks, with a particular focus on target genes and 3'UTR genetic variation. Small RNA and mRNA sequencing of heart and lung tissues identified 70 differentially expressed miRNAs and 453 candidate target genes associated with hypoxia adaptation, which were significantly enriched in pathways such as vascular smooth muscle contraction. Integrative analysis of whole‐genome resequencing data from 20 Tibetan pigs and 17 Meishan pigs further revealed that genetic variants within 3'UTR regions may contribute to the modulation of miRNA‐mRNA interactions. Notably, we identified a highly differentiated SNP within the predicted miR‐221‐5p binding site in the 3'UTR of RAB17 , suggesting a potential role of this variant in posttranscriptional regulation. Dual‐luciferase reporter assays and functional validation further supported a regulatory interaction between miR‐221‐5p and the RAB17 3'UTR. Collectively, these findings provide an integrative multi‐omics framework for elucidating candidate miRNA regulatory networks associated with high‐altitude adaptation and highlight the potential contribution of miRNA‐mediated posttranscriptional regulation and 3'UTR genetic variation to high‐altitude adaptation in Tibetan pigs.
papers.abstract_zh: 微小核糖核酸（miRNAs）是基因表現的關鍵轉錄後調節因子，在缺氧的生理反應中扮演重要角色，特別是在心血管系統中。然而，miRNAs在高原適應期間的心肺組織中的調節作用仍所知有限。藏豬是一個具有強大耐缺氧能力的高原適應品種，使其成為探討高原適應分子機制的理想模型。在本研究中，我們比較了藏豬與低海拔梅山豬之間的miRNA表現譜，並整合多體學數據來探討miRNA介導的調節網路，特別聚焦於標靶基因與3'UTR基因變異。對心臟和肺部組織進行的小型核糖核酸及mRNA定序，識別出70個與缺氧適應相關的差異表現miRNA以及453個候選標靶基因，這些基因在血管平滑肌收縮等路徑中顯著富集。對20隻藏豬和17隻梅山豬的全基因組重定序數據進行的整合分析進一步顯示，3'UTR區域內的基因變異可能參與調控miRNA與mRNA的交互作用。值得注意的是，我們在 $RAB17$ 基因3'UTR的預測 miR-221-5p 結合位點內識別出一個高度分化的SNP，這暗示了此變異在轉錄後調節中的潛在作用。雙螢光素酶報告基因檢定與功能驗證進一步支持了 miR-221-5p 與 $RAB17$ 3'UTR 之間的調節交互作用。總體而言，這些發現提供了一個整合的多體學框架，用於闡明與高原適應相關的候選miRNA調節網路，並突顯了miRNA介導的轉錄後調節及3'UTR基因變異對藏豬高原適應的潛在貢獻。

papers.title: ABCB1 Frameshift Deletion in Skye Terriers With Potential Pharmacogenetic Relevance
papers.abstract: Ivermectin‐associated neurotoxicity is a potentially life‐threatening condition caused by disruption of the ABCB1 encoded P‐glycoprotein drug transporter in certain dog breeds. Skye terriers are considered at increased risk of ivermectin toxicity despite the absence of an identified molecular cause. We searched the Dog10K variant dataset for ABCB1 variants potentially underlying ivermectin sensitivity in Skye terriers and screened an independent cohort of 27 dogs to confirm sequence variants. A 1‐bp frameshift deletion predicted to cause loss of function in ABCB1 was identified in two of three Skye terriers in the Dog10K dataset and was absent from all 1869 non‐Skye‐terrier genomes. The variant had an allele frequency of 16.7% in the independent Skye terrier cohort. This is the first reported ABCB1 variant in Skye terriers and represents a plausible candidate genetic basis for the anecdotally observed ivermectin sensitivity in the breed.
papers.abstract_zh: 伊vermectin（驅蟲敏）相關的神經毒性是一種潛在危及生命的病症，由特定犬種體內由 $ABCB1$ 基因編碼的 P-醣蛋白藥物轉運體功能受損所引起。儘管尚未確認其分子病因，斯凱爹利（Skye terriers）被認為具有較高的伊維菌素毒性風險。我們搜尋了 Dog10K 變異數據集，以尋找可能導致斯凱爹利對伊維菌素敏感的 $ABCB1$ 變異，並篩查了一個包含 27 隻狗的獨立群組以確認序列變異。在 Dog10K 數據集的三隻斯凱爹利中，有兩隻被識別出一個預期會導致 $ABCB1$ 功能喪失的 1-bp 移碼缺失，而在所有 1869 個非斯凱爹利基因組中均不存在此缺失。該變異在獨立的斯凱爹利群組中的等位基因頻率為 16.7%。這是首次報導的斯凱爹利 $ABCB1$ 變異，並為該犬種中觀察到的軼事性伊維菌素敏感性提供了合理的候選基因基礎。

papers.title: FLCN Multi‐Exon Deletion in a Chihuahua With Renal Cysts and Nodular Dermatofibrosis
Molecular modelling study on Piper betle phytocompounds to discover the potential active moiety responsible for xanthine oxidase inhibition in avian gout
papers.abstract: 1. This study investigated the phytochemicals responsible for xanthine oxidase (XO) inhibitory activity in Piper betle L. herb. In silico analysis was performed against the active sites of XO using 32 phytocompounds from P. betle along with the known inhibitor allopurinol used in avian gout treatment.2. Functions including docking score and GLIDE score, ADME analyses using QikProp module and toxicity assessment with ProTox-II server. Molecular dynamics simulations were performed for 100 ns with GROMACS software to evaluate the stability and fluctuations of the protein–ligand complexes.3. The results revealed that 12 phytocompounds of P. betle exhibited higher GLIDE XP docking scores (−6.881 to −4.766 kcal/mol) compared to allopurinol (−4.535 kcal/mol) and 11 phytocompounds showed higher GLIDE energy (−42.822 kcal/mol to −36.706 kcal/mol) than allopurinol (−32.676 kcal/mol). Among these, 4-chromanol and 4-allyl-1,2-diacetoxybenzene were identified as the most potent compounds of P. betle, forming hydrogen bond interactions with XO similar to allopurinol.4. The ADME analyses showed that selected phytocompounds met the ADME descriptors and did not violate Lipinski’s ‘rule of five’ and toxicity assessment yielded satisfactory results. Furthermore, 100 ns MD simulations showed a stable trajectory and less conformational variation (RMSD, RMSF) along with a steady interaction profile observed throughout the simulations. The MM‑GBSA calculations supported the docking studies.5. The data showed that 4-chromanol and 4-allyl-1, 2-diacetoxybenzene phytocompounds present in P. betle might account for antigout activity through XO inhibition, meaning that these could be developed as potential drug molecules.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究探討了荖葉（*Piper betle* L.）中具有黃嘌呤氧化酶（XO）抑制活性的植物化學成分。利用來自荖葉的 32 種植物化合物以及用於治療鳥類痛風的已知抑制劑别嘌呤醇（allopurinol），針對 XO 的活性位點進行了電腦模擬（in silico）分析。
2. 功能分析包含對接分數（docking score）與 GLIDE 分數、使用 QikProp 模組進行 ADME（吸收、分佈、代謝、排泄）分析，以及透過 ProTox-II 伺服器進行毒性評估。使用 GROMACS 軟體進行 100 奈秒（ns）的分子動力學模擬，以評估蛋白質－配體複合物的穩定性與波動。
3. 結果顯示，與别嘌呤醇（−4.535 kcal/mol）相比，荖葉中有 12 種植物化合物表現出更高的 GLIDE XP 對接分數（−6.881 至 −4.766 kcal/mol）；有 11 種植物化合物表現出比别嘌呤醇（−32.676 kcal/mol）更高的 GLIDE 能量（−42.822 kcal/mol 至 −36.706 kcal/mol）。其中，4-苯并吡喃醇（4-chromanol）與 4-烯丙基-1,2-二乙酰氧基苯（4-allyl-1,2-diacetoxybenzene）被鑑定為荖葉中最具潛力的化合物，能與 XO 形成類似别嘌呤醇的氫鍵相互作用。
4. ADME 分析顯示，所選的植物化合物符合 ADME 描述符且未違反里品斯基「五規則」（Lipinski’s ‘rule of five’），毒性評估也產出了令人滿意的結果。此外，100 奈秒的分子動力學模擬顯示出穩定的軌跡、較小的構象變異（RMSD、RMSF），以及在整個模擬過程中觀察到穩定的相互作用分佈。MM-GBSA 計算結果支持了對接研究。
5. 數據表明，荖葉中存在的 4-苯并吡喃醇與 4-烯丙基-1,2-二乙酰氧基苯等植物化合物，可能透過抑制 XO 發揮抗痛風活性，這意味著它們可被開發為具有潛力的藥物分子。

papers.title: Sanitisation of Enterococcus cecorum attached to the shells of fertilised eggs by carbon dioxide microbubbles and sodium hypochlorite
papers.abstract: 1. Enterococcus cecorum (EC) infection in chicks must be prevented because of its severe pathogenicity in poultry farming. In this study, the combined sanitising effects of sodium hypochlorite (NaClO) and carbon dioxide microbubbles (CO2MB) on artificially applied EC on eggshells were clarified and the effectiveness for sanitising fertilised eggs was investigated.2. The number of surviving EC cells on eggshells decreased with increasing chlorine concentration and treatment time, with the NaClO solution containing CO2MB. The spray treatment of the NaClO solution containing CO2MB was more effective for sanitising EC.3. In addition, sanitisation of EC on fertilised eggs using a NaClO solution containing CO2MB was effective in preventing contamination in the setter, without negative effects on hatching or early growth of chicks.4. Using NaClO solution containing CO2MB was an effective method for sanitising EC on fertilised eggs.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 由於盲腸球菌（Enterococcus cecorum, EC）在家禽飼養中具有嚴重的致病性，因此必須預防雛雞感染。本研究旨在闡明次氯酸鈉（NaClO）與二氧化碳微氣泡（CO2MB）結合對人工接種於蛋殼上之EC的綜合殺菌效果，並探討其對種蛋殺菌的有效性。
2. 在含有CO2MB的NaClO溶液處理下，蛋殼上存活的EC菌數隨著氯濃度和處理時間的增加而減少。含有CO2MB之NaClO溶液的噴霧處理對EC的殺菌效果更為顯著。
3. 此外，使用含有CO2MB的NaClO溶液對種蛋進行殺菌，能有效防止孵化器內的污染，且對雛雞的孵化率或早期生長沒有負面影響。
4. 使用含有CO2MB的NaClO溶液是種蛋上EC殺菌的有效方法。

papers.title: Magnolol enhances yak oocyte maturation and blastocyst quality by improving lipid metabolism and redox homeostasis through a PPARγ-dependent mechanism
papers.abstract: Background Reproductive efficiency in yaks is limited by the poor developmental competence of their oocytes during in vitro maturation (IVM). Magnolol (MAG), a natural polyphenolic compound with potent antioxidant activity, has been reported to regulate cellular metabolism and oxidative stress; however, its role in oocyte maturation and early embryonic development remains unclear. Therefore, this study investigated the effects and molecular mechanisms of MAG on yak oocyte maturation and developmental competence. Methods Yak cumulus–oocyte complexes were cultured in IVM medium supplemented with different concentrations of MAG (0, 0.5, 1, 5, and 10 μmol/L). Oocyte maturation, cumulus expansion, oxidative stress indicators, mitochondrial function, apoptosis, and lipid metabolism were evaluated using fluorescence staining, qPCR, and immunofluorescence analysis. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential targets of MAG, and the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) antagonist GW9662 was applied to verify the regulatory mechanism occurring during IVM and subsequent embryo development. Results Based on the concentration-screening results, 1 μmol/L MAG was selected for subsequent mechanistic and embryo-development analyses. MAG supplementation significantly improved oocyte maturation and cumulus expansion, enhanced glutathione levels and mitochondrial membrane potential, and reduced reactive oxygen species accumulation and apoptosis. MAG also promoted lipid droplet accumulation and upregulated the expression of lipid metabolism–related genes, including PPARG , CD36 , FABP3 , and FABP4 . Network pharmacology identified PPARγ as a key target of MAG. Pharmacological inhibition of PPARγ with GW9662 markedly reversed MAG-induced improvements in lipid metabolism, antioxidant capacity, and oocyte developmental competence. Furthermore, MAG increased blastocyst formation rate, total cell number, and CDX2 expression while reducing the blastocyst apoptosis. Conclusion MAG improves yak oocyte quality and embryonic developmental competence by promoting lipid homeostasis, maintaining redox balance, and enhancing mitochondrial function. The beneficial effects of MAG are closely associated with the involvement of PPARγ signaling in the regulation of lipid homeostasis. These findings provide a potential strategy for improving the efficiency of yak assisted reproductive technologies.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：氂牛的繁殖效率受限於其卵母細胞在體外成熟（IVM）期間較差的發育能力。厚朴酚（Magnolol, MAG）是一種具有強效抗氧化活性的天然多酚類化合物，據報導能調節細胞代謝與氧化壓力；然而，其在卵母細胞成熟與早期胚胎發育中的作用仍不清楚。因此，本研究探討了 MAG 對氂牛卵母細胞成熟與發育能力的作用及其分子機制。方法：將氂牛卵丘—卵母細胞複合體培養於添加不同濃度 MAG（0、0.5、1、5 及 10 μmol/L）的 IVM 培養基中。利用螢光染色、qPCR 及免疫螢光分析，評估卵母細胞成熟度、卵丘擴張、氧化壓力指標、粒線體功能、細胞凋亡與脂質代謝。運用網路藥理學與分子對接預測 MAG 的潛在標靶，並應用過氧化體增殖物活化受體γ（PPARγ）拮抗劑 GW9662，以驗證在 IVM 及後續胚胎發育期間發生的調節機制。結果：根據濃度篩選結果，選擇 1 μmol/L MAG 用於後續的機制與胚胎發育分析。添加 MAG 顯著改善了卵母細胞成熟與卵丘擴張、提高了穀胱甘肽含量與粒線體膜電位，並減少了活性氧自由基的累積與細胞凋亡。MAG 同時促進了脂滴的累積，並上調了脂質代謝相關基因（包括 PPARG、CD36、FABP3 及 FABP4）的表現。網路藥理學鑑定出 PPARγ 為 MAG 的關鍵標靶。以 GW9662 進行 PPARγ 的藥理學抑制，顯著逆轉了 MAG 所誘導的脂質代謝、抗氧化能力及卵母細胞發育能力的提升。此外，MAG 提高了囊胚率、總細胞數及 CDX2 表現量，同時降低了囊胚細胞凋亡。結論：MAG 透過促進脂質恆定、維持氧化還原平衡以及增強粒線體功能，改善了氂牛卵母細胞的品質與胚胎發育能力。MAG 的有益作用與 PPARγ 信號傳導參與脂質恆定的調節密切相關。這些發現為提高氂牛輔助生殖技術的效率提供了潛在策略。

papers.title: The Chromosomal Organization of Isleria hauxwelli and Its Meaning for the Karyotypic Evolution in Thamnophilidae (Passeriformes)
papers.abstract: The order Passeriformes, the most speciose avian order, includes over 6000 species (~60% of all birds). The Amazon Basin alone hosts > 900 bird species, with Passeriformes representing > 500 of them. The family Thamnophilidae comprises ~200 insectivorous species, accounting for 15% of Neotropical passerine richness. Within Thamnophilinae, Isleria is the least speciose genus, containing only two species. It was erected after phylogenetic analyses revealed Myrmotherula as non‐monophyletic. To advance knowledge of chromosomal evolution in Passeriformes, we analyzed the karyotype of Isleria hauxwelli using molecular cytogenetics. We found a diploid number of 2n = 84 and a fundamental number (FN) of 92. The BOE‐7 probe, corresponding to the ancestral fusion of GGA‐9 with two microchromosomes, maintained that configuration without undergoing fission to produce IHA‐5. The BOE‐14 probe, typically fragmented in all cytogenomically characterized Passeriformes, corresponded to two distinct GGA segments: the R3 portion and a region of unknown homology. This is the first documentation of such chromosomal organization in passerines. The absence of these fissions suggests a possible autapomorphic chromosomal condition within Thamnophilidae. Additionally, a potential fission involving microchromosomes homeologous to probes BOE‐15 and BOE‐16 is suggested: while these probes mark three microchromosome pairs in GGA, they mark four pairs in I. hauxwelli —a feature not yet observed in other passerines. As most Thamnophilidae remain cytogenetically uncharacterized, systematic study of this family is essential to determine whether these rearrangements represent synapomorphies, autapomorphies, or convergent events.
papers.abstract_zh: 雀形目（Passeriformes）是鳥類中物種數最多的目，包含超過 6000 種（約佔所有鳥類的 60%）。僅亞馬遜盆地就棲息了超過 900 種鳥類，其中雀形目就佔了 500 多種。蟻鵙科（Thamnophilidae）包含約 200 種食蟲鳥類，佔新熱帶界雀形目豐富度的 15%。在蟻鵙亞科（Thamnophilinae）中，Isleria 是物種數最少的屬，僅包含兩種。該屬是在系統發生分析顯示微雀鯛屬（Myrmotherula）為並系群之後才建立的。為了推進對雀形目染色體演化的了解，我們運用分子細胞遺傳學分析了赫氏細尾蟻鵙（Isleria hauxwelli）的核型。我們發現其二倍體染色體數為 2n = 84，基本數（FN）為 92。對應於原雞（GGA）第 9 號染色體與兩個微小染色體祖先融合的 BOE-7 探針，維持了該構型而未發生分裂以產生 IHA-5。在所有已進行細胞基因體學表徵的雀形目中通常會斷裂的 BOE-14 探針，則對應於兩個不同的 GGA 片段：R3 部分以及一個同源性未知的區域。這是首次在雀形目中記錄到這種染色體組織形式。這些分裂的缺失暗示了蟻鵙科內部可能存在自近裔性狀（autapomorphic）的染色體狀態。此外，研究亦顯示可能發生涉及與 BOE-15 和 BOE-16 探針同源（homeologous）之微小染色體的斷裂：這些探針在 GGA 中標記了三對微小染色體對，但在赫氏細尾蟻鵙中則標記了四對——這是在其他雀形目中尚未觀察到的特徵。由於大多數蟻鵙科鳥類尚未進行細胞遺傳學表徵，對該科進行系統性研究至關重要，以確定這些重排是共近裔性狀（synapomorphies）、自近裔性狀還是趨同演化事件。

papers.title: ZBED6 deletion activates FNDC1-mediated PI3K/AKT and MAPK/ERK1/2 signaling pathways to promote myogenesis in pigs
papers.abstract: Background Myogenesis is a tightly regulated biological process that is essential for skeletal muscle growth, regeneration, and livestock production. Although the transcription factor ZBED6 is a key regulator of skeletal muscle development, the downstream molecular mechanisms through which it controls myogenesis remain incompletely understood. Here, using ZBED6-deficient pigs and primary porcine skeletal muscle satellite cells, we sought to identify novel downstream targets of ZBED6 and elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying ZBED6-mediated regulation of myogenesis. Results By integrating transcriptomic, quantitative proteomic, and ChIP-seq datasets, we identified fibronectin type III domain-containing protein 1 (FNDC1), a muscle-derived secreted factor, as a previously unrecognized direct transcriptional target of ZBED6. ChIP-qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter assays showed that ZBED6 directly binds to the FNDC1 promoter and represses its transcription. Functional analyses in primary porcine skeletal muscle satellite cells showed that ZBED6 knockdown markedly promoted myoblast proliferation, differentiation, and myotube formation, whereas FNDC1 knockdown partially attenuated these effects. Conversely, FNDC1 overexpression partially rescued the impaired myogenesis caused by ZBED6 overexpression. Mechanistically, ZBED6 deficiency promoted porcine myoblast proliferation and differentiation, at least in part, through FNDC1 -mediated activation of the PI3K/AKT and MAPK/ERK1/2 signaling pathways. Consistently, pharmacological inhibition of either pathway significantly attenuated the enhanced porcine myoblast proliferation and differentiation induced by ZBED6 deficiency, supporting that activation of these signaling pathways contributes in part to the pro-myogenic effects mediated by the ZBED6-FNDC1 regulatory axis in porcine myoblasts. Conclusions This study identifies FNDC1 as a novel direct transcriptional target of ZBED6, supporting the ZBED6-FNDC1 axis as a regulatory mechanism contributing to porcine myoblast proliferation and differentiation. These findings expand the current understanding of the ZBED6 regulatory network and provide a cellular framework for future studies investigating skeletal muscle growth in vivo.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：肌肉生成是一個受到嚴密調控的生物學過程，對骨骼肌生長、再生以及家畜生產至關重要。儘管轉錄因子 ZBED6 是骨骼肌發育的關鍵調節因子，但其控制肌肉生成下游的分子機制仍未完全闡明。在此，我們利用 ZBED6 缺陷豬和原代豬骨骼肌衛星細胞，旨在識別 ZBED6 的新型下游標靶，並闡明 ZBED6 介導肌肉生成調節的底層分子機制。結果：透過整合轉錄體學、定量蛋白質體學和 ChIP-seq 數據集，我們將纖維結合蛋白 III 型域包含蛋白 1 (FNDC1，一種肌肉來源的分泌因子) 識別為先前未被發現的 ZBED6 直接轉錄標靶。ChIP-qPCR 和雙螢光素酶報告基因分析顯示，ZBED6 直接結合至 FNDC1 啟動子並抑制其轉錄。在原代豬骨骼肌衛星細胞中的功能分析表明，ZBED6 基因 knockdown（表現抑制）顯著促進了肌原細胞的增殖、分化和肌管形成，而 FNDC1 的 knockdown 則部分減弱了這些效應。相反地，FNDC1 的過度表現部分挽救了由 ZBED6 過度表現所引起的肌肉生成受損。在機制上，ZBED6 缺陷至少部分透過 FNDC1 介導的 PI3K/AKT 和 MAPK/ERK1/2 信號通路活化，促進了豬肌原細胞的增殖與分化。一致地，對任一信號通路的藥理學抑制均顯著減弱了由 ZBED6 缺陷所誘導的豬肌原細胞增殖與分化的增強效果，支持了這些信號通路的活化部分促成了豬肌原細胞中由 ZBED6-FNDC1 調節軸所介導的促肌肉生成效應。結論：本研究將 FNDC1 識別為 ZBED6 的一個新型直接轉錄標靶，支持 ZBED6-FNDC1 軸作為促進豬肌原細胞增殖與分化的調節機制。這些發現擴展了當前對 ZBED6 調節網絡的理解，並為未來研究活體骨骼肌生長的細胞學研究提供了框架。

papers.title: Chestnut–quebracho tannins shape the fecal metabolome of weaned pigs through microbiota-dependent urolithin production
papers.abstract: Background Chestnut and quebracho tannins may support gut health in weaned piglets, but their efficacy likely depends on farm environment and microbial capacity to convert tannins into bioactive metabolites. This study evaluated the effects of a blend of chestnut-derived hydrolysable tannins and quebracho-derived condensed tannins on growth performance, diarrhea occurrence, gut metagenome, and fecal metabolome in piglets reared under two commercial farm conditions. A total of 160 weaned piglets (initial body weight 6.53 ± 0.13 kg) were assigned to a 2 × 2 factorial design comprising 2 weaning units (W1 and W2) and 2 dietary treatments (control diet or control diet + 2 g/kg tannin blend; 40 piglets per treatment × farm). The trial lasted 76 d, with weighings at T0 (entry into weaning, median 28 d), T1 (d 35), T2 (d 49), and T3 (d 76). Fecal scores and samples were collected at T1, T2, and T3 for shotgun metagenomics (155 samples per time point) and untargeted metabolomics, and targeted urolithin quantification was performed in tannin-treated piglets at T1 and T2. Results Tannin supplementation did not affect overall growth performance throughout the weaning phase, but reduced diarrhea occurrence at T2 in W2 ( P = 0.032). Species-level beta diversity was consistently affected by treatment across time points ( R 2 = 0.01–0.03; P < 0.01), whereas alpha diversity was mainly farm-driven during the early post-weaning phase. Linear discriminant analysis effect size identified farm-dependent taxonomic markers, including Escherichia coli in control pigs from W1 at T1 and Megasphaera elsdenii , Faecalibacterium prausnitzii , and Lactobacillus amylovorus in tannin-treated pigs at later time points. Untargeted metabolomics revealed treatment-related fecal signatures, with isourolithin A and urolithin B among the most discriminant metabolites in treated pigs, especially in W2. Targeted analysis identified 3 urolithin metabotypes (metabotype B in 50.0% of samples), with higher isourolithin A, urolithin B, and urolithin A in W2 than W1 at T2 ( P < 0.01). Network integration identified candidate cooperative microbial consortia associated with urolithin production, including Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens ; these co-abundance associations are correlative and remain to be functionally validated. Conclusions Overall, chestnut–quebracho tannins were associated with a farm-dependent reduction in post-weaning diarrhea and modulated the gut ecosystem through microbiota-dependent polyphenol metabolism.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：栗木與 quebracho（ quebracho/紅 quebracho）單寧可能有助於保育豬的腸道健康，但其功效可能取決於豬場環境以及將單寧轉化為具生物活性代謝物的微生物能力。本研究評估了源自栗木的水解單寧與源自 quebracho 的縮合單寧之混合物，對在兩種商業化豬場條件下飼養的仔豬之生長表現、下痢發生率、腸道巨基因體及糞便代謝體之影響。總計 160 頭離乳仔豬（初始體重 6.53 ± 0.13 公斤）被分配至 2 × 2 因子設計，包含 2 個離乳舍（W1 與 W2）及 2 種日糧處理（對照組日糧，或對照組日糧 + 2 g/kg 單寧混合物；每處理每豬場 40 頭仔豬）。試驗持續 76 天，分別於 T0（進入離乳期，中位數 28 天）、T1（第 35 天）、T2（第 49 天）及 T3（第 76 天）進行秤重。於 T1、T2 及 T3 收集糞便評分與樣本以進行全基因體鳥槍法定序（每個時間點 155 個樣本）與非標靶代謝體學分析，並對接受單寧處理的仔豬在 T1 和 T2 進行標靶尿石素（urolithin）定量。結果：在整個離乳階段中，補充單寧並未影響整體生長表現，但降低了 W2 在 T2 時的下痢發生率（P = 0.032）。在各個時間點，物種層級的貝塔多樣性（beta diversity）持續受到處理的影響（R2 = 0.01–0.03；P < 0.01），而阿爾法多樣性（alpha diversity）在離乳後早期主要由豬場環境所驅動。線性判別分析效應大小（LEfSe）識別出具豬場依賴性的分類群標記，包括 T1 時 W1 對照組豬隻中的大腸桿菌（Escherichia coli），以及在較晚時間點單寧處理組豬隻中的埃氏巨球形菌（Megasphaera elsdenii）、普拉梭菌（Faecalibacterium prausnitzii）和澱粉乳桿菌（Lactobacillus amylovorus）。非標靶代謝體學揭示了與處理相關的糞便特徵，其中異尿石素 A（isourolithin A）與尿石素 B（urolithin B）為處理組豬隻中最具區別力的代謝物之一，在 W2 尤為顯著。標靶分析識別出 3 種尿石素代謝型（metabotypes，其中代謝型 B 占 50.0% 的樣本），且 W2 在 T2 時的異尿石素 A、尿石素 B 與尿石素 A 濃度高於 W1（P < 0.01）。網路整合分析識別出與尿石素產生相關的候選協同微生物群系，包含異尿石素產生艾拉吉桿菌（Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens）；這些共豐度關聯具相關性，尚待功能性驗證。結論：總體而言，栗木-quebracho 單寧與離乳後下痢的豬場依賴性減少有關，並透過依賴微生物群的多酚代謝來調節腸道生態系統。

papers.title: The mLOS Open-Source Software for Analyzing Length of Stay in Animal Shelters
papers.abstract: Length of stay (LOS) is critical in shelter management and animal welfare. Its assessment by calendar period must account for animals whose stay overlaps with period boundaries. mLOS is an open-source R tool that uses animal-level intake and outcome records to analyze LOS distributions and competing outcomes using survival-analysis methods. A companion Python package, ShelterDataPrep, prepares raw data extracts for analysis. The factors used are calendar period, intake type, and a user-defined animal group. The counting-process formulations left-truncate stays in progress at the beginning of a period and right-censor stays ongoing at period end. Kaplan-Meier estimates the stay distribution, Aalen-Johansen gives cumulative incidence by outcome type, and Cox and Weibull regressions compute the effect of each factor adjusted for others. A run computes in-care stay curves, remaining stay curves, competing outcomes, outcome conditional on tenure, and population-load figures including census. Each is produced for the unified sample and separately by factor. Pooled and per-factor Cox regressions produce hazard ratios while corresponding Weibull regressions produce LOS ratios. Validation includes hand-derived exact tests and simulation fixtures that recover known behavior. The outputs comprise plots, companion CSVs, a JSON with complete results, a consolidated workbook, and an experimental slide deck.
papers.abstract_zh: 住院天數（Length of stay, LOS）對收容所管理與動物福利至關重要。透過日曆期間進行評估時，必須將留宿時間與期間邊界重疊的動物納入考量。mLOS 是一個開源的 R 工具，利用個體層級的入所與出所記錄，並透過存活分析方法來分析 LOS 分配與競爭風險結果。其配套的 Python 套件 ShelterDataPrep 則負責準備供分析使用的原始資料擷取檔。所使用的因子包含日曆期間、入所類型，以及使用者定義的動物群組。計數過程公式將在期間開始時仍在進行中的留宿進行左截尾（left-truncate），並將在期間結束時持續中的留宿進行右設限（right-censor）。Kaplan-Meier 法可用於估算留宿分配，Aalen-Johansen 法能提供依結果類型的累積發生率，Cox 與 Weibull 迴歸則可計算經其他因子調整後的各因子效應。單次執行即可計算在所留宿曲線、剩餘留宿曲線、競爭結果、以留宿期為條件的出所率，以及包含清查數在內的族群負載圖。上述內容皆會針對整合樣本及各因子分別產出。合併與各因子的 Cox 迴歸可產生風險比（hazard ratios），而對應的 Weibull 迴歸則產生 LOS 比。驗證方式包含手算精確檢定以及能還原已知行為的模擬測試裝置。產出成果包含繪圖、配套的 CSV 檔、包含完整結果的 JSON 檔、整合活頁簿，以及實驗性質的簡報檔。

papers.title: Apparent Ca Test Positivity and Crossmatch Reactivity in Donkeys from Italy: Intraspecies and Horse–Donkey Compatibility
papers.abstract: Blood group distribution and serological compatibility are poorly characterized in donkeys. We estimated the apparent Ca positive-test frequency in 84 domestic donkeys and assessed donkey–donkey and horse–donkey crossmatch reactivity. Ca typing was performed using a commercial equine immunochromatographic assay. For donkey–donkey crossmatching, one major and one minor crossmatch were analyzed for each of the 77 Ca-concordant and 34 Ca-discordant pairs. Fifty-six of eighty-four donkeys yielded a positive result with the equine Ca assay (66.7%; 95% CI, 56.1–75.8%). Major combined macroscopic/microscopic reactivity occurred in 18/77 Ca-concordant and 11/34 Ca-discordant pairs, whereas minor combined reactivity occurred in 21/77 and 8/34 pairs, respectively. In crossed random-effects logistic models, the adjusted odds ratios for Ca-discordant versus Ca-concordant pairs were 1.56 (95% CI, 0.64–3.82) for major combined reactivity, 0.82 (95% CI, 0.32–2.10) for minor combined reactivity, and 1.57 (95% CI, 0.41–5.94) for major macroscopic reactivity; the minor macroscopic model was not estimable. Horse–donkey reactions were frequent and direction-dependent. When donkey plasma was tested against horse RBCs, combined reactivity occurred in 80/80 tests in the horse-donor/donkey-recipient dataset and in 76/76 tests in the reciprocal dataset, with macroscopic reactivity in 77/80 (96.3%) and 74/76 (97.4%), respectively. In the reciprocal horse-plasma/donkey-RBC direction, combined reactivity occurred in 53/80 (66.3%) and 51/76 (67.1%) tests, with macroscopic reactivity in 32/80 (40.0%) and 32/76 (42.1%), respectively. Ca concordance was not significantly associated with crossmatch reactivity in the present dataset, and Ca status alone did not account for the observed crossmatch-reactivity pattern.
papers.abstract_zh: Donkey血型分佈與血清學相容性目前尚缺乏充分的特性研究。本研究估算84隻家驢中Ca抗原陽性檢測的表觀頻率，並評估驢－驢及馬－驢的交叉試驗反應性。Ca分型採用商業馬用免疫層析檢驗試劑盒進行。在驢－驢交叉試驗中，77對Ca一致及34對Ca不一致的配對各分析一次主試驗與次試驗。在84隻驢子中，有56隻的馬用Ca檢驗結果呈陽性（66.7%；95%信賴區間，56.1–75.8%）。在77對Ca一致的配對中，有18對發生主要的肉眼／顯微鏡綜合反應，34對Ca不一致的配對中有11對發生；次要綜合反應則分別發生於21對與8對配對中。在交叉隨機效應邏輯斯迴歸模型中，Ca不一致相對於Ca一致配對的調整勝算比為：主要綜合反應1.56（95%信賴區間，0.64–3.82）、次要綜合反應0.82（95%信賴區間，0.32–2.10），以及主要肉眼反應1.57（95%信賴區間，0.41–5.94）；次要肉眼模型則無法估計。馬－驢反應頻繁且具方向相依性。當以驢血漿對抗馬紅血球時，在馬捐贈者／驢接受者資料集中的80個試驗中，全數（80/80）皆發生綜合反應，而在相互對照資料集中的76個試驗中亦全數（76/76）發生，肉眼反應分別佔77/80（96.3%）與74/76（97.4%）。在相反的馬血漿／驢紅血球方向中，綜合反應分別發生於53/80（66.3%）與51/76（67.1%）個試驗中，肉眼反應則分別佔32/80（40.0%）與32/76（42.1%）。在本研究資料集中，Ca一致性與交叉試驗反應性無顯著相關，且單憑Ca狀態無法解釋所觀察到的交叉試驗反應模式。

papers.title: Superior MAP–EtCO2 Target Attainment with Rocuronium-Facilitated Controlled Ventilation in Geriatric Small Dogs: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.abstract: Comparative evidence for integrated ventilation–neuromuscular blockade–reversal strategies is limited in geriatric small dogs. This single-center retrospective cohort included 288 dogs aged ≥12 years and weighing ≤7 kg undergoing orthopedic surgery or thoracolumbar hemilaminectomy. Initially planned strategies were spontaneous ventilation without neuromuscular blockade (A), controlled ventilation without blockade (B), rocuronium–controlled ventilation–sugammadex (C), vecuronium–controlled ventilation–sugammadex (D), or vecuronium–controlled ventilation–neostigmine–atropine (E). The primary outcome was the percentage of the entire primary physiologic window with concurrent mean arterial pressure ≥ 60 mmHg and end-tidal carbon dioxide 35–55 mmHg. Adjusted means were A 58.9%, B 59.3%, C 86.6%, D 74.0%, and E 67.8%.
