These findings suggest an association between pre-transfusion SIRS and clinically suspected transfusion-associated adverse events under the broad retrospective primary outcome definition, but the results were sensitive to the level of diagnostic certainty required for outcome classification. The findings should therefore be considered hypothesis-generating and require confirmation in prospective studies using standardized reaction definitions and blinded outcome assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 輸血是重症犬隻重要的支持性療法，然而輸血反應（transfusion reactions, TRs）仍然是臨床上相關的併發症。這項回顧性研究旨在評估輸血前全身性發炎反應症候群（SIRS）是否與犬隻輸血相關不良事件有關。本研究回顧了 2023 年 12 月至 2026 年 5 月期間，於大韓民國一家獸醫轉診醫院接受含紅血球血液製品犬隻的病歷。在 100 隻犬隻的 146 次輸血病程中，有 142 次具備可評估主要結果的病程被納入主要結果分析中。SIRS 組發生輸血相關不良事件的頻率高於無 SIRS 組（32.7% 對比 11.4%；p = 0.007）。在單變量邏輯斯迴歸中，SIRS 與主要結果發生勝算增加相關（勝算比 [OR]，3.78；95% 信賴區間 [CI]，1.36–10.51；p = 0.011）。在以病患為群集的多變量廣義估計方程式（GEE）分析中，調整後的勝算比仍維持升高至 3.57，儘管該關聯性未達到統計學顯著性（95% CI，0.98–12.98；p = 0.053）。每多符合一項 SIRS 標準，皆與主要結果發生勝算增加相關（OR，1.63；95% CI，1.10–2.41；p = 0.014）。然而，在使用基於歸因性（imputability）及獨立重新判定之更嚴格結果定義的敏感度分析中，此關聯性減弱且無統計學顯著性。這些發現表明，在廣泛的回顧性主要結果定義下，輸血前 SIRS 與臨床懷疑的輸血相關不良事件之間存在關聯性，但結果對結果分類所需的診斷確定性水準相當敏感。因此，這些發現應被視為具假設生成性（hypothesis-generating），並需要在前瞻性研究中使用標準化的反應定義與盲法結果評估來進一步確認。

papers.title: Blood DNA Methylation Responses to Seasonal Environmental Variation in the Giant Panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca): A Whole-Genome Bisulfite Sequencing Analysis of Multiple Individuals Across Multiple Time Points
papers.abstract: Seasonal environmental variation is a widespread stressor for wildlife and can induce plastic changes in DNA methylation. Blood DNA methylation is an integrative molecular indicator of overall physiological status, yet its seasonal dynamics in the giant panda remain unclear. This study aimed to profile genome-wide blood methylation patterns in giant pandas under natural field conditions and to reveal the epigenetic strategies underlying their seasonal adaptation. Twelve blood samples were collected from three wild-trained giant pandas in the Daxiangling Nature Reserve during winter (n = 6) and summer (n = 6) between 2023 and 2025 and were subjected to whole-genome bisulfite sequencing. The genome-wide mC/C ratio (4.18–4.98%) was dominated by the CG context. Winter–summer comparison identified 7113 differentially methylated regions and 3063 differentially methylated genes. These genes were enriched in transcriptional regulation, cell surface receptor signaling, miRNA metabolism, and MAPK, Ras, and T/B cell receptor signaling pathways. Winter-hypermethylated genes were enriched in both immune defense and energy-consuming processes, whereas winter-hypomethylated genes showed limited enrichment, indicating that hypermethylation-mediated suppression dominates seasonal adaptation. This study reveals, for the first time, a seasonal methylation fingerprint in giant panda blood characterized by a “summer immune enhancement, winter energy conservation” pattern. As sampling occurred in natural habitats, these differences reflect integrated epigenetic responses to temperature, photoperiod, food availability, and pathogen pressure rather than single-factor effects. These findings provide molecular evidence for seasonal adaptation in endangered mammals and candidate markers for captive panda management and wild-release assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 季節性環境變異是對野生動物普遍存在的壓力源，並能誘導DNA甲基化產生可塑性變化。血液DNA甲基化是整體生理狀態的綜合性分子指標，然而大貓本的血液DNA甲基化季節性動態仍不清楚。本研究旨在描繪自然野外條件下大貓熊全基因組血液甲基化模式，並揭示其季節性適應背後的表觀遺傳策略。於2023年至2025年間，在大相嶺自然保護區內從3隻野化培訓的大貓熊採集了12個血液樣本（冬季n = 6，夏季n = 6），並進行全基因組亞硫酸鹽定序。全基因組mC/C比率（4.18–4.98%）以CG背景為主。冬夏比較共鑑定出7113個差異甲基化區域與3063個差異甲基化基因。這些基因顯著富集於轉錄調控、細胞表面受體訊號傳遞、miRNA代謝，以及MAPK、Ras和T/B細胞受體訊號傳遞路徑。冬季高甲基化基因在免疫防禦與耗能過程中皆有富集，而冬季低甲基化基因則顯示有限的富集，表明高甲基化介導的抑制作用在季節性適應中佔主導地位。本研究首次揭示了大貓熊血液的季節性甲基化特徵，表現出「夏季免疫增強、冬季能量節約」的模式。由於採樣在自然棲息地進行，這些差異反映了對溫度、光週期、食物可利用性及病原體壓力的綜合表觀遺傳反應，而非單一因素的影響。這些發現為瀕危哺乳動物的季節性適應提供了分子證據，並為圈養大貓熊管理與野外放歸評估提供了候選標記。

papers.title: YOLOv11-Pose-Based Tracking Reveals Neuropeptide F Regulation of Agonistic Behavior in Macrobrachium rosenbergii
papers.abstract: The giant freshwater prawn Macrobrachium rosenbergii is inherently aggressive, and this innate trait constitutes a major bottleneck restricting high-density intensive aquaculture. In this study, we developed behavioral phenotyping analysis software integrating YOLOv11-pose and the SORT tracking algorithm to automatically recognize and quantify agonistic behaviors. To validate the reliability of this platform, we used it to investigate the role of neuropeptide F (NPF) through loss- and gain-of-function strategies. The platform successfully captured behavioral differences across treatments and generated results that were consistent with manual observations, confirming its accuracy and utility for automated behavioral analysis. Moreover, it provided additional kinematic metrics that are not accessible through manual observation, offering more comprehensive behavioral quantification. Mechanistically, NPF silencing reduced feed intake, suppressed growth, and disrupted hepatopancreatic glycolysis, suggesting that NPF may modulate aggression at least partly through energy metabolic pathways. Collectively, this study provides a robust tool for behavioral phenotyping in crustaceans, with potential applications for behavior-based management in intensive farming systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型淡水蝦類羅氏沼蝦（*Macrobrachium rosenbergii*）具有天生具侵略性的特質，而此種天生特徵構成了限制高密度集約化水產養殖的主要瓶頸。在本研究中，我們開發了一套整合 YOLOv11-pose 與 SORT 追蹤演算法的行為表現型分析軟體，以自動辨識並量化敵對行為。為了驗證此平台的可靠性，我們透過功能喪失與功能獲得策略，利用該平台探討神經肽 F（NPF）的作用。此平台成功捕捉了各處理組之間的行為差異，且產生的結果與人工觀察結果一致，證實了其用於自動化行為分析的準確性與實用性。此外，它提供了人工觀察無法取得的額外運動學指標，從而提供更全面的行為量化。在機制上，NPF 靜默降低了攝食量、抑制生長，並干擾了肝胰臟的糖解作用，這表明 NPF 至少部分可能透過能量代謝途徑來調控侵略性。總體而言，本研究為甲殼類動物的行為表現型分析提供了強健的工具，並在集約化養殖系統的基於行為管理中具有潛在的應用價值。

papers.title: Association Between Gut Microbiota Dysbiosis and Synovial Inflammation in Carpal Osteoarthritis of Ili Racehorses: A Preliminary Study Integrating Imaging, Synovial Fluid Analysis, and Fecal 16S rRNA Sequencing
papers.abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a leading cause of lameness and premature retirement in racehorses. Gut microbiota may contribute to OA pathogenesis through the gut–joint axis, but this relationship remains unclear in racehorses. This study focused on six OA-affected Ili racehorses and six healthy Ili racehorses from the same region; the Ili horse originated from Yili, Xinjiang, China. OA severity was assessed by clinical examination, lameness grading, radiography, arthroscopy, synovial fluid biomarker analysis, and fecal 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Associations between differential gut microbiota and synovial inflammatory markers were evaluated by Spearman correlation analysis. OA horses exhibited higher lameness scores and typical radiographic findings. Compared with healthy controls, OA horses exhibited significantly higher synovial concentrations of IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, total protein, COMP, and MMP-3. Gut microbiota analysis revealed reduced microbial diversity and significant compositional alterations in OA horses. Spearman correlation analysis demonstrated significant associations between these microbial changes and synovial inflammatory mediators as well as cartilage degradation markers. Overall, gut microbiota dysbiosis in Ili racehorses with carpal OA may be associated with synovial inflammation and abnormal cartilage metabolism via the gut–joint axis. However, the experimental scale and the number of animals will be increased as needed for further validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 骨關節炎（OA）是賽馬跛行和提早退役的主要原因。腸道微生物相可能透過腸－關節軸（gut–joint axis）參與骨關節炎的發病機制，但這種關係在賽馬中尚不清楚。本研究聚焦於來自同一地區的6匹罹患骨關節炎的伊犁馬和6匹健康的伊犁馬；伊犁馬源自中國新疆伊犁。骨關節炎的嚴重程度透過臨床檢查、跛行評級、X光檢查、關節鏡檢查、滑液生物標記分析以及糞便16S rRNA基因定序進行評估。透過斯皮爾曼相關分析（Spearman correlation analysis）評估差異腸道微生物相與滑液發炎標記之間的關聯。罹患骨關節炎的馬匹表現出較高的跛行分數和典型的X光檢查結果。與健康對照組相比，罹患骨關節炎的馬匹其滑液中的IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α、總蛋白、COMP和MMP-3濃度顯著升高。腸道微生物相分析顯示，罹患骨關節炎的馬匹微生物多樣性降低，且組成發生顯著改變。斯皮爾曼相關分析表明，這些微生物變化與滑液發炎介質以及軟骨降解標記之間存在顯著關聯。總體而言，患有腕關節骨關節炎的伊犁馬其腸道微生物相失調，可能透過腸－關節軸與滑液發炎及異常的軟骨代謝有關。然而，未來將視需要擴大實驗規模和動物數量以進行進一步驗證。

papers.title: Sex-Specific DNA Methylation in the Liver of Ancherythroculter nigrocauda, a Fish with Female-Biased Size Dimorphism
papers.abstract: Sexual size dimorphism (SSD) is widespread in teleost fishes, yet the epigenetic mechanisms underlying sex-specific growth remain poorly understood, particularly in non-model species. Here, we performed genome-wide DNA methylation profiling of liver tissue in Ancherythroculter nigrocauda, a species exhibiting female-biased SSD, using the MethylRAD approach. MethylRAD sequencing of five females and five males generated approximately 1.0–1.5 million unique methylated loci per sample. Comparative analysis identified 82,872 differentially methylated sites (DMSs), which clearly separated sexes and were significantly enriched in promoters and CpG islands. Gene ontology analyses revealed that sex-biased methylation preferentially affected pathways related to intracellular signaling, cell adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, and protein modification, processes closely associated with hepatic growth and metabolic regulation. Chromosomal binning uncovered large contiguous male-biased methylation domains on Superscaffold15 and Superscaffold20, consistent with recombination-suppressed regions and suggesting candidate sex-linked loci, with Superscaffold20 supported by prior sex-specific coverage differences. Integration with liver transcriptome data revealed a threshold-dependent regulatory architecture: genes harboring dense methylation clustering (>20 DMS) were approximately six-fold more likely to exhibit sex-biased expression, and directional concordance between methylation and transcription further supported functional coupling. Together, these findings demonstrate that sex-biased DNA methylation in the liver is widespread yet concentrated within regulatory hotspots and discrete chromosomal domains, highlighting epigenetic regulation as a key contributor to hepatic sexual dimorphism and providing new insights into the molecular basis of SSD in teleost fishes.
papers.abstract_zh: 性別體型雙態性（sexual size dimorphism, SSD）在硬骨魚類中普遍存在，然而探討性別特異性生長背後的表觀遺傳機制仍所知有限，特別是在非模式物種中。本研究利用 MethylRAD 方法，對具有雌性偏向性 SSD 的物種黑尾鲌（Ancherythroculter nigrocauda）的肝組織進行了全基因組DNA甲基化圖譜分析。對五個雌性和五個雄性進行的 MethylRAD 定序，每個樣本產生了約 100 萬至 150 萬個獨特的甲基化位點。比較分析識別出 82,872 個差異甲基化位點（DMSs），這些位點能明確區分性別，且在啟動子和 CpG 島中顯著富集。基因本體（Gene Ontology）分析顯示，性別偏向性甲基化主要影響與細胞內信號傳導、細胞黏附、細胞骨架組織和蛋白質修飾相關的途徑，這些過程與肝臟生長和代謝調控密切相關。染色體區段分箱（chromosomal binning）在 Superscaffold15 和 Superscaffold20 上發現了大片連續的雄性偏向性甲基化域，這與重組抑制區域一致，並暗示了候選性別聯鎖位點的存在，其中 Superscaffold20 得到了先前性別特異性覆蓋度差異的支持。與肝臟轉錄體數據的整合揭示了一個閾值依賴的調控架構：含有密集甲基化叢集（>20 個 DMS）的基因表現出性別偏向性表達的可能性約高出六倍，甲基化與轉錄之間的具方向性的一致性進一步支持了功能偶聯。綜上所述，這些發現表明肝臟中的性別偏向性 DNA 甲基化雖然普遍，但集中於調控熱點和獨立的染色體域中，突顯了表觀遺傳調控是促成肝臟性別雙態性的關鍵因素，並為硬骨魚類 SSD 的分子基礎提供了新見解。

papers.title: Respiration Rate Associations with Temperature and Relative Humidity and Preliminary Model-Derived Reference Points in Korean Native Black Goats
papers.abstract: Quantitative evidence on the associations of temperature, relative humidity, and skin temperature (ST) with respiration rate (RR) in Korean native black goats remains limited, including potential sex- and growth-stage differences. Twenty-four goats (six per sex-by-growth-stage group) were repeatedly measured on 35 dates at a single farm over 15–33 °C, yielding 840 repeated animal-date observations. Natural-log-transformed RR was analyzed using a linear mixed-effects model accounting for animal-, date-, and pen-level dependence. Within the observed conditions, each 1 °C increase in temperature and 1 percentage-point increase in relative humidity were associated with 9.23% and 0.79% increases in RR, respectively. At 24 °C, mean relative humidity, and mean baseline body weight, adult goats had higher predicted RR than growing goats, while temperature-associated RR slopes did not clearly differ by sex or growth stage. Adding ST modestly improved in-sample model fit. Model-derived temperatures corresponding to RR criteria of 40, 60, and 80 breaths/min were 21.2–23.1, 25.8–27.7, and 29.0–31.0 °C, respectively, conditional on mean relative humidity and mean baseline body weight. These preliminary population-level reference points are not validated thresholds of heat-stress severity, welfare impairment, or production loss and require external validation in larger, multi-farm studies using independent physiological, behavioural, welfare, and production outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 關於韓國本土黑山羊之溫度、相對濕度及皮膚溫度與呼吸頻率關聯性的定量證據仍然有限，且潛在的性別與生長階段差異亦未明。本研究在單一牧場的 15–33 °C 環境下，對 24 隻山羊（每個性別與生長階段組 6 隻）進行了 35 個日期的重複測量，共產生 840 筆重複的動物-日期觀察值。利用線性混合效應模型分析經自然對數轉換的呼吸頻率，並納入動物、日期及欄位層級的相依性。在觀察到的條件下，溫度每升高 1 °C 與相對濕度每增加 1 個百分點，分別與呼吸頻率增加 9.23% 和 0.79% 相關。在 24 °C、平均相對濕度和平均基準體重下，成羊的預測呼吸頻率高於生長羊，而與溫度相關的呼吸頻率斜率在性別或生長階段之間並無明顯差異。加入皮膚溫度可適度提升樣本內模型的配適度。在給定平均相對濕度和平均基準體重的前提下，對應至呼吸頻率標準為每分鐘 40、60 及 80 次的模型推導溫度分別為 21.2–23.1、25.8–27.7 及 29.0–31.0 °C。這些初步的族群層級參考點並非熱緊迫嚴重程度、福利受損或生產損失的已驗證閾值，尚需透過納入獨立生理、行為、福利及生產結果之更大規模、多牧場研究進行外部驗證。

papers.title: Immune Response of the Pacific Oyster Magallana gigas Following Shell Damage
papers.abstract: Shell integrity is a key determinant of health in cultured bivalves; however, its damage may affect physiological and immune processes associated with repair. This study evaluated the effects of a single non-penetrating shell damage on cellular immune responses and immune-related gene expression in the mantle of the Pacific oyster Magallana gigas. Over 14 days post-damage, reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species (RNS) production, phagocytic activity, adhesion, and aggregation of hemocytes were assessed. Relative expression of tumor necrosis factor (TNF-1, TNF-2), interleukin-17 (IL-17-3, IL-17-6), and Toll receptor (Toll-1) genes was also determined in mantle tissue. The damage induced predominantly temporal alterations in hemocyte functional activity. During the first two days, ROS production decreased, while RNS production remained unchanged; phagocytic activity increased on day 1 and decreased on day 2. More prolonged changes were observed in hemocyte adhesion and aggregation. Of the genes examined, only TNF-2 showed a significant change, with decreased expression on day 7. These results show that a single non-penetrating shell damage primarily induces a broad stress-associated physiological response, which transiently modulates cellular immune parameters and local regulation mechanisms. By the end of the experiment, most parameters did not differ from the control, although certain changes persisted during shell repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 貝殼完整性是決定養殖雙殼類健康狀況的關鍵因素；然而，其受損可能會影響與修復相關的生理及免疫過程。本研究評估了單次非穿透性貝殼損傷對太平洋牡蠣（Magallana gigas）外套膜中細胞免疫反應及免疫相關基因表現的影響。在損傷後的14天內，評估了血球的活性氧（ROS）與活性氮（RNS）產量、吞噬活性、黏附及聚集作用。同時測定了外套膜組織中腫瘤壞死因子（TNF-1、TNF-2）、介白素-17（IL-17-3、IL-17-6）及Toll受體（Toll-1）基因的相對表現量。損傷主要誘導了血球功能活性的時間性改變。在頭兩天，ROS產量下降，而RNS產量保持不變；吞噬活性在第1天增加，但在第2天下降。血球的黏附和聚集則觀察到較長時間的變化。在所檢測的基因中，僅TNF-2表現出顯著變化，其表現量在第7天下降。這些結果表明，單次非穿透性貝殼損傷主要引發廣泛的壓力相關生理反應，從而短暫調節細胞免疫參數與局部調控機制。到實驗結束時，多數參數與對照組無顯著差異，儘管某些變化在貝殼修復期間仍然持續。

papers.title: Chromosome-Level Genome Assemblies of Darevskia mixta and Darevskia valentini: A Platform for Studying Parthenogenesis in Caucasian Rock Lizards
papers.abstract: Darevskia lizards attract the attention of many biologists due to the emergence of parthenogenetic species within the genus. In this study, we present chromosome-level genome assemblies of Darevskia mixta (Méhely, 1909) and Darevskia valentini (Boettger, 1892), two species whose distant ancestors hybridized and formed a parthenogenetic taxon. Genomic DNA was sequenced using the PacBio platform. Primary genome assemblies were generated from ~60 Gb (D. mixta) and ~35 Gb (D. valentini) of the processed PacBio data using HiFiasm and reference-scaffolded. The final genome sequences of D. mixta and D. valentini each span ~1.4 Gb, comprising 19 (18 autosomes and the Z chromosome) and 20 (18 autosomes and the Z and W chromosomes) scaffolds, with N50 scaffold values of 91.1 and 97.5 Mb, respectively. Both genome sequences contain ~42% repeats and encode ~41 thousand predicted genes. The assemblies share major structural similarity, but feature a number of inversions and translocations relative to each other. The obtained assemblies represent the first quality platform for unraveling the genetic features associated with the emergence and maintenance of parthenogenesis in Darevskia lizards.
papers.abstract_zh: 岩蜥屬（Darevskia）蜥蜴因該屬內孤雌生殖物種的出現，吸引了許多生物學家的關注。在這項研究中，我們發表了混合岩蜥（Darevskia mixta (Méhely, 1909)）與瓦倫丁岩蜥（Darevskia valentini (Boettger, 1892)）的染色體層級基因組組裝，這兩個物種的遠祖曾發生雜交並形成一個孤雌生殖分類群。基因組DNA使用PacBio平臺進行定序。初步的基因組組裝是利用HiFiasm與參考基因組骨架，分別從約60 Gb（混合岩蜥）與約35 Gb（瓦倫丁岩蜥）經處理的PacBio數據中產生。混合岩蜥與瓦倫丁岩蜥的最終基因組序列長度均約為1.4 Gb，分別包含19個（18條體染色體及Z染色體）與20個（18條體染色體及Z與W染色體）骨架（scaffolds），其N50骨架數值分別為91.1 Mb與97.5 Mb。這兩個基因組序列皆包含約42%的重複序列，並編碼約4.1萬個預測基因。兩者的組裝結果具有主要的結構相似性，但彼此相對存在許多倒位與易位。所獲得的基因組組裝為揭示岩蜥屬中孤雌生殖之出現與維持相關的遺傳特徵，提供了第一個高品質的平臺。

papers.title: Expression Profile of Transfer RNA-Derived Fragments in Chinese Mitten Crab (Eriocheir sinensis) After Challenge with Aeromonas hydrophila
papers.abstract: The Chinese mitten crab (Eriocheir sinensis) is an important cultured crab in China; however, its aquaculture productivity is severely limited by bacterial pathogens, including Aeromonas hydrophila. Transfer RNA-derived fragments (tRFs) are an emerging class of functional small non-coding RNAs that have been implicated in host–pathogen interactions and immune regulation; yet, their roles in the antibacterial defense of crustaceans remain poorly understood. To investigate the immune response of the Chinese mitten crab to A. hydrophila infection, we employed high-throughput sequencing to characterize the expression profiles and functional features of tRFs in crab hemocytes following a bacterial challenge. The results revealed that tRFs exhibited a conserved length distribution (15–20 nt) and subtype composition, with 5′-tRFs representing the dominant subtype in both control and infected groups. Notably, infection specifically induced the abundance of tRF fragments of 35-nt tRF fragments and slightly altered the proportion of tRF subtypes. Differential expression analysis identified 415 significantly upregulated and 3 downregulated tRFs upon A. hydrophila infection, suggesting widespread changes in tRF abundance during infection. Target prediction and functional enrichment analyses were performed for the top 30 differentially expressed tRFs; the predicted targets were significantly associated with VEGF signaling pathway, DNA replication proteins, FoxO signaling pathway, and NF-kappa B signaling pathway. The reliability of the sequencing data was confirmed by stem-loop RT-qPCR validation. Collectively, our findings advance the understanding of tRF expression in crustacean immunity and suggest that tRFs may be associated with the immune response of crabs against bacterial infection, pending functional validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 中華絨螯蟹（*Eriocheir sinensis*）是中國一項重要的養殖蟹類；然而，其水產養殖生產力受到包括嗜水氣單胞菌（*Aeromonas hydrophila*）在內的細菌病原體的嚴重限制。轉移核糖核酸衍生片段（tRFs）是一類新興的功能性小型非編碼RNA，已被證實參與宿主與病原體的交互作用及免疫調節；然而，牠們在甲殼類動物抗菌防禦中的作用仍所知甚少。為了探討中華絨螯蟹對嗜水氣單胞菌感染的免疫反應，我們採用高通量測序技術，對感染後蟹血細胞中tRFs的表達圖譜與功能特徵進行了表徵。結果顯示，tRFs呈現出保守的長度分佈（15–20 nt）和亞型組成，其中5′-tRFs在對照組和感染組中均占主導地位。值得注意的是，感染特異性地誘發了35-nt tRF片段豐度的增加，並輕微改變了tRF亞型的比例。差異表達分析識別出在嗜水氣單胞菌感染後有415個顯著上調和3個顯著下調的tRFs，這表明在感染過程中tRFs的豐度發生了廣泛的變化。對前30個差異表達的tRFs進行了標靶預測與功能富集分析；預測的標靶與VEGF信號通路、DNA複製蛋白、FoxO信號通路及NF-kappa B信號通路顯著相關。測序數據的可靠性已通過莖環RT-qPCR驗證獲得證實。總體而言，我們的研究結果推進了對甲殼類動物免疫中tRF表達的理解，並表明在功能驗證之前，tRFs可能與螃蟹對抗細菌感染的免疫反應有關。

papers.title: Issue Information
Effects of xylooligosaccharide supplementation on methane emissions, rumen microbiome, and serum metabolome in lactating Jersey cows
papers.abstract: control.
papers.abstract_zh: 木寡糖（XOS）被認為是能有效減少甲烷（CH4）排放的益生元。然而，XOS對CH4排放的影響與瘤胃微生物及其代謝物改變之間的具體關係仍不清楚。為了探討XOS與CH4排放之間的關係，本研究將48頭澤西乳牛隨機分為兩組：XOS組（T組）和對照組（C組）。T組在基礎日糧中添加25 g/d的XOS，C組則添加0 g/d的XOS。每組隨機選取3頭泌乳量與泌乳階段一致的乳牛，進行CH4排放檢測、16S rRNA定序及非標靶代謝體學分析。與C組相比，添加XOS顯著降低了CH4排放，並提高了瘤胃微生物群的觀測物種數（observed species）及基於豐度的覆蓋度估計（ACE）指數。兩組之間共鑑定出16種差異代謝物；這些差異代謝物與微生物群（包括綠彎菌門 [Chloroflexi]、酸桿菌門 [Acidobacteriota] 和產琥珀酸絲菌屬 [Succiniclasticum]）相關。本研究表明，XOS可能透過影響微生物群來調節反芻動物的CH4排放，從而為CH4控制提供了理論依據。

papers.title: Effects of Thymol Supplementation in Health Care Sand on Growth Performance, Serum Biochemical Parameters, Fecal Microbial Diversity, and Fecal Metabolites in Squabs
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of thymol supplementation in health care sand on growth performance, serum biochemical parameters, fecal microbial diversity, and fecal metabolites in Grey King squabs. A total of 160 healthy 28-day-old Grey King squabs were selected and randomly assigned to four treatment groups: the CON, 2%Thy, 3%Thy, and 4%Thy groups. Each group consisted of 10 replicates with four squabs per replicate, resulting in a total of 40 squabs per group. Under identical feeding management conditions and dietary nutrient levels, squabs in the CON group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand; those in the 2%Thy group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand containing 2% thymol; those in the 3%Thy group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand containing 3% thymol; and those in the 4%Thy group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand containing 4% thymol. The experiment lasted for 30 days. During the experimental period, the pigeons were housed in cages measuring 45 cm × 50 cm × 60 cm. Each pigeon was provided with 40 g of diet and 5 g of health care sand daily and had free access to water. After Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate correction, no significant differences were observed in growth performance, body measurements, apparent nutrient retention, or energy metabolizability among treatments (q > 0.05). However, thymol-supplemented groups exhibited significantly increased serum total antioxidant capacity and superoxide dismutase, glutathione peroxidase, and catalase activities, together with decreased malondialdehyde levels (q < 0.05). Fecal microbiome and metabolomic analyses were restricted to the CON and 3%Thy groups, with the 3%Thy group selected after evaluation of the phenotypic and physiological responses rather than being prespecified before the experiment. These omics comparisons were therefore considered exploratory. No statistically significant difference in overall fecal microbial community composition was detected between the two groups, whereas 17 candidate differential fecal metabolite features were observed. These features were mainly putatively annotated as lipids and lipid-like molecules, organic acids and derivatives, organoheterocyclic compounds, and benzenoids. Among the supplementation levels evaluated, the 3%Thy group showed comparatively favorable numerical responses in several measured parameters and may be considered a candidate level for further investigation. However, the present findings do not establish an optimal thymol supplementation level, and the biological significance of the exploratory fecal omics results requires further validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討在保健砂中添加百里香酚（thymol）對灰王鴿幼鴿生長性能、血清生化指標、糞便微生物多樣性及糞便代謝物的影響。試驗選取 160 隻 28 日齡健康灰王鴿幼鴿，隨機分為 4 個處理組：CON 組、2%Thy 組、3%Thy 組和 4%Thy 組。每組設 10 個重複，每個重複 4 隻幼鴿，每組共 40 隻幼鴿。在相同的飼養管理條件與日糧營養水平下，CON 組飼喂基礎日糧加 5 克保健砂；2%Thy 組飼喂基礎日糧加含 2% 百里香酚的 5 克保健砂；3%Thy 組飼喂基礎日糧加含 3% 百里香酚的 5 克保健砂；4%Thy 組飼喂基礎日糧加含 4% 百里香酚的 5 克保健砂。試驗期為 30 天。試驗期間，鴿子飼養於 45 cm × 50 cm × 60 cm 的籠舍中。每隻鴿子每日提供 40 克日糧及 5 克保健砂，自由飲水。經 Benjamini–Hochberg 偽發現率校正後，各處理組間的生長性能、體型指標、表觀養分留存率或能量代謝率均無顯著差異（$q > 0.05$）。然而，添加百里香酚組別的血清總抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶、穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶及過氧化氫酶活性均顯著增加，同時丙二醛含量顯著降低（$q < 0.05$）。糞便微生物組與代謝體學分析僅限於 CON 組與 3%Thy 組，其中 3%Thy 組是在評估表型與生理反應後選出，而非在試驗前預先指定。因此，這些體學比較被視為探索性分析。兩組間的整體糞便微生物群落組成未檢測到統計學上的顯著差異，但觀察到 17 個潛在的差異糞便代謝物特徵。這些特徵主要被推測註解為脂質與類脂分子、有機酸及其衍生物、有機雜環化合物以及苯類化合物。在所評估的添加水平中，3%Thy 組在數項測量指標上表現出相對較佳的數值反應，可被視為進一步研究的候選添加水平。然而，本研究結果並未確立最佳百里香酚添加水平，探索性糞便體學結果的生物學意義仍需進一步驗證。

papers.title: Age-Related Decrease in Interthalamic Adhesion Thickness in Cats Without Apparent Cognitive Dysfunction
papers.abstract: Feline cognitive dysfunction syndrome (FCDS) is an age-associated disorder for which objective imaging markers remain limited. This study evaluated the association between age and interthalamic adhesion thickness (IAT) in cats without apparent cognitive dysfunction and described IAT across feline life stages. MRI examinations from 112 client-owned cats aged 4 months to 18 years were retrospectively reviewed. Cats were classified as kittens (<1 year), young (1 to < 7 years), mature (7 to <11 years) and senior (≥11 years). Cats with intracranial lesions or reported behavioral changes suggestive of cognitive dysfunction were excluded. Two blinded observers measured IAT on transverse T1W and T2W images. Analyses included linear regression adjusted for brain height, brain width, sex/neuter status, breed group, and scanner; exploratory quadratic age modeling; and comparisons among life stages. Interobserver agreement was high. Age was negatively associated with IAT on T1W (B = −0.071 mm/year) and T2W images (B = −0.067 mm/year; both p < 0.001). This association persisted after multivariable adjustment (T1W: B = −0.074 mm/year; T2W: B = −0.067 mm/year; both p < 0.001) and after excluding kittens or brachycephalic cats. Senior cats had lower IAT than all other life stages on both sequences. A quadratic term suggested a steeper decline at older ages on T1W images only; this finding remains exploratory. These findings support a group-level association between age and IAT, rather than individual-level diagnostic use. Its potential diagnostic value for FCDS requires prospective evaluation with standardized behavioral assessment and age-matched controls.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓認知功能障礙症候群（Feline cognitive dysfunction syndrome, FCDS）是一種與年齡相關的疾病，目前缺乏客觀的影像學標記。本研究旨在評估無明顯認知功能障礙貓隻的年齡與丘腦間黏連厚度（interthalamic adhesion thickness, IAT）之間的關聯，並描述不同貓生長階段的 IAT。本研究回顧性分析了 112 隻年齡介於 4 個月至 18 歲之間、有飼主的貓之 MRI 檢查結果。貓隻被分類為幼貓（<1 歲）、年輕貓（1 歲至 <7 歲）、成年貓（7 歲至 <11 歲）以及高齡貓（≥11 歲）。排除具有顱內病變或被通報有暗示認知功能障礙之行為改變的貓隻。兩位盲性觀察者在橫斷面 T1W 和 T2W 影像上測量 IAT。分析包括經腦高、腦寬、性別／絕育狀態、品種組和掃描儀調整後的線性迴歸；探索性二次年齡建模；以及不同生命階段之間的比較。觀察者間的一致性高。在 T1W 和 T2W 影像上，年齡與 IAT 呈負相關（T1W：B = −0.071 mm/年；T2W：B = −0.067 mm/年；兩者 p < 0.001）。在進行多變數調整後（T1W：B = −0.074 mm/年；T2W：B = −0.067 mm/年；兩者 p < 0.001），以及排除幼貓或短頭貓後，此關聯仍然存在。在兩種造影序列中，高齡貓的 IAT 皆低於其他所有生命階段。二次方程式項顯示，僅在 T1W 影像上，高齡時的下降趨勢更為陡峭；此發現仍屬探索性質。這些發現支持年齡與 IAT 之間存在群體層面的關聯，而非個體層面的診斷用途。其對 FCDS 的潛在診斷價值，尚需透過標準化行為評估與年齡匹配的對照組進行前瞻性評估來確立。

papers.title: Why Do Goitered Gazelles Cross the Path of an Approaching Moving Object Instead of Fleeing?
papers.abstract: Animal–vehicle collisions are an important conservation concern. Although many studies examine road mortality and wildlife crossings, less is known about ungulates that run across the path of an approaching vehicle rather than simply fleeing. This study describes this behavior in goitered gazelles (Gazella subgutturosa) and examines its association with four recorded factors: approach category, group size, group composition, and month. In a forward stepwise logistic regression, approach category was associated with crossing behavior (Wald = 22.784, df = 2, p < 0.001). The odds of crossing were higher in the high-category group than in the low-category group (odds ratio = 2.36). However, the categories also differed in object type (cars, motor scooters, and bicycles/pedestrians), so the independent effect of speed cannot be separated from the effect of object type. Group size, group composition, and month did not meet the model’s entry criteria. These observational results identify an association, but do not determine whether path-crossing is a uniquely anti-predator response, a reaction to limited assessment time, or another form of behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 動物與車輛的碰撞是重要的保育議題。雖然許多研究探討了道路死亡率與野生動物穿越道，但對於有蹄類動物在面對逼近的車輛時，究竟是單純逃逸，還是會奔跑穿過車輛路徑，目前所知甚少。本研究描述了小頭瞪羚（Gazella subgutturosa）的這個行為，並探討其與四個記錄因素（接近類別、群體大小、群體組成和月份）之間的關聯。在逐步向前logistic迴歸分析中，接近類別與穿越行為有關（Wald = 22.784, df = 2, p < 0.001）。高等級群體發生穿越行為的勝算比低等級群體來得高（勝算比 = 2.36）。然而，這些類別在目標物類型（汽車、機車以及腳踏車／行人）上也有所不同，因此速度的獨立效應無法與目標物類型的效應分開。群體大小、群體組成和月份並未符合模型的進入標準。這些觀察結果辨識出了一項關聯，但無法斷定路徑穿越究竟是單純的抗掠食反應、對評估時間有限的反應，還是另一種形式的行為。

papers.title: Nanoscale Characterization of Microscopically Layered Bone in the Russian Sturgeon Pectoral Fin Spine: A 3D FIB-SEM Study
papers.abstract: Dermal bone, the earliest known form of bone, develops without a cartilage precursor and persists in extant fish species. The pectoral fin spine (PFS) is a dermal bone located at the leading edge of the pectoral fin of sturgeons, where it is exposed to loading associated with locomotion. The peripheral region and dermal osteons of the PFS both appear layered at lower magnification; however, collagen organization in load-bearing fish skeletal elements remains incompletely characterized at the nanoscale. The aim of this study is to characterize the 3D nanostructure of the layered peripheral and osteonal bone forming the PFS in Russian sturgeons using focused ion beam–scanning electron microscopy (FIB-SEM). In the dermal osteons, bone forms concentric layers around a central canal at lower magnification, and at the nanoscale, the calcified collagen fibrils within these layers have preferential orientations that change in a clockwise–anticlockwise fanning pattern, consistent with lamellar bone. In contrast, the examined peripheral bone, which also appears layered at low magnification, is composed mainly of unidirectional calcified collagen fibrils aligned with the long axis of the PFS. Within the examined peripheral volumes, no comparable nanoscale lamellar pattern was detected, and the predominant fibril organization was consistent with parallel-fibered bone. Groups of voids associated with unidentified fibrillar material were also observed in the examined peripheral volumes; the voids were oriented approximately normal to the long axis of the PFS. We conclude that regions appearing layered at lower magnification can differ markedly at the nanoscale, and that the lamellar organization seen in dermal osteons raises questions about its evolutionary origin.
papers.abstract_zh: 真皮骨（dermal bone）已知是最早出現的骨骼形式，其發育不經由軟骨前驅物，且存在於現存的魚類物種中。胸鰭棘（pectoral fin spine, PFS）是一種真皮骨，位於鱘魚胸鰭的前緣，承受與運動相關的負載。在低倍率下，PFS的周邊區域與真皮骨單元（osteons）均呈現層狀結構；然而，承受負載的魚類骨骼元素中，膠原蛋白的組織形式在奈米尺度下仍未被充分解析。本研究旨在利用聚焦離子束掃描式電子顯微鏡（FIB-SEM），解析俄羅斯鱘魚PFS中構成層狀周邊骨與骨單元骨的三維奈米結構。在真皮骨單元中，於低倍率下骨骼繞著中央管形成同心層；而在奈米尺度下，這些層內的鈣化膠原原纖維具有偏好方向，並以順時針與逆時針的扇形模式交替變化，這與板層骨（lamellar bone）一致。相較之下，所檢視的周邊骨在低倍率下雖也呈層狀，但主要由與PFS長軸對齊的單向鈣化膠原原纖維組成。在所檢視的周邊體積中，未檢測到可比擬的奈米尺度板層模式，且主要的原纖維組織與平行纖維骨（parallel-fibered bone）一致。在所檢視的周邊體積中也觀察到位處不明原纖維物質之空洞群，這些空洞的方向大致垂直於PFS的長軸。我們得出結論：在低倍率下看似層狀的區域，在奈米尺度下可能存在顯著差異，且真皮骨單元中所見的板層組織對其演化起源提出了疑問。

papers.title: Coronavirus Diversity in an Italian Bat Population Sampled During the Pandemic in 2020
papers.abstract: Evolutionary studies have established a correlation between human and bat coronaviruses (CoV), identifying bats as the natural reservoir for Coronaviridae. Over the past two decades, three major zoonotic spillover events have been described: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome CoV (SARS-CoV) and Middle East Respiratory Syndrome CoV (MERS-CoV), which caused significant global outbreaks, and SARS-CoV-2, which triggered the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite these events, the true diversity of coronavirus species harbored by bats remains largely unmapped, even as the discovery of novel strains continues to accelerate. In this study, we analyzed 37 fecal swab samples collected in Northern Italy, targeting the bat genera Miniopterus, Myotis, and Rhinolophus. Coronaviruses were detected using a pan-coronavirus (Pan-CoV) nested RT-PCR in five bat samples: three tested positive for Alphacoronaviruses (Alpha-CoVs) and two for Betacoronaviruses (Beta-CoVs). Positive samples were subjected to Pan-CoV Illumina next-generation sequencing (NGS), and two samples yielded sufficient read depth for robust contig assembly. Phylogenetic analysis revealed the co-circulation of three distinct Alpha-CoVs within a Miniopterus schreibersii (M. schreibersii) fecal sample and the presence of a SARS-CoV-related strain in a Rhinolophus hipposideros (R. hipposideros) fecal sample. Both the Alpha-CoVs and the Beta-CoVs were most closely related to European strains. These findings confirm the widespread circulation of diverse CoVs in Italian bats and underscore the need for continued molecular epidemiological surveillance to unravel the full extent of CoV heterogeneity in European wildlife.
papers.abstract_zh: 演化研究已確立人類與蝙蝠冠狀病毒（CoV）之間的關聯，並認定蝙蝠為冠狀病毒科（Coronaviridae）的自然宿主。在過去二十年間，已描述了三起主要的動物源性病毒跨物種傳播事件：造成全球重大疫情的嚴重急性呼吸道症候群冠狀病毒（SARS-CoV）與中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒（MERS-CoV），以及引發 COVID-19 大流行的 SARS-CoV-2。儘管發生了這些事件，蝙蝠所攜帶的冠狀病毒物種的真實多樣性大體上仍未被充分繪製，儘管新毒株的發現持續加速。在本研究中，我們分析了採集自義大利北部、針對蝙蝠屬（Miniopterus、Myotis 和 Rhinolophus）的 37 份糞便拭子樣本。利用泛冠狀病毒（Pan-CoV）巢式 RT-PCR 在五份蝙蝠樣本中檢測出冠狀病毒：三份對阿爾法冠狀病毒（Alpha-CoVs）呈陽性反應，兩份對貝塔冠狀病毒（Beta-CoVs）呈陽性反應。對陽性樣本進行泛冠狀病毒 Illumina 次世代定序（NGS），其中兩份樣本產生了足夠的讀取深度以進行穩健的重疊群（contig）組裝。系統發生樹分析顯示，在一個長翼蝠（Miniopterus schreibersii）糞便樣本中共同傳播著三種不同的阿爾法冠狀病毒，且在一個小菊頭蝠（Rhinolophus hipposideros）糞便樣本中存在與 SARS-CoV 相關的毒株。阿爾法冠狀病毒與貝塔冠狀病毒皆與歐洲毒株的親緣關係最近。這些發現證實了多樣化的冠狀病毒在義大利蝙蝠中廣泛傳播，並強調了持續進行分子流行病學監測的必要性，以揭示歐洲野生動物中冠狀病毒異質性的完整範圍。

papers.title: Dietary γ-Aminobutyric Acid (GABA) Improves Growth Performance and Increases Plasma Cortisol During Recovery from Short-Term Acute Thermal Exposure in Juvenile Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)
papers.abstract: γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is a functional feed additive that may improve growth and stress resilience. The study evaluated the effects of dietary GABA on growth performance and recovery-phase physiological responses after short-term acute thermal exposure in juvenile rainbow trout. Two hundred twenty-five fish (18.9 ± 0.1 g) were fed five diets for 8 weeks: a control diet containing 68 mg/kg (GABA68) and diets with 108 (GABA108), 149 (GABA149), 183 (GABA183), and 218 (GABA218) mg/kg GABA. Fish were then subjected to short-term acute thermal exposure (20 °C for 2 h) followed by 2 h recovery at 15 °C. Dietary GABA significantly improved weight gain and specific growth rate, with the provisional model-based dietary GABA level for weight gain estimated to be approximately 198–210 mg/kg diet based on broken-line regression models, and increased feed and protein efficiency (p < 0.05). Fish fed the GABA183 and GABA218 diets had significantly higher plasma cortisol concentrations than those fed GABA68 and GABA108 when averaged across temperature treatments, with a significant temperature × GABA interaction (p < 0.05). During recovery, hepatic hsp70α and hsp90βα expression was significantly lower following 20 °C exposure than in fish maintained at 15 °C, whereas dietary GABA and its interaction with temperature had no significant effects on the stress-related genes analyzed. Dietary GABA improved growth performance and feed utilization; however, cortisol measured at a single recovery time point cannot distinguish a stronger stress response, delayed recovery, or altered cortisol clearance and does not demonstrate improved thermal tolerance or a faster recovery rate.
papers.abstract_zh: γ-胺基丁酸（GABA）是一種功能性飼料添加物，可能可改善生長與抗壓能力。本研究評估了飼糧添加GABA對幼虹鱒在短期急性熱暴露後，生長性能及恢復期生理反應的影響。試驗使用225尾魚（18.9 ± 0.1公克），餵食五種飼糧共8週：包含對照組含68 mg/kg GABA（GABA68），以及添加108（GABA108）、149（GABA149）、183（GABA183）與218（GABA218）mg/kg GABA的飼糧。隨後將魚隻暴露於短期急性熱環境（20 °C下2小時），接著在15 °C下恢復2小時。飼糧添加GABA顯著改善了體重增加量與特定生長率，根據折線迴歸模型估算，基於體重增加量的暫定模式化飼糧GABA添加量約為每公斤飼糧198–210 mg/kg，且提高了飼料效率與蛋白質效率（p < 0.05）。跨溫度處理平均而言，餵食GABA183與GABA218飼糧的魚隻，其血漿皮質醇濃度顯著高於餵食GABA68與GABA108的魚隻，且溫度與GABA具有顯著的交互作用（p < 0.05）。在恢復期間，經20 °C暴露後的肝臟 $hsp70\alpha$ 與 $hsp90\beta\alpha$ 表現量顯著低於維持在15 °C的魚隻，而飼糧GABA及其與溫度的交互作用對所分析的壓力相關基因則無顯著影響。飼糧添加GABA改善了生長性能與飼料利用率；然而，在單一恢復時間點測得的皮質醇無法區分是較強的壓力反應、延遲的恢復，還是改變的皮質醇清除率，亦無法證明其具備較佳的耐熱性或更快的恢復速率。

papers.title: Effects of Salinity on Growth, Muscle Biochemical Components and Antioxidant Resistance of Planiliza haematocheilus
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of different water salinities (0, 10, 20 [control], 30, and 40; Practical Salinity Scale, dimensionless) over 56 days on growth performance, muscle biochemical composition, and antioxidant responses in serum and liver of Planiliza haematocheilus. After one-week pre-acclimation at 20, juveniles were directly transferred to the experimental salinities; thus, all groups except the 20 control experienced acute salinity transfer followed by 56-day exposure. Therefore, acute transfer stress and subsequent salinity exposure were confounded and could not be separated in this design. Survival was highest at 20 and lowest at 0. Weight gain rate and specific growth rate peaked at 30 and were lowest at 0. Under this direct-transfer protocol, the optimal salinity range for growth and survival was approximately 20–30 for these ~93 g juveniles. Hepatosomatic index differed significantly among salinity groups. Muscle moisture content was negatively correlated with salinity. Crude protein content was highest in the salinity-40 group, whereas crude fat was highest at 20 and lowest at 0; ash content did not differ significantly among treatments. Superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity in serum and liver showed no clear trend with salinity, but most groups differed significantly from the control. Liver SOD activity was highest at 10 and lowest at 30. Serum catalase (CAT) activity did not differ significantly among salinity groups, whereas liver CAT activity tended to decrease and then increase with rising salinity. Salinity had limited effect on serum malondialdehyde (MDA) content, except for a peak at 40, whereas liver MDA content decreased with increasing salinity and was significantly higher in the low-salinity groups. These results indicate that, under the direct-transfer protocol, P. haematocheilus juveniles (initial weight ~93 g) pre-acclimated to 20 and then directly transferred showed optimal growth and survival at 20–30, and that liver antioxidant parameters may serve as sensitive biomarkers of salinity stress. However, because acute transfer stress was confounded with subsequent 56-day salinity exposure, these findings are specific to this direct-transfer protocol and developmental stage and should not be extrapolated to gradual acclimation protocols or smaller juveniles.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了不同水體鹽度（0、10、20 [對照組]、30 與 40；實用鹽度標尺，無因次）對梭魚（*Planiliza haematocheilus*）生長表現、肌肉生化組成，以及血清和肝臟抗氧化反應的影響，試驗為期 56 天。幼魚在鹽度 20 下預馴養一週後，直接移至實驗鹽度；因此，除鹽度 20 對照組外，所有組別皆經歷急性鹽度轉移，隨後進行為期 56 天的暴露。因此，在此實驗設計中，急性轉移緊迫與隨後的鹽度暴露產生了混淆，無法加以區分。存活率以鹽度 20 最高、0 最低。增重率和特定生長率在鹽度 30 時達到峰值，以 0 時最低。在此直接轉移實驗方案下，對於這些約 93 克的幼魚而言，生長與存活的最佳鹽度範圍約為 20–30。肝體比在各鹽度組間有顯著差異。肌肉水分含量與鹽度呈負相關。粗蛋白含量以鹽度 40 組最高，而粗脂肪含量以 20 時最高、0 時最低；灰分含量在各處理組間無顯著差異。血清和肝臟中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性隨鹽度變化並無明顯趨勢，但多數組別與對照組有顯著差異。肝臟 SOD 活性以 10 時最高、30 時最低。血清過氧化氫酶（CAT）活性在各鹽度組間無顯著差異，而肝臟 CAT 活性隨鹽度上升呈現先降低後升高的趨勢。除在鹽度 40 時出現峰值外，鹽度對血清丙二醛（MDA）含量的影響有限，而肝臟 MDA 含量則隨鹽度增加而降低，且在低鹽度組中顯著較高。這些結果表明，在直接轉移實驗方案下，經鹽度 20 預馴養並直接轉移的梭魚幼魚（初始體重約 93 克）在鹽度 20–30 時表現出最佳的生長與存活，且肝臟抗氧化參數可作為鹽度緊迫的敏感生物標記。然而，由於急性轉移緊迫與隨後 56 天的鹽度暴露產生了混淆，這些發現具體僅適用於此直接轉移方案與發育階段，不應外推至漸進式馴養方案或較小體型的幼魚。

papers.title: HDAC2-Specific Inhibitor Santacruzamate A Inhibits Mouse Preantral Folliculogenesis Through Granulosa Cell Apoptosis and Oocyte Meiosis Interference
papers.abstract: Histone deacetylase 2 (HDAC2)-mediated epigenetic modifications play a crucial role in oogenesis, yet the regulatory mechanisms of HDAC2 throughout the entire process of folliculogenesis remain elusive. In the present study, the localization and expression of HDAC2 were detected in mouse ovaries at distinct postnatal ages and after gonadotropin treatment. The effects and molecular mechanisms of Santacruzamate A (SCA), a selective HDAC2 inhibitor, on folliculogenesis were investigated via an in vitro 3D culture model of mouse preantral follicles. The results showed that HDAC2 was localized in the nuclei of both ovarian granulosa cells and oocytes. Its expression was gradually increased with ovarian development in mice aged from postnatal day 7 to 21, and significantly decreased after 12 h hCG treatment. In follicles cultured in vitro, HDAC2 expression peaked on day 4 of culture. SCA exerted stage-specific and dose-dependent regulatory effects on folliculogenesis. SCA significantly suppressed follicular growth, blocked antrum formation, and triggered follicular atresia. Mechanistically, SCA promoted ovarian granulosa cell apoptosis via increases in pro-apoptotic genes BAX and Caspase-3 levels, and a decrease in anti-apoptotic gene BCL-2 level. Furthermore, SCA disrupted the structural integrity of the follicular microfilament cytoskeleton, interfered with the levels of genes related to oocyte–granulosa cell communication including CX37 and GDF9, caused abnormalities in oocyte spindle structure, chromosome alignment, mitochondrial distribution, and decreased mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm). In conclusion, HDAC2 participates in the transcriptional regulation of mouse folliculogenesis through dynamically changing expression at distinct developmental stages. HDAC2 exerts stage-specific regulatory effects on follicular growth and oocyte maturation, and its mechanisms are associated with maintaining granulosa cell survival, ensuring cytoskeletal integrity, and preserving oocyte mitochondrial function. This study advances our understanding of epigenetic regulation of folliculogenesis and provides novel targets and an experimental basis for optimizing in vitro follicular culture systems and regulating female reproductive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 組織去乙醯酶2（HDAC2）介導的表觀遺傳修飾在卵子發生中扮演關鍵角色，然而HDAC2在整個卵泡發育過程中的調控機制仍未完全明瞭。在本研究中，我們檢測了不同出生後發育階段及性腺激素刺激後的小鼠卵巢中HDAC2的定位與表現。透過小鼠小卵泡體外三維培養模型，探討選擇性HDAC2抑制劑Santacruzamate A（SCA）對卵泡發育的影響及相關分子機制。結果顯示，HDAC2定位於卵巢顆粒細胞及卵母細胞的細胞核中。在出生後第7天至第21天的小鼠中，其表現量隨著卵巢發育而逐漸增加，並在注射hCG 12小時後顯著下降。在體外培養的卵泡中，HDAC2表現量於培養第4天達到峰值。SCA對卵泡發育產生具有階段特異性及劑量依賴性的調控作用。SCA顯著抑制卵泡生長、阻礙竇狀卵泡形成，並引發卵泡閉鎖。在機制上，SCA透過增加促凋亡基因BAX和Caspase-3的表現量、降低抗凋亡基因BCL-2的表現量，促進卵巢顆粒細胞凋亡。此外，SCA破壞了卵泡微絲細胞骨架的結構完整性，干擾了與卵母細胞－顆粒細胞通訊相關的基因（如CX37和GDF9）表現量，導致卵母細胞紡錘體結構、染色體排列及線粒體分佈異常，並降低了線粒體膜電位（ΔΨm）。綜上所述，HDAC2透過在不同發育階段動態變化的表現，參與小鼠卵泡發育的轉錄調控。HDAC2對卵泡生長和卵母細胞成熟發揮階段特異性的調控作用，其機制與維持顆粒細胞存活、確保細胞骨架完整性以及維持卵母細胞線粒體功能密切相關。本研究加深了我們對卵泡發育表觀遺傳調控的理解，並為優化體外卵泡培養系統及調控雌性生殖性能提供了新的標靶與實驗基礎。

papers.title: Variation in Colostrum Brix Values and Associations Between Initial Body Weight, Colostrum Intake and Piglet Survival from 24 h to Weaning in a Swedish Sow Herd
papers.abstract: Colostrum is essential for neonatal piglet survival, but individual teat measurements may not represent sow-level mean Brix values. Brix refractometry provides an indirect on-farm estimate of colostrum IgG concentration. This exploratory study quantified Brix variation within and between sows and examined associations between initial body weight, sow Brix values, estimated colostrum intake, and survival from approximately 24 h to weaning. Colostrum was sampled from 28 sows in a Swedish high-health herd. A total of 410 teat samples were analysed and 373 piglets were weighed at colostrum sampling and followed until weaning. The mean sow Brix value was 27.6%. Approximately half the variation was attributable to differences between sows, with the remainder occurring between teats within sows. Empirical resampling analysis showed that sampling multiple teats improved the precision of sow-level mean Brix estimates; with five teats, 95.2% of estimates were within ±1.5 Brix percentage points of the observed sow mean. No clear association between sow-level Brix values and survival from 24 h to weaning was detected. Survival was associated with initial body weight, and the association with estimated colostrum intake depended on initial body weight, being strongest for piglets with lower body weight. Given limited sow numbers and single-herd design, these findings require multi-herd validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 初乳對初生仔豬的存活至關重要，但個別乳頭的測量值可能無法代表母豬群體的平均布里克斯（Brix）糖度值。布里克斯折射儀可用於場內間接估算初乳中的 IgG 濃度。本探索性研究量化了母豬體內及母豬之間的布里克斯變異，並檢視了初始體重、母豬布里克斯值、估算初乳攝入量以及從約 24 小時齡至離乳期間存活率之間的關聯。本研究自瑞典一個高健康水準豬場的 28 頭母豬採集初乳樣本，分析了總共 410 個乳頭樣本，並對 373 頭仔豬在採集初乳時進行秤重，並追蹤至離乳。母豬平均布里克斯值為 27.6%。大約一半的變異歸因於母豬間的差異，其餘則發生在同一頭母豬的不同乳頭之間。經驗重抽樣分析顯示，採集多個乳頭可提高母豬層級平均布里克斯估計值的精確度；若採集五個乳頭，95.2% 的估計值落在觀察到的母豬平均值 ±1.5 個布里克斯百分點的範圍內。研究未發現母豬層級布里克斯值與 24 小時齡至離乳存活率之間有明顯的關聯。存活率與初始體重有關，而與估算初乳攝入量的關聯則取決於初始體重，對體重較輕的仔豬影響最強烈。鑑於母豬數量有限且為單一豬場設計，這些結果尚需多豬場的驗證。

papers.title: Characterising the Yellow Muscle Phenotype of Common Carp by Muscle Carotenoids, Fatty Acid Composition and Multi-Omics Analysis
papers.abstract: Muscle color affects the market value of common carp (Cyprinus carpio), but the pigmentary and metabolic basis of the yellow muscle phenotype remains unclear. In this study, we compared muscle carotenoids, fatty acid profiles, and multi-omics data between wild yellow muscle (YC) and normal muscle (NC) common carp. YC showed significantly higher yellowness (b*) value, but there were no significant differences in the lightness (L*) and redness (a*) values. Total carotenoid was higher in YC and positively correlated with b*value. YC had higher saturated fatty acids (SFA) and n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFA) proportions, including eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), but lower n-6 and total PUFA, despite unchanged crude fat content. Total carotenoid content correlated with multiple fatty acids but not crude fat. Multi-omics analyses converged on glycerophospholipid metabolism, unsaturated fatty acid biosynthesis, and arachidonic acid metabolism, and cd36, scarb1, and bco2 were upregulated in YC muscle. In summary, these findings indicate that carotenoid accumulation underlies enhanced yellowness, while lipid remodeling and related transport processes may facilitate carotenoid retention in YC.
papers.abstract_zh: 肌肉顏色會影響鯉魚（Cyprinus carpio）的市場價值，然而黃色肌肉表型的色素與代謝基礎仍不清楚。在本研究中，我們比較了野生黃色肌肉（YC）與正常肌肉（NC）鯉魚的肌肉類胡蘿蔔素、脂肪酸組分以及多體學數據。YC顯示出顯著較高的黃色度（$b^*$）值，但在明度（$L^*$）和紅色度（$a^*$）值上則無顯著差異。總類胡蘿蔔素在YC中較高，且與$b^*$值呈正相關。儘管粗脂肪含量沒有改變，但YC具有較高的飽和脂肪酸（SFA）與n-3多元不飽和脂肪酸（n-3 PUFA）比例（包含二十碳五烯酸〔EPA〕與二十二碳六烯酸〔DHA〕），而n-6及總多元不飽和脂肪酸則較低。總類胡蘿蔔素含量與多種脂肪酸相關，但與粗脂肪無關。多體學分析聚焦於甘油磷脂代謝、不飽和脂肪酸生物合成及花生四烯酸代謝，且 $cd36$、$scarb1$ 和 $bco2$ 在 YC 肌肉中顯著上調。總括而言，這些發現表明類胡蘿蔔素的累積是增強黃色度的基礎，而脂質重塑及相關轉運過程則可能促進類胡蘿蔔素在 YC 中的滯留。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Bird Collision Prevention Patterned Samples: Avoidance Performance Under Transparent and Reflective Glass Conditions in Flight Tunnel Tests
papers.abstract: The transparency and reflectivity of glass are primary factors contributing to bird collisions, as they prevent birds from recognizing glass surfaces as obstacles. However, the effectiveness of bird collision prevention products is primarily evaluated through transparency-based tunnel tests, which do not adequately account for the reflective conditions commonly found on building glass. We developed an indoor flight tunnel system that simulated sky reflections on glass surfaces and compared avoidance responses to three bird collision prevention patterned samples under both transparent and reflective conditions. A total of 507 wild small passerines were tested, each undergoing a single flight trial. All three patterned samples showed lower avoidance rates under reflective than transparent conditions, but the overall effect of test condition on avoidance was not statistically significant. The frequency of invalid flights increased significantly under reflective conditions. These findings suggest that avoidance responses to bird collision prevention products may vary between transparent and reflective test configurations, although the magnitude of this difference remains uncertain. Incorporating reflective conditions alongside conventional transparency-based tests may therefore provide complementary information for evaluating product performance under different optical conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 玻璃的透明度與反射率是導致鳥類窗殺的主要因素，因為這會妨礙鳥類將玻璃表面識別為障礙物。然而，防撞產品的有效性評估主要透過基於透明條件的隧道實驗進行，這並未能充分考量建築玻璃常見的反射條件。本研究開發了一套室內飛行隧道系統，可模擬玻璃表面上的天空反射，並在透明與反射條件下，比較鳥類對三種防撞圖案樣本的迴避反應。總共測試了 507 隻野生小型雀形目鳥類，每隻鳥進行單次飛行試驗。在反射條件下，三種圖案樣本的迴避率均低於透明條件，但測試條件對迴避行為的整體影響並未達到統計顯著。無效飛行頻率在反射條件下顯著增加。這些研究結果顯示，鳥類對防撞產品的迴避反應可能會因透明與反射的測試配置而異，儘管此差異的幅度仍不確定。因此，在傳統的透明測試之外納入反射條件，或可為評估產品在不同光學條件下的效能提供互補的資訊。

papers.title: Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis in Two Neutered Male Maine Coon Cats: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE), also referred to as spontaneous femoral capital physeal fracture, is an uncommon orthopedic disorder in cats characterized by separation of the femoral capital epiphysis through the proximal femoral physis in the absence of significant trauma. Maine Coon cats, particularly males, appear to be predisposed to this condition. This report describes two neutered male Maine Coon cats, aged 21 and 16 months, presenting with pelvic limb lameness without a known history of significant trauma. The first cat exhibited grade 2 pelvic limb lameness, bilateral pelvic limb muscle atrophy, and pain and crepitus during manipulation of both coxofemoral joints. Radiographic examination revealed bilateral SCFE associated with secondary degenerative changes. The second cat presented with grade 1 pelvic limb lameness, joint laxity, and pain without palpable crepitus. Radiographic examination raised suspicion of right femoral capital physeal separation, which was subsequently confirmed by computed tomography. Both cats underwent femoral head and neck excision (FHNE), with bilateral FHNE performed during a single anesthetic episode in the first cat. Postoperative clinical examinations and owner reports indicated improvement in pelvic limb function and resolution of clinically apparent lameness in both cats. Radiographic examinations performed six months postoperatively documented the surgical changes, with persistent reduction in pelvic limb soft-tissue volume consistent with muscle atrophy. These cases highlight the variable clinical and imaging presentations of SCFE in Maine Coon cats and the complementary roles of radiography and computed tomography in diagnosis. Although clinical improvement was observed following FHNE, the absence of standardized functional assessments limits definitive conclusions regarding the extent of postoperative recovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 股骨頭骺板is滑脫（Slipped capital femoral epiphysis, SCFE），亦稱為自發性股骨頭骺板骨折，是貓少見的骨科疾病，其特徵為在沒有明顯外傷的情況下，股骨頭骨骺透過近端股骨骺板分離。緬因貓，特別是公貓，似乎對此疾病具有易感性。本病例報告描述了兩隻絕育公緬因貓，年齡分別為21個月大與16個月大，主訴為後肢跛行且無已知之顯著外傷史。第一隻貓表現出2級後肢跛行、雙側後肢肌肉萎縮，以及在雙側髖關節操作時出現疼痛與彈響音。放射線學檢查顯示雙側SCFE伴隨繼發性退化性改變。第二隻貓表現出1級後肢跛行、關節鬆弛以及疼痛，無可觸及之彈響音。放射線學檢查懷疑右側股骨頭骺板分離，隨後透過電腦斷層掃描確診。兩隻貓皆接受了股骨頭頸切除術（FHNE），其中第一隻貓在單次麻醉過程中進行了雙側FHNE。術後臨床檢查與飼主回報顯示，兩隻貓的後肢功能均有所改善，且臨床上明顯的跛行消失。術後六個月進行的放射線學檢查記錄了手術變化，並伴隨與肌肉萎縮一致的後肢軟組織體積持續減少。這些病例突顯了緬因貓SCFE多變的臨床與影像學表現，以及放射線學與電腦斷層掃描在診斷中的互補角色。儘管在接受FHNE後觀察到臨床改善，但缺乏標準化的功能評估，限制了對術后恢復程度的明確結論。
